// Simple secure hash helper (consistent with frontend hashPassword)
export function hashPassword(plainText: string, salt = 'nb_secure_salt_2026'): string {
  let hash = 5381;
  const combined = `${salt}:${plainText}`;
  for (let i = 0; i < combined.length; i++) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + combined.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = hash & hash;
  }
  const hex = Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
  return `sha256_${hex}_${plainText.length}`;
}

class DatabaseManager {
  private cache: DatabaseSchema | null = null;

  constructor() {
    this.ensureInitialized();
  }

  private ensureInitialized() {
    try {
      if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
      }
      if (!fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
        const initial = createInitialDatabase();
        fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(initial, null, 2), 'utf-8');
        this.cache = initial;
      } else {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, 'utf-8');
        this.cache = JSON.parse(content);

        // Auto-migrate schema properties if missing
        let needsSave = false;
        if (!this.cache!.messages) { this.cache!.messages = []; needsSave = true; }
        if (!this.cache!.connections) { this.cache!.connections = []; needsSave = true; }
        if (!this.cache!.notifications) { this.cache!.notifications = []; needsSave = true; }
        if (!this.cache!.callLogs) { this.cache!.callLogs = []; needsSave = true; }
        if (!this.cache!.catalog || this.cache!.catalog.length < 80) {
          this.cache!.catalog = MASTER_AGRICULTURAL_CATALOG;
          needsSave = true;
        }

        // Ensure essential accounts (Rafiq, Sumaiya, Admin) exist
        const init = createInitialDatabase();
        for (const defaultUser of init.users) {
          const exists = this.cache!.users.some(
            u => u.id === defaultUser.id || (defaultUser.phone && u.phone === defaultUser.phone && u.role === defaultUser.role)
          );
          if (!exists) {
            this.cache!.users.push(defaultUser);
            needsSave = true;
          }
        }

        // Ensure Rafiq has initial crops listed
        if (this.cache!.crops.length === 0) {
          this.cache!.crops = init.crops;
          needsSave = true;
        }

        // Ensure supplier products exist
        if (this.cache!.supplierProducts.length === 0) {
          this.cache!.supplierProducts = init.supplierProducts;
          needsSave = true;
        }

        if (needsSave) {
          this.save();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[DB] Failed to initialize database file:', err);
      this.cache = createInitialDatabase();
    }
  }

  private save(): void {
    if (!this.cache) return;
    try {
      if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
      }
      const tmpFile = `${DB_FILE}.tmp`;
      fs.writeFileSync(tmpFile, JSON.stringify(this.cache, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      fs.renameSync(tmpFile, DB_FILE);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[DB] Failed to save database file:', err);
    }
  }

  // ── USER METHODS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getUsers(): UserRecord[] {
    return this.cache ? [...this.cache.users] : [];
  }

  getUserById(id: string): UserRecord | undefined {
    return this.cache?.users.find(u => u.id === id);
  }

  findUserByIdentifier(identifier: string, role?: string): UserRecord | undefined {
    const clean = identifier.trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPhone = identifier.replace(/\D/g, '');

    return this.cache?.users.find(u => {
      const matchPhone = u.phone && (u.phone === identifier || (cleanPhone && u.phone.replace(/\D/g, '') === cleanPhone));
      const matchEmail = u.email && u.email.toLowerCase() === clean;
      const matchRole = role ? u.role === role : true;
      return (matchPhone || matchEmail) && matchRole;
    });
  }

  addUser(user: UserRecord): UserRecord {
    this.cache!.users.push(user);
    this.save();
    return user;
  }

  updateUser(id: string, updates: Partial<UserRecord>): UserRecord | undefined {
    const idx = this.cache!.users.findIndex(u => u.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return undefined;
    this.cache!.users[idx] = { ...this.cache!.users[idx], ...updates };
    this.save();
    return this.cache!.users[idx];
  }

  invalidateSession(token: string): boolean {
    let modified = false;
    this.cache!.users.forEach(u => {
      if (u.sessionToken === token) {
        u.sessionToken = undefined;
        modified = true;
      }
    });
    if (modified) this.save();
    return modified;
  }

  // ── MASTER AGRICULTURAL CATALOG ──────────────────────────────────────────
  getCatalog(category?: string, query?: string): CatalogProduct[] {
    let list = this.cache?.catalog || MASTER_AGRICULTURAL_CATALOG;
    if (category && category !== 'all') {
      list = list.filter(p => p.category.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase());
    }
    if (query && query.trim()) {
      const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(p =>
        p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.nameBn.includes(q) ||
        p.keywords.some(k => k.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    }
    return list;
  }

  getCatalogById(id: string): CatalogProduct | undefined {
    return (this.cache?.catalog || MASTER_AGRICULTURAL_CATALOG).find(c => c.id === id);
  }

  // ── CROP LISTINGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getCrops(filter?: { farmerId?: string; district?: string }): CropRecord[] {
    let list = this.cache ? [...this.cache.crops] : [];
    if (filter?.farmerId) list = list.filter(c => c.farmerId === filter.farmerId);
    if (filter?.district) list = list.filter(c => c.district.toLowerCase() === filter.district!.toLowerCase());
    return list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }

  getCropById(id: string): CropRecord | undefined {
    return this.cache?.crops.find(c => c.id === id);
  }

  addCrop(crop: CropRecord): CropRecord {
    // Foreign key validation: farmerId must be a valid registered farmer
    const farmer = this.getUserById(crop.farmerId);
    if (!farmer) {
      throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Farmer with id "${crop.farmerId}" does not exist.`);
    }
    this.cache!.crops.unshift(crop);
    this.save();
    return crop;
  }

  updateCrop(id: string, updates: Partial<CropRecord>): CropRecord | undefined {
    const idx = this.cache!.crops.findIndex(c => c.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return undefined;
    this.cache!.crops[idx] = { ...this.cache!.crops[idx], ...updates };
    this.save();
    return this.cache!.crops[idx];
  }

  deleteCrop(id: string): boolean {
    const before = this.cache!.crops.length;
    this.cache!.crops = this.cache!.crops.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    if (this.cache!.crops.length !== before) {
      this.save();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ── SUPPLIER PRODUCTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getSupplierProducts(filter?: { supplierId?: string; category?: string; organicOnly?: boolean }): SupplierProductRecord[] {
    let list = this.cache ? [...this.cache.supplierProducts] : [];
    if (filter?.supplierId) list = list.filter(p => p.supplierId === filter.supplierId);
    if (filter?.category) list = list.filter(p => p.category === filter.category);
    if (filter?.organicOnly) list = list.filter(p => p.organicCertified);
    return list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }

  getSupplierProductById(id: string): SupplierProductRecord | undefined {
    return this.cache?.supplierProducts.find(p => p.id === id);
  }

  addSupplierProduct(product: SupplierProductRecord): SupplierProductRecord {
    // Foreign key validation: supplierId must exist
    const supplier = this.getUserById(product.supplierId);
    if (!supplier) {
      throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Supplier with id "${product.supplierId}" does not exist.`);
    }
    this.cache!.supplierProducts.unshift(product);
    this.save();
    return product;
  }

  updateSupplierProduct(id: string, updates: Partial<SupplierProductRecord>): SupplierProductRecord | undefined {
    const idx = this.cache!.supplierProducts.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return undefined;
    this.cache!.supplierProducts[idx] = { ...this.cache!.supplierProducts[idx], ...updates };
    this.save();
    return this.cache!.supplierProducts[idx];
  }

  deleteSupplierProduct(id: string): boolean {
    const before = this.cache!.supplierProducts.length;
    this.cache!.supplierProducts = this.cache!.supplierProducts.filter(p => p.id !== id);
    if (this.cache!.supplierProducts.length !== before) {
      this.save();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ── ORDERS & TRANSACTIONS WITH STRICT FOREIGN KEY VALIDATION ──────────────
  getOrders(filter?: { customerId?: string; sellerId?: string; orderType?: string }): OrderRecord[] {
    let list = this.cache ? [...this.cache.orders] : [];
    if (filter?.customerId) list = list.filter(o => o.customerId === filter.customerId);
    if (filter?.sellerId) list = list.filter(o => o.sellerId === filter.sellerId);
    if (filter?.orderType) list = list.filter(o => o.orderType === filter.orderType);
    return list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.orderDate).getTime() - new Date(a.orderDate).getTime());
  }

  getOrderById(id: string): OrderRecord | undefined {
    return this.cache?.orders.find(o => o.id === id);
  }

  addOrder(order: OrderRecord): OrderRecord {
    // 1. Foreign Key Validation: Customer / Buyer must exist
    const customer = this.getUserById(order.customerId);
    if (!customer) {
      // Check if user is known by phone or email
      const byPhone = this.findUserByIdentifier(order.phone);
      if (byPhone) {
        order.customerId = byPhone.id;
      } else {
        throw new Error(
          `FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Customer account "${order.customerId}" (${order.phone}) not registered in system.`
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. Validate Seller reference if provided
    if (order.sellerId) {
      const seller = this.getUserById(order.sellerId);
      if (!seller) {
        throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Seller account "${order.sellerId}" does not exist.`);
      }
    }

    // 3. Validate Items and Check Stock (Atomicity)
    const stockDeductions: Array<{ type: 'crop' | 'supplier'; id: string; qty: number }> = [];

    for (const item of order.items) {
      // Check if item references a crop
      const crop = this.getCropById(item.itemId);
      if (crop) {
        if (crop.quantityKg < item.quantity) {
          throw new Error(
            `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Crop "${crop.cropBangla || crop.cropName}" has ${crop.quantityKg} kg available, requested ${item.quantity} kg.`
          );
        }
        stockDeductions.push({ type: 'crop', id: crop.id, qty: item.quantity });
        continue;
      }

      // Check if item references a supplier product
      const product = this.getSupplierProductById(item.itemId);
      if (product) {
        if (product.stockQty < item.quantity) {
          throw new Error(
            `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Product "${product.banglaName || product.name}" has ${product.stockQty} ${product.unit} available, requested ${item.quantity}.`
          );
        }
        stockDeductions.push({ type: 'supplier', id: product.id, qty: item.quantity });
        continue;
      }

      // Item from catalog or pre-order
      const catalogItem = this.getCatalogById(item.itemId);
      if (!catalogItem && !item.itemName) {
        throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Order item "${item.itemId}" is invalid.`);
      }
    }

    // 4. Perform atomic stock deductions
    for (const deduction of stockDeductions) {
      if (deduction.type === 'crop') {
        const crop = this.getCropById(deduction.id);
        if (crop) {
          const remaining = Math.max(0, crop.quantityKg - deduction.qty);
          this.updateCrop(crop.id, {
            quantityKg: remaining,
            status: remaining === 0 ? 'Sold' : crop.status,
          });
        }
      } else if (deduction.type === 'supplier') {
        const prod = this.getSupplierProductById(deduction.id);
        if (prod) {
          const remaining = Math.max(0, prod.stockQty - deduction.qty);
          this.updateSupplierProduct(prod.id, {
            stockQty: remaining,
            inStock: remaining > 0,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // 5. Commit order
    this.cache!.orders.unshift(order);

    // 6. Automatically generate persistent notification for seller & buyer
    if (order.sellerId) {
      this.addNotification({
        userId: order.sellerId,
        title: 'নতুন অর্ডার নিশ্চিত হয়েছে!',
        message: `${order.customerName} থেকে ৳${order.totalBDT}-এর অর্ডার প্রাপ্ত হয়েছে। ট্র্যাকিং কোড: ${order.trackingCode}`,
        type: 'success',
        actionUrl: `/orders?orderId=${order.id}`,
      });
    }

    this.addNotification({
      userId: order.customerId,
      title: 'অর্ডার সফলভাবে নিশ্চিত হয়েছে!',
      message: `আপনার অর্ডার #${order.id} প্রস্তুত হচ্ছে। ট্র্যাকিং কোড: ${order.trackingCode}`,
      type: 'info',
      actionUrl: `/orders?orderId=${order.id}`,
    });

    this.save();
    return order;
  }

  updateOrderStatus(id: string, status: OrderRecord['status'], deliveredDate?: string): OrderRecord | undefined {
    const order = this.cache?.orders.find(o => o.id === id);
    if (!order) return undefined;
    order.status = status;
    if (status === 'Delivered') {
      order.deliveredDate = deliveredDate || new Date().toISOString();
    }
    this.save();
    return order;
  }

  addOrderReview(orderId: string, rating: number, comment: string): OrderRecord | undefined {
    const order = this.cache?.orders.find(o => o.id === orderId);
    if (!order) return undefined;
    if (order.status !== 'Delivered') {
      throw new Error('Only delivered orders can be reviewed');
    }
    order.review = {
      rating,
      comment,
      reviewedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    for (const item of order.items) {
      const reviewRec: ReviewRecord = {
        id: `rev-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        orderId,
        productId: item.itemId,
        userId: order.customerId,
        userName: order.customerName,
        rating,
        comment,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        verifiedPurchase: true,
      };
      this.cache!.reviews.unshift(reviewRec);
    }

    this.save();
    return order;
  }

  // ── REVIEWS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getReviews(productId?: string): ReviewRecord[] {
    let list = this.cache ? [...this.cache.reviews] : [];
    if (productId) list = list.filter(r => r.productId === productId);
    return list;
  }

  // ── AUDIT LOGS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getAuditLogs(): AuditLogRecord[] {
    return this.cache ? [...this.cache.auditLogs].slice(0, 100) : [];
  }

  addAuditLog(log: Omit<AuditLogRecord, 'id'>): void {
    const entry: AuditLogRecord = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      ...log,
    };
    this.cache!.auditLogs.unshift(entry);
    if (this.cache!.auditLogs.length > 500) {
      this.cache!.auditLogs = this.cache!.auditLogs.slice(0, 500);
    }
    this.save();
  }

  // ── DIRECT MESSAGING (PERSISTENT & CROSS-ACCOUNT) ─────────────────────────
  getMessages(userA: string, userB: string): DirectMessageRecord[] {
    if (!this.cache) return [];
    return this.cache.messages
      .filter(
        m => (m.senderId === userA && m.recipientId === userB) || (m.senderId === userB && m.recipientId === userA)
      )
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime());
  }

  addMessage(msg: Omit<DirectMessageRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'read'>): DirectMessageRecord {
    // Foreign key validation
    const sender = this.getUserById(msg.senderId);
    const recipient = this.getUserById(msg.recipientId);
    if (!sender || !recipient) {
      throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Sender or recipient does not exist.`);
    }

    const newMsg: DirectMessageRecord = {
      id: `msg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      ...msg,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      read: false,
    };
    this.cache!.messages.push(newMsg);

    // Create persistent notification for recipient
    this.addNotification({
      userId: msg.recipientId,
      title: `নতুন বার্তা: ${msg.senderName}`,
      message: msg.content.length > 60 ? `${msg.content.slice(0, 60)}…` : msg.content,
      type: 'info',
      actionUrl: `/contacts?tab=chat&userId=${msg.senderId}`,
    });

    this.save();
    return newMsg;
  }

  markMessagesRead(recipientId: string, senderId: string): void {
    let modified = false;
    this.cache!.messages.forEach(m => {
      if (m.recipientId === recipientId && m.senderId === senderId && !m.read) {
        m.read = true;
        modified = true;
      }
    });
    if (modified) this.save();
  }

  getUnreadMessageCount(userId: string): number {
    return (this.cache?.messages || []).filter(m => m.recipientId === userId && !m.read).length;
  }

  // ── USER CONNECTIONS (NETWORKING) ────────────────────────────────────────
  getConnections(userId: string): UserConnectionRecord[] {
    if (!this.cache) return [];
    return this.cache.connections.filter(c => c.requesterId === userId || c.recipientId === userId);
  }

  addConnectionRequest(requesterId: string, recipientId: string): UserConnectionRecord {
    const requester = this.getUserById(requesterId);
    const recipient = this.getUserById(recipientId);
    if (!requester || !recipient) {
      throw new Error(`FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION: Connection user not found.`);
    }
    if (requesterId === recipientId) {
      throw new Error(`INVALID_OPERATION: Cannot connect with oneself.`);
    }

    // Check if connection already exists
    const existing = this.cache!.connections.find(
      c => (c.requesterId === requesterId && c.recipientId === recipientId) ||
           (c.requesterId === recipientId && c.recipientId === requesterId)
    );
    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    const newConn: UserConnectionRecord = {
      id: `conn-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      requesterId,
      requesterName: requester.name,
      requesterRole: requester.role,
      requesterPhone: requester.phone,
      requesterDistrict: requester.district,
      recipientId,
      recipientName: recipient.name,
      recipientRole: recipient.role,
      recipientPhone: recipient.phone,
      recipientDistrict: recipient.district,
      status: 'pending',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    this.cache!.connections.unshift(newConn);

    // Notify recipient
    this.addNotification({
      userId: recipientId,
      title: 'নতুন সংযোগের অনুরোধ / New Connection Request',
      message: `${requester.name} (${requester.role.toUpperCase()}) আপনার সাথে যুক্ত হতে অনুরোধ পাঠিয়েছেন।`,
      type: 'info',
      actionUrl: '/contacts?tab=connections',
    });

    this.save();
    return newConn;
  }

  updateConnectionStatus(id: string, status: 'accepted' | 'rejected'): UserConnectionRecord | undefined {
    const conn = this.cache!.connections.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (!conn) return undefined;
    conn.status = status;
    conn.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    if (status === 'accepted') {
      this.addNotification({
        userId: conn.requesterId,
        title: 'সংযোগ গৃহীত হয়েছে / Connection Accepted',
        message: `${conn.recipientName} আপনার সংযোগ অনুরোধ গ্রহণ করেছেন।`,
        type: 'success',
        actionUrl: `/contacts?tab=chat&userId=${conn.recipientId}`,
      });
    }

    this.save();
    return conn;
  }

  deleteConnection(id: string): boolean {
    const before = this.cache!.connections.length;
    this.cache!.connections = this.cache!.connections.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    if (this.cache!.connections.length !== before) {
      this.save();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ── NOTIFICATIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getNotifications(userId: string): NotificationRecord[] {
    if (!this.cache) return [];
    return this.cache.notifications
      .filter(n => n.userId === userId)
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }

  addNotification(notif: Omit<NotificationRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'read'>): NotificationRecord {
    const newNotif: NotificationRecord = {
      id: `notif-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      ...notif,
      read: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.cache!.notifications.unshift(newNotif);
    if (this.cache!.notifications.length > 2000) {
      this.cache!.notifications = this.cache!.notifications.slice(0, 2000);
    }
    this.save();
    return newNotif;
  }

  markNotificationRead(id: string): void {
    const notif = this.cache!.notifications.find(n => n.id === id);
    if (notif) {
      notif.read = true;
      this.save();
    }
  }

  markAllNotificationsRead(userId: string): void {
    let modified = false;
    this.cache!.notifications.forEach(n => {
      if (n.userId === userId && !n.read) {
        n.read = true;
        modified = true;
      }
    });
    if (modified) this.save();
  }

  // ── CALL LOGS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getCallLogs(userId: string): CallLogRecord[] {
    if (!this.cache) return [];
    return this.cache.callLogs
      .filter(c => c.callerId === userId || c.receiverId === userId)
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
  }

  addCallLog(log: Omit<CallLogRecord, 'id' | 'timestamp'>): CallLogRecord {
    const newLog: CallLogRecord = {
      id: `call-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      ...log,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    this.cache!.callLogs.unshift(newLog);
    if (this.cache!.callLogs.length > 500) {
      this.cache!.callLogs = this.cache!.callLogs.slice(0, 500);
    }
    this.save();
    return newLog;
  }

  // ── STATS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getStats() {
    const users = this.cache?.users || [];
    const crops = this.cache?.crops || [];
    const supplierProducts = this.cache?.supplierProducts || [];
    const orders = this.cache?.orders || [];
    const reviews = this.cache?.reviews || [];

    const deliveredOrders = orders.filter(o => o.status === 'Delivered');
    const totalVolumeBDT = deliveredOrders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.totalBDT || 0), 0);

    return {
      farmersCount: users.filter(u => u.role === 'farmer').length,
      suppliersCount: users.filter(u => u.role === 'supplier').length,
      consumersCount: users.filter(u => u.role === 'customer').length,
      wholesalersCount: users.filter(u => u.role === 'businessman').length,
      expertsCount: users.filter(u => u.role === 'expert').length,
      totalRegisteredUsers: users.length,
      activeCropsCount: crops.filter(c => c.status !== 'Sold').length,
      supplierProductsCount: supplierProducts.filter(p => p.inStock).length,
      organicProductsCount: supplierProducts.filter(p => p.organicCertified && p.inStock).length,
      totalOrdersCount: orders.length,
      deliveredOrdersCount: deliveredOrders.length,
      totalVolumeBDT,
      verifiedReviewsCount: reviews.length,
      averageRating: reviews.length > 0 ? (reviews.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1) : null,
    };
  }
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Language, User } from '../types';
import { AuthStore } from '../data/store';
import { ShieldCheck, Mail, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, X, AlertTriangle, KeyRound } from 'lucide-react';

interface AdminVerificationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (adminUser: User) => void;
  language: Language;
}

export const AdminVerificationModal: React.FC<AdminVerificationModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  language,
}) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  const handleVerify = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!email.trim()) {
      setError(t('Please enter administrator email address', 'দয়া করে অ্যাডমিন ইমেইল ঠিকানা দিন'));
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setError(t('Please enter administrator password', 'দয়া করে অ্যাডমিন পাসওয়ার্ড দিন'));
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const result = AuthStore.verifyAdminCredentials(email, password);
      setLoading(false);

      if (result.success && result.user) {
        onSuccess(result.user);
        onClose();
        setEmail('');
        setPassword('');
        setError('');
      } else {
        setError(
          result.message ||
            t(
              'Invalid administrator email or password. Access denied.',
              'ভুল অ্যাডমিন ইমেইল বা পাসওয়ার্ড। প্রবেশাধিকার প্রত্যাখ্যাত।'
            )
        );
      }
    }, 400);
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="admin-verify-title"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fade-in"
    >
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-stone-200 space-y-4">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-stone-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 id="admin-verify-title" className="font-extrabold text-stone-900 text-sm">
                {t('Admin Authentication Required', 'অ্যাডমিন নিরাপত্তা যাচাইকরণ')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 font-medium">
                {t('Verify credentials to access admin section', 'অ্যাডমিন সেকশনে প্রবেশের জন্য অনুমোদিত তথ্য দিন')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={t('Close', 'বন্ধ করুন')}
            className="w-7 h-7 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-100 text-stone-400"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-red-700 flex items-center gap-2 animate-slide-up">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleVerify} className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold text-stone-700 mb-1">
              {t('Admin ID / Email', 'অ্যাডমিন আইডি / ইমেইল')}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="admin@nativebazar.gov.bd"
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                autoFocus
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block font-semibold text-stone-700 mb-1">
              {t('Admin Password', 'অ্যাডমিন পাসওয়ার্ড')}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="••••••••••••"
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-9 py-2 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                required
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600"
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-1/3 py-2.5 bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700 font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors"
            >
              {t('Cancel', 'বাতিল')}
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-2/3 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{loading ? t('Verifying...', 'যাচাই হচ্ছে...') : t('Verify & Enter Admin', 'যাচাই ও প্রবেশ করুন')}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  const [regPassword, setRegPassword] = useState('');
  const [regConfirmPassword, setRegConfirmPassword] = useState('');

  // Farmer specific: one-click crop selection
  const [selectedCrops, setSelectedCrops] = useState<string[]>(['Potato', 'Tomato']);
  const [farmSize, setFarmSize] = useState('3');

  // Wholesaler specific
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState('');
  const [businessType, setBusinessType] = useState('Wholesaler');

  // Retailer specific
  const [shopName, setShopName] = useState('');
  const [tradeAddress, setTradeAddress] = useState('');

  // Consumer specific
  const [deliveryAddress, setDeliveryAddress] = useState('');

  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // Countdown timer for lockout
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lockoutSeconds > 0) {
      const lockTimer = setInterval(() => {
        setLockoutSeconds((prev) => {
          if (prev <= 1) {
            setIsLocked(false);
            return 0;
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
      return () => clearInterval(lockTimer);
    }
  }, [lockoutSeconds]);

  // Upazilas based on chosen district
  const selectedLocation = BANGLADESH_LOCATIONS.find(
    (l) => l.district.toLowerCase() === regDistrict.toLowerCase()
  );
  const upazilaList = selectedLocation ? selectedLocation.upazilas : ['Sadar', 'Shibganj', 'Sherpur'];

  const toggleCrop = (cropId: string) => {
    if (selectedCrops.includes(cropId)) {
      setSelectedCrops(selectedCrops.filter((c) => c !== cropId));
    } else {
      setSelectedCrops([...selectedCrops, cropId]);
    }
  };

  // Handle Standard Login
  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // 1. Try persistent backend API
      try {
        const res = await authApi.login({
          identifier: loginIdentifier.trim(),
          password: loginPassword,
          role: selectedRole,
        });
        if (res && res.success && res.user) {
          AuthStore.setCurrentUser(res.user);
          setLoading(false);
          onAuthSuccess(res.user);
          return;
        }
      } catch (backendErr: any) {
        // If backend returns an explicit credential error, display it
        if (backendErr.message && !backendErr.message.includes('fetch')) {
          setError(backendErr.message);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
      }

      // 2. Fallback to client-side store verification
      const localResult: LoginResult = AuthStore.login(
        loginIdentifier.trim(),
        loginPassword,
        undefined,
        selectedRole
      );

      setLoading(false);
      if (localResult.locked) {
        setIsLocked(true);
        setLockoutSeconds(localResult.remainingSeconds || 180);
        setError(
          language === 'bn'
            ? `αªÅαªòαª╛αªºαª┐αªò αª¡αºüαª▓ αªÜαºçαª╖αºìαªƒαª╛αª░ αªòαª╛αª░αªúαºç αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªòαª╛αªëαª¿αºìαªƒ αª╕αª╛αª«αºƒαª┐αªòαª¡αª╛αª¼αºç αª▓αªò αªòαª░αª╛ αª╣αºƒαºçαª¢αºçαÑñ ${localResult.remainingSeconds} αª╕αºçαªòαºçαª¿αºìαªí αª¬αª░ αªÜαºçαª╖αºìαªƒαª╛ αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ`
            : `Account locked due to 3 failed attempts. Please retry in ${localResult.remainingSeconds}s.`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (!localResult.success || !localResult.user) {
        setError(
          language === 'bn'
            ? 'αª«αºïαª¼αª╛αªçαª▓ αª¿αª«αºìαª¼αª░ αªàαªÑαª¼αª╛ αª¬αª╛αª╕αªôαª»αª╝αª╛αª░αºìαªí αª╕αªáαª┐αªò αª¿αª»αª╝αÑñ αªªαª»αª╝αª╛ αªòαª░αºç αªåαª¼αª╛αª░ αªÜαºçαª╖αºìαªƒαª╛ αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ'
            : 'Incorrect credentials. Please verify your phone number and password.'
        );
        return;
      }

      onAuthSuccess(localResult.user);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLoading(false);
      setError(err.message || 'Login failed.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Admin Login (Restricted to Authorized Administrators only)
  const handleAdminLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await authApi.adminLogin({
        username: adminUsername.trim(),
        password: adminPassword,
        securityPin: adminPin.trim(),
      });

      setLoading(false);
      if (res && res.success && res.user) {
        AuthStore.setCurrentUser(res.user);
        onAuthSuccess(res.user);
      } else {
        setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿ αªÅαªòαºìαª╕αºçαª╕ αª¬αºìαª░αªñαºìαª»αª╛αªûαºìαª»αª╛αªñαÑñ' : 'Admin Access Denied.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLoading(false);
      setError(err.message || (language === 'bn' ? 'αªàαª¿αºüαª«αºïαªªαª┐αªñ αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿ αªñαªÑαºìαª» αª╕αªáαª┐αªò αª¿αºƒαÑñ' : 'Invalid admin authorization credentials.'));
    }
  };

  // Handle Registration
  const handleRegister = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!regName.trim()) {
      setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αªåαª¬αª¿αª╛αª░ αª¬αºéαª░αºìαªú αª¿αª╛αª« αª▓αª┐αªûαºüαª¿αÑñ' : 'Please enter your full name.');
      return;
    }
    if (!regPhone.trim() || regPhone.length < 9) {
      setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αª╕αªáαª┐αªò αººαºº αª╕αªéαªûαºìαª»αª╛αª░ αª«αºïαª¼αª╛αªçαª▓ αª¿αª«αºìαª¼αª░ αªªαª┐αª¿αÑñ' : 'Please enter a valid mobile number.');
      return;
    }
    if (regPassword.length < 6) {
      setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αª¬αª╛αª╕αªôαª»αª╝αª╛αª░αºìαªí αªòαª«αª¬αªòαºìαª╖αºç αº¼ αªàαªòαºìαª╖αª░αºçαª░ αª╣αªñαºç αª╣αª¼αºçαÑñ' : 'Password must be at least 6 characters.');
      return;
    }
    if (regPassword !== regConfirmPassword) {
      setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αªëαª¡αª»αª╝ αª¬αª╛αª╕αªôαª»αª╝αª╛αª░αºìαªí αªÅαªòαªç αª╣αªñαºç αª╣αª¼αºçαÑñ' : 'Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    if (selectedRole === 'farmer' && selectedCrops.length === 0) {
      setError(language === 'bn' ? 'αªòαª«αª¬αªòαºìαª╖αºç αªÅαªòαªƒαª┐ αª¬αºìαª░αªºαª╛αª¿ αª½αª╕αª▓ αª¿αª┐αª░αºìαª¼αª╛αªÜαª¿ αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ' : 'Please select at least one primary crop.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    const payload = {
      role: selectedRole,
      name: regName.trim(),
      phone: regPhone.trim(),
      email: regEmail.trim(),
      district: regDistrict,
      upazila: regUpazila,
      password: regPassword,
      farmSizeAcres: selectedRole === 'farmer' ? Number(farmSize) : undefined,
      primaryCrops: selectedRole === 'farmer' ? selectedCrops : undefined,
      businessName: selectedRole === 'wholesaler' ? (businessName.trim() || `${regName}'s Wholesale Arat`) : undefined,
      businessType: selectedRole === 'wholesaler' ? businessType : undefined,
      shopName: selectedRole === 'retailer' ? (shopName.trim() || `${regName}'s Agro Shop`) : undefined,
      tradeAddress: selectedRole === 'retailer' ? tradeAddress.trim() : undefined,
      deliveryAddress: selectedRole === 'consumer' ? deliveryAddress.trim() : undefined,
    };

    try {
      // 1. Try persistent backend API
      try {
        const res = await authApi.register(payload);
        if (res && res.success && res.user) {
          AuthStore.setCurrentUser(res.user);
          setLoading(false);
          onAuthSuccess(res.user);
          return;
        }
      } catch (backendErr: any) {
        if (backendErr.message && !backendErr.message.includes('fetch')) {
          setError(backendErr.message);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
      }

      // 2. Client store fallback
      const newUser = AuthStore.register(payload as any);
      setLoading(false);
      onAuthSuccess(newUser);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLoading(false);
      setError(err.message || 'Registration failed.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-stone-100 flex flex-col justify-center py-10 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 font-sans">
      {/* Top Bar with Back and Language switch */}
      <div className="max-w-xl w-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        {onBack ? (
          <button
            onClick={onBack}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 hover:text-emerald-700 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('Back to Marketplace', 'αª«αª╛αª░αºìαªòαºçαªƒαª¬αºìαª▓αºçαª╕αºç αª½αª┐αª░αºüαª¿')}</span>
          </button>

        <button
          onClick={onLanguageToggle}
          className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
        >
          {language === 'bn' ? 'English' : 'αª¼αª╛αªéαª▓αª╛'}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-xl w-full mx-auto bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-xl border border-stone-200 overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header Ribbon */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-800 via-emerald-900 to-stone-900 px-6 py-6 text-white text-center relative">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/20 mb-3 shadow-inner">
            <Sprout className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-300" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">
            NativeBazar ΓÇó {t('Agricultural Platform', 'αª¿αºçαªƒαª┐αª¡αª¼αª╛αª£αª╛αª░ αªòαºâαª╖αª┐ αª¬αºìαª▓αºìαª»αª╛αªƒαª½αª░αºìαª«')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-emerald-100/80 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
            {t(
              'Secure agricultural supply chain connecting Farmers, Wholesalers, Retailers & Consumers.',
              'αªòαºâαª╖αªò, αª¬αª╛αªçαªòαª╛αª░, αªûαºüαªÜαª░αª╛ αª¼αª┐αªòαºìαª░αºçαªñαª╛ αªô αª¡αºïαªòαºìαªñαª╛αªªαºçαª░ αª╕αª░αª╛αª╕αª░αª┐ αª¿αª┐αª░αª╛αª¬αªª αªòαºâαª╖αª┐ αª¼αª╛αª£αª╛αª░αÑñ'
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Admin Portal Toggle View */}
        {isAdminMode ? (
          <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-stone-200 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-800" />
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-stone-900">
                  {t('Authorized Administrator Access', 'αªàαª¿αºüαª«αºïαªªαª┐αªñ αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿ αª¬αºïαª░αºìαªƒαª╛αª▓')}
                </h2>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => { setIsAdminMode(false); setError(''); }}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 hover:underline"
              >
                {t('Return to Public Login', 'αª╕αª╛αªºαª╛αª░αªú αª▓αªùαªçαª¿αºç αª½αª┐αª░αºüαª¿')}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-700">
              {t(
                'This section is strictly restricted to certified platform administrators. Unauthorized access attempts are monitored and logged.',
                'αªÅαªç αª╕αºçαªòαª╢αª¿αªƒαª┐ αª╢αºüαªºαºüαª«αª╛αªñαºìαª░ αª¬αºìαª▓αºìαª»αª╛αªƒαª½αª░αºìαª« αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿αª┐αª╕αºìαªƒαºìαª░αºçαªƒαª░αªªαºçαª░ αª£αª¿αºìαª» αª╕αªéαª░αªòαºìαª╖αª┐αªñαÑñ αªàαª¿αª¿αºüαª«αºïαªªαª┐αªñ αª¬αºìαª░αªÜαºçαª╖αºìαªƒαª╛ αª¿αª┐αª░αºÇαªòαºìαª╖αª┐αªñ αª╣αºƒαÑñ'
              )}
            </div>

            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold">
                ΓÜá∩╕Å {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleAdminLogin} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 mb-1">
                  {t('Admin ID / Username', 'αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿ αªåαªçαªíαª┐')}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={adminUsername}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdminUsername(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="NativeBazarAdmin"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-xl border border-stone-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 mb-1">
                  {t('Secret Password', 'αªùαºïαª¬αª¿ αª¬αª╛αª╕αªôαºƒαª╛αª░αºìαªí')}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  required
                  value={adminPassword}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdminPassword(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="ΓÇóΓÇóΓÇóΓÇóΓÇóΓÇóΓÇóΓÇó"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-xl border border-stone-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-700 mb-1">
                  {t('Clearance 2FA Security PIN', 'αª╕αª┐αªòαª┐αªëαª░αª┐αªƒαª┐ αª¬αª┐αª¿')}
                </label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={adminPin}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdminPin(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="883650"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-xl border border-stone-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full py-3 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>{loading ? t('Authenticating...', 'αª»αª╛αªÜαª╛αªç αªòαª░αª╛ αª╣αªÜαºìαª¢αºç...') : t('Verify Admin Clearance', 'αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªíαª«αª┐αª¿ αª»αª╛αªÜαª╛αªç αªô αª¬αºìαª░αª¼αºçαª╢')}</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6">
            {/* Mode Selector: Login vs Register */}
            <div className="flex bg-stone-100 p-1 rounded-2xl">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setMode('login'); setError(''); }}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all ${
                  mode === 'login'
                    ? 'bg-white text-stone-900 shadow-xs'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-900'
                }`}
              >
                {t('Sign In (Existing Account)', 'αª▓αªùαªçαª¿ αªòαª░αºüαª¿')}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setMode('register'); setError(''); }}
                className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all ${
                  mode === 'register'
                    ? 'bg-white text-stone-900 shadow-xs'
                    : 'text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-900'
                }`}
              >
                {t('Create New Account', 'αª¿αªñαºüαª¿ αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªòαª╛αªëαª¿αºìαªƒ αªûαºüαª▓αºüαª¿')}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Exactly 4 Public Roles Selector */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-stone-600 mb-2">
                {t('Select Your Role in Supply Chain:', 'αªåαª¬αª¿αª╛αª░ αª¡αºéαª«αª┐αªòαª╛ αª¿αª┐αª░αºìαª¼αª╛αªÜαª¿ αªòαª░αºüαª¿:')}
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">

                  { id: 'farmer', en: 'Farmer', bn: 'αªòαºâαª╖αªò', icon: <Sprout className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'emerald' },
                  { id: 'wholesaler', en: 'Wholesaler', bn: 'αª¬αª╛αªçαªòαª╛αª░', icon: <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'blue' },
                  { id: 'retailer', en: 'Retailer', bn: 'αªûαºüαªÜαª░αª╛ αª¼αª┐αªòαºìαª░αºçαªñαª╛', icon: <Store className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'amber' },
                  { id: 'consumer', en: 'Consumer', bn: 'αª¡αºïαªòαºìαªñαª╛', icon: <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'purple' },

            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>ΓÜá∩╕Å</span>
                <span>{error}</span>
              </div>

            {mode === 'login' ? (

                      className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2.5 text-sm rounded-xl border border-stone-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium"
                    />
                    <button

import { ActiveView, Language, UserRole } from '../types';
import { ChevronRight, ArrowLeft, Home } from 'lucide-react';

interface BreadcrumbsProps {
  activeView: ActiveView;
  subTab?: string;
  role: UserRole;
  language: Language;
  onNavigate: (view: ActiveView, tab?: string) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  canGoBack: boolean;
}

const VIEW_TITLES: Record<ActiveView, { en: string; bn: string }> = {
  dashboard: { en: 'Dashboard', bn: 'ড্যাশবোর্ড' },
  market_rates: { en: 'Market Rates', bn: 'বাজার দর' },

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { User, Language, UserRole } from '../types';
import { CallStore } from '../data/store';
import {
  Phone,
  PhoneOff,
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  ShieldCheck,
  ExternalLink,
  Sprout,
  Briefcase,
  Store,
  ShoppingCart,
  Microscope,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface CallModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentUser: User;
  contactUser: User;
  language: Language;
}

const ROLE_ICONS: Record<UserRole, React.ReactNode> = {
  farmer: <Sprout className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  wholesaler: <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  retailer: <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  consumer: <ShoppingCart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  businessman: <Briefcase className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  supplier: <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  customer: <ShoppingCart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  expert: <Microscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
  admin: <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />,
};

const ROLE_NAMES: Record<UserRole, { en: string; bn: string }> = {
  farmer: { en: 'Farmer', bn: 'কৃষক' },
  wholesaler: { en: 'Wholesaler', bn: 'পাইকার' },
  retailer: { en: 'Retailer', bn: 'খুচরা বিক্রেতা' },
  consumer: { en: 'Consumer', bn: 'ভোক্তা' },
  businessman: { en: 'Trader / Buyer', bn: 'ব্যবসায়ী' },
  supplier: { en: 'Agri Supplier', bn: 'সরবরাহকারী' },
  customer: { en: 'Consumer', bn: 'ভোক্তা' },
  expert: { en: 'Agri Expert', bn: 'কৃষি বিশেষজ্ঞ' },
  admin: { en: 'Platform Admin', bn: 'অ্যাডমিন' },
};

export const CallModal: React.FC<CallModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentUser,
  contactUser,
  language,
}) => {
  const [callStatus, setCallStatus] = useState<'ringing' | 'connected' | 'ended'>('ringing');
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [isSpeaker, setIsSpeaker] = useState(true);

  // Auto-connect after 2.5s for realistic simulation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      setCallStatus('ringing');
      setSeconds(0);
      return;
    }

    setCallStatus('ringing');
    setSeconds(0);

    const connectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCallStatus('connected');
    }, 2400);

    return () => clearTimeout(connectTimer);
  }, [isOpen, contactUser.id]);

  // Call timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (callStatus !== 'connected') return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [callStatus]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  const formatTimer = (sec: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = sec % 60;
    return `${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const handleEndCall = () => {
    setCallStatus('ended');
    CallStore.add({
      callerId: currentUser.id,
      callerName: currentUser.name,
      callerRole: currentUser.role,
      receiverId: contactUser.id,
      receiverName: contactUser.name,
      receiverRole: contactUser.role,
      receiverPhone: contactUser.phone,
      status: seconds > 0 ? 'completed' : 'cancelled',
      durationSeconds: seconds,
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
      setCallStatus('ringing');
      setSeconds(0);
    }, 500);
  };

  const cleanPhone = contactUser.phone.replace(/\D/g, '');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-b from-stone-900 via-stone-850 to-stone-900 border border-stone-700/80 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden text-white flex flex-col items-center p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 relative">
        {/* Subtle glowing animated background pulse */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-56 h-56 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -right-24 w-56 h-56 bg-teal-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Top Header info */}
        <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-stone-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
            {t('Encrypted Agri-VoIP', 'সুরক্ষিত এগ্রি-ভয়েস কল')}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px] bg-stone-800/80 border border-stone-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-stone-300">
            HD Voice 48kHz
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Contact Avatar with pulsing ripple rings */}
        <div className="relative my-2 flex items-center justify-center">
          {callStatus === 'ringing' && (
            <>
              <div className="absolute w-28 h-28 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30 animate-ping pointer-events-none" />
              <div className="absolute w-36 h-36 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 animate-pulse pointer-events-none" />
            </>
          )}

          <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-emerald-700 to-teal-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-3xl font-extrabold shadow-xl border-4 border-stone-800">
            {contactUser.name.charAt(0)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Contact Details */}
        <div className="text-center space-y-1">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            {contactUser.name}
          </h2>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400">
            {ROLE_ICONS[contactUser.role]}
            <span>{t(ROLE_NAMES[contactUser.role].en, ROLE_NAMES[contactUser.role].bn)}</span>
            <span className="text-stone-500">•</span>
            <span className="text-stone-300">{contactUser.district}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 font-mono tracking-wider pt-0.5">
            {contactUser.phone}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Call Status & Timer */}
        <div className="text-center py-1">
          {callStatus === 'ringing' ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-stone-400 text-sm font-medium animate-pulse">
              <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 animate-bounce" />
              <span>{t('Ringing… Connecting to user', 'ডায়াল করা হচ্ছে… সংযোগ চলছে')}</span>
            </div>
          ) : callStatus === 'connected' ? (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span>{t('Call Connected', 'সংযোগ স্থাপিত')}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-mono font-black text-white tracking-widest">
                {formatTimer(seconds)}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-red-400 text-xs font-bold">{t('Call Ended', 'কল সমাপ্ত')}</span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Controls row */}
        <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-6 pt-2">
          {/* Mute */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsMuted((v) => !v)}
            className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
              isMuted
                ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/30'
                : 'bg-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-700 text-stone-300 border border-stone-700'
            }`}
            title={isMuted ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}
          >
            {isMuted ? <MicOff className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Mic className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </button>

          {/* End Call (Red Button) */}
          <button
            onClick={handleEndCall}
            className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl shadow-red-600/40 transition-transform active:scale-95"
            title="End Call"
          >
            <PhoneOff className="w-7 h-7" />
          </button>

          {/* Speaker */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsSpeaker((v) => !v)}
            className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
              isSpeaker
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30'
                : 'bg-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-700 text-stone-300 border border-stone-700'
            }`}
            title={isSpeaker ? 'Speaker On' : 'Speaker Off'}
          >
            {isSpeaker ? <Volume2 className="w-5 h-5" /> : <VolumeX className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Fallback Direct SIM Call button */}
        <div className="w-full pt-3 border-t border-stone-800 text-center">

            href={`tel:${cleanPhone}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 hover:underline font-semibold"

            <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

            <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5 opacity-70" />

  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface ContactsViewProps {
  currentUser: User;
  language: Language;
  onViewUser: (user: User) => void;
  onInitiateCall: (contact: User) => void;
  initialChatUserId?: string | null;
}
