export const ContactsView: React.FC<ContactsViewProps> = ({
  currentUser,
  language,
  onViewUser,
  onInitiateCall,
  initialChatUserId,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'directory' | 'chat' | 'connections' | 'calls'>(
    initialChatUserId ? 'chat' : 'directory'
  );

  // ── Directory state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [appliedSearch, setAppliedSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedRoleFilter, setSelectedRoleFilter] = useState<UserRole | 'all'>('all');
  const [selectedDistrictFilter, setSelectedDistrictFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [directoryUsers, setDirectoryUsers] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [directoryLoading, setDirectoryLoading] = useState(false);
  const [directoryError, setDirectoryError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [directoryTotal, setDirectoryTotal] = useState(0);

  // ── Local fallback: connections & call logs (localStorage) ──────────
  const [connections, setConnections] = useState<UserConnection[]>([]);
  const [callLogs, setCallLogs] = useState<CallLog[]>([]);

  // ── Chat / Inbox state ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [activeChatUser, setActiveChatUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<DirectMessage[]>([]);
  const [chatPartners, setChatPartners] = useState<User[]>([]);
  const [messageInput, setMessageInput] = useState('');
  const [sendingMessage, setSendingMessage] = useState(false);
  const [sendError, setSendError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chatLoading, setChatLoading] = useState(false);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // ── SSE real-time connection ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const sseRef = useRef<EventSource | null>(null);
  const activeChatUserRef = useRef<User | null>(null);
  activeChatUserRef.current = activeChatUser;

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // ── Load directory from backend ──────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchDirectory = useCallback(async (search?: string) => {
    setDirectoryLoading(true);
    setDirectoryError(null);
    try {
      const result = await apiService.getUsers({
        excludeId: currentUser.id,
        role: selectedRoleFilter !== 'all' ? selectedRoleFilter : undefined,
        district: selectedDistrictFilter !== 'all' ? selectedDistrictFilter : undefined,
        search: search ?? appliedSearch,
      });
      if (result.success) {
        setDirectoryUsers(result.users);
        setDirectoryTotal(result.total);
      } else {
        setDirectoryError(t('Failed to load users. Check network.', 'ব্যবহারকারী লোড করতে ব্যর্থ। নেটওয়ার্ক পরীক্ষা করুন।'));
      }
    } catch {
      setDirectoryError(t('Network error loading directory.', 'ডিরেক্টরি লোড করতে নেটওয়ার্ক ত্রুটি।'));
    } finally {
      setDirectoryLoading(false);
    }
  }, [currentUser.id, selectedRoleFilter, selectedDistrictFilter, appliedSearch]);

  // Re-fetch on filter change
  useEffect(() => { fetchDirectory(appliedSearch); }, [selectedRoleFilter, selectedDistrictFilter]);

  // ── Local store data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const refreshLocalData = useCallback(() => {
    setConnections(ConnectionStore.getByUser(currentUser.id));
    setCallLogs(CallStore.getByUser(currentUser.id));
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  // ── Chat partners from localStorage + backend ─────────────────────────
  const fetchChatPartners = useCallback(async () => {
    const localAll = MessageStore.getAll();
    const partnerIds = new Set<string>();
    localAll.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.senderId === currentUser.id) partnerIds.add(m.recipientId);
      if (m.recipientId === currentUser.id) partnerIds.add(m.senderId);
    });
    if (partnerIds.size > 0) {
      const partners: User[] = [];
      for (const pid of partnerIds) {
        const found = directoryUsers.find((u) => u.id === pid);
        if (found) { partners.push(found); continue; }
        // Fetch from backend if not in directory
        const res = await apiService.getUsers({});
        if (res.success) { const bu = res.users.find((u) => u.id === pid); if (bu) partners.push(bu); }
      }
      setChatPartners(partners);
    }
  }, [currentUser.id, directoryUsers]);

  // ── Load conversation from backend ────────────────────────────────────
  const loadConversation = useCallback(async (otherUser: User) => {
    setChatLoading(true);
    try {
      const msgs = await apiService.getMessages(currentUser.id, otherUser.id);
      setChatMessages(msgs);
      await apiService.markMessagesRead(currentUser.id, otherUser.id);
    } catch {
      setChatMessages(MessageStore.getConversation(currentUser.id, otherUser.id));
    } finally {
      setChatLoading(false);
    }
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  // ── SSE: real-time message delivery ──────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser.id) return;
    if (sseRef.current) sseRef.current.close();
    const es = new EventSource(`/api/realtime?userId=${encodeURIComponent(currentUser.id)}`);
    sseRef.current = es;

    es.addEventListener('new_message', (e: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const { message } = JSON.parse(e.data) as { message: DirectMessage };
        if (activeChatUserRef.current &&
          (message.senderId === activeChatUserRef.current.id || message.recipientId === activeChatUserRef.current.id)) {
          setChatMessages((prev) => prev.some((m) => m.id === message.id) ? prev : [...prev, message]);
          apiService.markMessagesRead(currentUser.id, activeChatUserRef.current.id).catch(() => {});
        }
        fetchChatPartners();
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    });

    es.addEventListener('message_sent', (e: MessageEvent) => {
      try {
        const { message } = JSON.parse(e.data) as { message: DirectMessage };
        setChatMessages((prev) => prev.some((m) => m.id === message.id) ? prev : [...prev, message]);
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
    });

    es.onerror = () => {};
    return () => { es.close(); sseRef.current = null; };
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  // ── Initial load ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => { fetchDirectory(''); refreshLocalData(); }, [currentUser.id]);
  useEffect(() => { fetchChatPartners(); }, [directoryUsers]);

  // Handle initial chat user from props
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialChatUserId) {
      const target = directoryUsers.find((u) => u.id === initialChatUserId);
      if (target) { setActiveChatUser(target); setActiveTab('chat'); loadConversation(target); }
    }
  }, [initialChatUserId, directoryUsers]);

  useEffect(() => { messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }, [chatMessages]);

  // ── Search handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSearch = () => { setAppliedSearch(searchInput); fetchDirectory(searchInput); };
  const handleSearchKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSearch(); };
  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setSearchInput(''); setAppliedSearch('');
    setSelectedRoleFilter('all'); setSelectedDistrictFilter('all');
    fetchDirectory('');
  };

  // ── Chat handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSelectChat = (contact: User) => {
    setActiveChatUser(contact); setActiveTab('chat'); setSendError(null); loadConversation(contact);
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!activeChatUser || !messageInput.trim() || sendingMessage) return;
    const content = messageInput.trim();
    setMessageInput(''); setSendingMessage(true); setSendError(null);
    try {
      const result = await apiService.sendMessage({
        senderId: currentUser.id, senderName: currentUser.name, senderRole: currentUser.role,
        recipientId: activeChatUser.id, recipientName: activeChatUser.name, recipientRole: activeChatUser.role,
        content,
      });
      if (result.success && result.message) {
        setChatMessages((prev) => prev.some((m) => m.id === result.message!.id) ? prev : [...prev, result.message!]);
        MessageStore.sendMessage({ senderId: currentUser.id, senderName: currentUser.name, senderRole: currentUser.role,
          recipientId: activeChatUser.id, recipientName: activeChatUser.name, recipientRole: activeChatUser.role, content });
        fetchChatPartners();
      } else {
        setSendError(result.error || t('Message failed. Try again.', 'বার্তা পাঠানো ব্যর্থ। পুনরায় চেষ্টা করুন।'));
        setMessageInput(content);
      }
    } catch {
      setSendError(t('Network error. Not sent.', 'নেটওয়ার্ক ত্রুটি। বার্তা পাঠানো হয়নি।'));
      setMessageInput(content);
    } finally { setSendingMessage(false); }
  };

  const handleSendQuickMessage = async (text: string) => {
    if (!activeChatUser || sendingMessage) return;
    setSendingMessage(true);
    try {
      const result = await apiService.sendMessage({
        senderId: currentUser.id, senderName: currentUser.name, senderRole: currentUser.role,
        recipientId: activeChatUser.id, recipientName: activeChatUser.name, recipientRole: activeChatUser.role,
        content: text,
      });
      if (result.success && result.message)
        setChatMessages((prev) => prev.some((m) => m.id === result.message!.id) ? prev : [...prev, result.message!]);
    } catch { /* ignore */ } finally { setSendingMessage(false); }
  };

  // ── Connection handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleConnectToggle = async (targetUser: User) => {
    const status = ConnectionStore.getStatus(currentUser.id, targetUser.id);
    if (status === 'none') {
      const conn = await apiService.sendConnectionRequest(currentUser.id, targetUser.id);
      if (!conn.success) ConnectionStore.sendRequest(currentUser, targetUser);
    } else {
      const allConns = ConnectionStore.getAll();
      const existing = allConns.find((c) =>
        (c.requesterId === currentUser.id && c.recipientId === targetUser.id) ||
        (c.requesterId === targetUser.id && c.recipientId === currentUser.id)
      );
      if (existing) { await apiService.deleteConnection(existing.id).catch(() => {}); ConnectionStore.remove(currentUser.id, targetUser.id); }
    }
    refreshLocalData();
  };

  const handleAcceptConnection = async (connId: string) => {
    await apiService.updateConnectionStatus(connId, 'accepted').catch(() => {});
    ConnectionStore.accept(connId); refreshLocalData();
  };

  const handleRejectConnection = async (connId: string) => {
    await apiService.updateConnectionStatus(connId, 'rejected').catch(() => {});
    ConnectionStore.reject(connId); refreshLocalData();
  };

  const pendingIncomingRequests = connections.filter((c) => c.recipientId === currentUser.id && c.status === 'pending');
  const acceptedConnections = connections.filter((c) => c.status === 'accepted');
  const unreadCount = MessageStore.getUnreadCount(currentUser.id);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      {/* Top Banner / Header */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-900 via-teal-900 to-stone-900 text-white rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 max-w-3xl space-y-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold">
            <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{t('Cross-Role Agri Communication Hub', 'কৃষি ও ব্যবসায় আন্তঃযোগাযোগ কেন্দ্র')}</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight leading-snug">
            {t(
              'Connect, Message & Call Any Agricultural Stakeholder',
              'কৃষক, ব্যবসায়ী ও বিশেষজ্ঞদের সাথে সরাসরি সংযোগ, বার্তা ও কল'
            )}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-stone-300 text-xs md:text-sm leading-relaxed max-w-2xl">
            {t(
              'Interact securely with verified farmers, arat wholesalers, fertilizer suppliers, and agricultural extension officers across Bangladesh.',
              'সারাদেশের যাচাইকৃত কৃষক, পাইকারি আড়তদার, সার বিক্রেতা এবং কৃষি কর্মকর্তাদের সাথে ফোন বা সরাসরি চ্যাটের মাধ্যমে যোগাযোগ করুন।'
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Decorative background shapes */}
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 w-80 h-80 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
      </div>

      {/* Main Tabs Navigation */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-1.5 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('directory')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'directory'
                ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-900'
            }`}
          >
            <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('All Community & Directory', 'সকল ব্যবহারকারী ও ডিরেক্টরি')}</span>
            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
              activeTab === 'directory' ? 'bg-emerald-800 text-white' : 'bg-stone-200 text-stone-700'
            }`}>
              {directoryTotal}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('chat');
              if (!activeChatUser && chatPartners.length > 0) {
                handleSelectChat(chatPartners[0]);
              }
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'chat'
                ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-900'
            }`}
          >
            <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('Direct Chat & Messages', 'সরাসরি বার্তা ও চ্যাট')}</span>
            {unreadCount > 0 && (
              <span className="bg-red-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold min-w-[18px] text-center">
                {unreadCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('connections')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'connections'
                ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-900'
            }`}
          >
            <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('My Network & Connections', 'আমার নেটওয়ার্ক ও সংযোগ')}</span>
            {pendingIncomingRequests.length > 0 && (
              <span className="bg-amber-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold">
                {pendingIncomingRequests.length}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('calls')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'calls'
                ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-900'
            }`}
          >
            <PhoneCall className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('Call Logs', 'কল হিস্ট্রি')}</span>
            <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
              activeTab === 'calls' ? 'bg-emerald-800 text-white' : 'bg-stone-200 text-stone-700'
            }`}>
              {callLogs.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ─── TAB 1: DIRECTORY & ALL STAKEHOLDERS ───────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'directory' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Search & Filters Card */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-4 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3">
              {/* Search input with Bengali Search button */}
              <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 relative">
                  <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    id="directory-search-input"
                    type="text"
                    value={searchInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={handleSearchKeyDown}
                    placeholder={t(
                      'Search by name, phone, crop (Potato, Tomato), business or specialty…',
                      'নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর, ফসল (আলু, টমেটো), ব্যবসা দিয়ে খুঁজুন…'
                    )}
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-xs bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium text-stone-800 transition-all"
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  id="directory-search-btn"
                  onClick={handleSearch}
                  disabled={directoryLoading}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 disabled:opacity-60 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 shadow-xs"
                >
                  {directoryLoading ? (
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  <span>খুঁজুন</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* District Filter */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-500 shrink-0" />
                <select
                  value={selectedDistrictFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedDistrictFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-transparent font-semibold text-stone-700 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="all">{t('All Districts (সকল জেলা)', 'সকল জেলা')}</option>
                  {BANGLADESH_LOCATIONS.map((loc) => (
                    <option key={loc.district} value={loc.district}>
                      {loc.district} ({loc.districtBn})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Role Filter Pills */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pt-1 border-t border-stone-100">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-stone-400 uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 mr-1">
                {t('Role:', 'ভূমিকা:')}
              </span>
              {(['all', 'farmer', 'businessman', 'supplier', 'customer', 'expert'] as const).map((r) => {
                const isSelected = selectedRoleFilter === r;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={r}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedRoleFilter(r)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-stone-900 text-white shadow-2xs'
                        : 'bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700 border border-stone-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {r === 'all'
                      ? t('All Roles', 'সকল ভূমিকা')
                      : t(ROLE_META[r].labelEn, ROLE_META[r].labelBn)}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
              {/* Always-visible Reset Filter button */}
              <button
                id="reset-filters-btn"
                onClick={handleResetFilters}
                className="ml-auto px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-stone-100 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-700 text-stone-600 border border-stone-200 hover:border-red-200 transition-all whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>ফিল্টার রিসেট করুন</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Active search tag */}
            {appliedSearch && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-stone-600">
                <span className="font-medium">{t('Results for:', 'খোঁজার ফলাফল:')}</span>
                <span className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                  "{appliedSearch}"
                </span>
                <button onClick={handleResetFilters} className="text-stone-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Loading state */}
          {directoryLoading && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-12 text-center space-y-3">
              <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-600 mx-auto animate-spin" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-600">
                {t('Loading registered users…', 'নিবন্ধিত ব্যবহারকারীদের তালিকা লোড হচ্ছে…')}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error state */}
          {!directoryLoading && directoryError && (
            <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <AlertCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-red-400 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-700">{directoryError}</p>
              <button
                onClick={() => fetchDirectory(appliedSearch)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {t('Retry', 'পুনরায় চেষ্টা করুন')}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Empty state */}
          {!directoryLoading && !directoryError && directoryUsers.length === 0 && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-12 text-center space-y-3">
              <Users className="w-12 h-12 text-stone-300 mx-auto" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-stone-700 text-sm">
                {appliedSearch || selectedRoleFilter !== 'all' || selectedDistrictFilter !== 'all'
                  ? t('No stakeholders found matching your filters', 'আপনার ফিল্টারের সাথে কোনো ব্যবহারকারী পাওয়া যায়নি')
                  : t('No registered users found', 'কোনো নিবন্ধিত ব্যবহারকারী পাওয়া যায়নি')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                {t('Try a different search term, or reset the role and district filters.', 'অন্য শব্দ দিয়ে অনুসন্ধান করুন অথবা ফিল্টার পরিবর্তন করুন।')}
              </p>
              {(appliedSearch || selectedRoleFilter !== 'all' || selectedDistrictFilter !== 'all') && (
                <button
                  onClick={handleResetFilters}
                  className="mt-2 px-4 py-2 bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors"
                >
                  {t('Reset Filters', 'ফিল্টার রিসেট করুন')}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* User Cards Grid */}
          {!directoryLoading && !directoryError && directoryUsers.length > 0 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {directoryUsers.map((u) => {
                const meta = ROLE_META[u.role] || ROLE_META.farmer;
                const connStatus = ConnectionStore.getStatus(currentUser.id, u.id);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={u.id}
                    className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 p-5 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between group space-y-4"
                  >
                    <div>
                      {/* Top Row: Avatar & Badges */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-stone-800 to-stone-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold shadow-xs shrink-0">
                            {u.name.charAt(0)}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <h3 className="font-bold text-stone-900 text-sm group-hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors">
                                {u.name}
                              </h3>
                              {u.verified && (
                                <span title="Verified Member">
                                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 font-medium">
                              {u.nameBn || u.email || ''}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Role Badge */}
                        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border shrink-0 ${meta.badge}`}>
                          {meta.icon}
                          <span>{t(meta.labelEn, meta.labelBn)}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Location & Details */}
                      <div className="mt-3.5 pt-3 border-t border-stone-100 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-stone-600">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                          <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{(u as any).upazila ? `${(u as any).upazila}, ${u.district}` : u.district}</span>
                        </div>

                        {/* Role Extra Snippets */}
                        {u.role === 'farmer' && (u as any).primaryCrops && (
                          <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-700 font-medium">
                            🌱 {t('Crops:', 'ফসল:')} {(u as any).primaryCrops.join(', ')}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {u.role === 'businessman' && (u as any).businessName && (
                          <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-blue-700 font-medium truncate">
                            🏢 {(u as any).businessName}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {u.role === 'supplier' && (u as any).shopName && (
                          <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-amber-700 font-medium truncate">
                            🏪 {(u as any).shopName}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {u.role === 'expert' && (u as any).designation && (
                          <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-teal-700 font-medium truncate">
                            🔬 {(u as any).designation}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Action Buttons: Message, Call, Connect */}
                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-stone-100 space-y-2">
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        {/* Send Message Button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleSelectChat(u)}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors"
                        >
                          <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>{t('Message', 'বার্তা')}</span>
                        </button>

                        {/* Call Now Button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => onInitiateCall(u)}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-2xs"
                        >
                          <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                          <span>{t('Call Now', 'কল করুন')}</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Connection and Profile row */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 text-[11px]">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleConnectToggle(u)}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all ${
                            connStatus === 'accepted'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
                              : connStatus === 'pending_sent'
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200'
                              : 'bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700 border border-stone-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {connStatus === 'accepted' ? (
                            <>
                              <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                              <span>{t('Connected ✓', 'সংযুক্ত ✓')}</span>
                            </>
                          ) : connStatus === 'pending_sent' ? (
                            <>
                              <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                              <span>{t('Pending', 'অনুরোধাধীন')}</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <UserPlus className="w-3 h-3 text-stone-500" />
                              <span>{t('+ Connect', '+ যুক্ত হোন')}</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>

                        <button
                          onClick={() => onViewUser(u)}
                          className="text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800 hover:underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          <span>{t('View Profile', 'প্রোফাইল')}</span>
                          <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── TAB 2: DIRECT MESSAGING & CHAT ────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'chat' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 min-h-[580px]">
          {/* Chat Left Sidebar (Conversations List) */}
          <div className="md:col-span-4 border-r border-stone-200 flex flex-col bg-stone-50/50">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-stone-200 bg-white">
              <h2 className="font-extrabold text-stone-900 text-sm">
                {t('Conversations', 'কথোপকথন তালিকা')}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-0.5">
                {t('Direct encrypted peer messages', 'ব্যক্তিগত সরাসরি বার্তা')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-stone-100">
              {chatPartners.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-2">
                  <MessageSquare className="w-8 h-8 text-stone-300 mx-auto" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 font-medium">
                    {t('No ongoing conversations yet', 'এখনো কোনো বার্তা আদান-প্রদান হয়নি')}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400">
                    {t('Select any user from the Directory tab to begin chatting.', 'ডিরেক্টরি থেকে যেকোনো ব্যবহারকারী নির্বাচন করে বার্তা পাঠান।')}
                  </p>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('directory')}
                    className="mt-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg"
                  >
                    {t('Browse Directory', 'ডিরেক্টরি দেখুন')}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                chatPartners.map((partner) => {
                  const isSelected = activeChatUser?.id === partner.id;
                  const msgs = MessageStore.getConversation(currentUser.id, partner.id);
                  const lastMsg = msgs[msgs.length - 1];
                  const meta = ROLE_META[partner.role] || ROLE_META.farmer;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={partner.id}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectChat(partner)}
                      className={`p-3.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors flex items-center gap-3 ${
                        isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-50/80 border-l-4 border-emerald-600' : 'hover:bg-stone-100/70'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-stone-800 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shrink-0">
                        {partner.name.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-stone-900 truncate">
                            {partner.name}
                          </h4>
                          <span className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-bold ${meta.badge}`}>
                            {t(meta.labelEn, meta.labelBn)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {lastMsg && (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 truncate mt-0.5">
                            {lastMsg.senderId === currentUser.id ? 'You: ' : ''}
                            {lastMsg.content}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Chat Right Pane (Active Messages Thread) */}
          <div className="md:col-span-8 flex flex-col bg-white">
            {activeChatUser ? (
              <>
                {/* Active Chat Header */}
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-stone-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-stone-50/70">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                      {activeChatUser.name.charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-stone-900">
                          {activeChatUser.name}
                        </h3>
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" title="Online" />
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 font-medium">
                        {t(ROLE_META[activeChatUser.role].labelEn, ROLE_META[activeChatUser.role].labelBn)} • {activeChatUser.district}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions in Chat Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onInitiateCall(activeChatUser)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-2xs"
                      title={t('Voice Call Contact', 'সরাসরি কল করুন')}
                    >
                      <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{t('Voice Call', 'কল করুন')}</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => onViewUser(activeChatUser)}
                      className="p-1.5 text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-200 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                      title={t('View Full Profile', 'প্রোফাইল দেখুন')}
                    >
                      <UserIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Messages Body */}
                <div className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-3.5 bg-stone-50/40 max-h-[420px]">
                  {chatMessages.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="py-12 text-center space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 font-medium">
                        {t('Start a conversation with', 'কথোপকথন শুরু করুন')} {activeChatUser.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400">
                        {t('Ask about crop availability, price negotiation, or inputs.', 'ফসল, দরদাম বা সার-কীটনাশক সম্পর্কে কথা বলুন।')}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    chatMessages.map((m) => {
                      const isMe = m.senderId === currentUser.id;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={m.id}
                          className={`flex flex-col ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}
                        >
                          <div
                            className={`max-w-[78%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs shadow-2xs ${
                              isMe
                                ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-br-xs'
                                : 'bg-white text-stone-800 border border-stone-200 rounded-bl-xs'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <p className="leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{m.content}</p>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-stone-400 mt-1 px-1">
                            {new Date(m.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                  <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
                </div>

                {/* Quick Suggestion Chips */}
                {SUGGESTED_MESSAGES[activeChatUser.role] && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-stone-100/70 border-t border-stone-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-stone-400 uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0">
                      {t('Quick:', 'দ্রুত:')}
                    </span>
                    {SUGGESTED_MESSAGES[activeChatUser.role].map((s, idx) => (
                      <button
                        key={idx}
                        onClick={() => handleSendQuickMessage(language === 'bn' ? s.bn : s.en)}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white hover:bg-emerald-50 text-stone-700 hover:text-emerald-800 border border-stone-200 hover:border-emerald-300 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium transition-all shrink-0 shadow-2xs"
                      >
                        {t(s.en, s.bn)}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Input Bar */}
                <form
                  onSubmit={handleSendMessage}
                  className="p-3 border-t border-stone-200 bg-white flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={messageInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setMessageInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={t('Type a message or price offer…', 'বার্তা বা দরদাম লিখুন…')}
                    className="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 font-medium text-stone-800 transition-all"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={!messageInput.trim()}
                    className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 disabled:opacity-40 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-colors shrink-0"
                  >
                    <span>{t('Send', 'পাঠান')}</span>
                    <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </form>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center space-y-3">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-stone-100 flex items-center justify-center text-stone-400">
                  <MessageSquare className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-stone-800 text-sm">
                  {t('Select a contact to start messaging', 'বার্তা পাঠাতে একটি যোগাযোগ নির্বাচন করুন')}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 max-w-sm">
                  {t(

  isOpen,

  language,

}) => {

function getVerifiedPesticide(medicineStr: string): VerifiedPesticideInfo {
  const lower = (medicineStr || '').toLowerCase();
  for (const [key, info] of Object.entries(VERIFIED_PESTICIDES)) {
    if (lower.includes(key)) return info;
  }
  return VERIFIED_PESTICIDES.ridomil;
}

} from 'lucide-react';

interface CartItem {
  product: MarketplaceProduct;
  quantityKg: number;
}

interface CustomerMarketplaceProps {
  language: Language;
  currentUser?: User | null;
  onOpenAuth?: () => void;
}

const CATEGORIES = ['All', 'Vegetables', 'Tubers', 'Spices', 'Grains', 'Fruits'];
const DISTRICTS = ['All', 'Bogura', 'Dhaka', 'Rajshahi', 'Rangpur', 'Dinajpur'];

  language,
  currentUser,
  onOpenAuth,
}) => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filters & Search

  const [selectedDistrict, setSelectedDistrict] = useState('All');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // Cart & Drawer

    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('nb_guest_cart');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });

  const [showCheckoutModal, setShowCheckoutModal] = useState(false);
  const [submittingOrder, setSubmittingOrder] = useState(false);

  const [expandedTraceMap, setExpandedTraceMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(currentUser?.phone || '');

    currentUser?.address || (currentUser?.upazila ? `${currentUser.upazila}, ${currentUser.district}` : '')
  );

    orderId: string;
    totalBDT: number;

  } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {

      localStorage.setItem('nb_guest_cart', JSON.stringify(cart));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save cart to localStorage', e);
    }
  }, [cart]);

  // Load retail products (strictly targetRole=consumer & sellerRole=retailer)

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        targetRole: 'consumer',
        sellerRole: 'retailer',
        district: selectedDistrict !== 'All' ? selectedDistrict : undefined,
        category: selectedCategory !== 'All' ? selectedCategory : undefined,
        search: searchQuery.trim() || undefined,
      });
      setProducts(res.products || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load marketplace products', err);
      setError(
        language === 'bn'
          ? 'αª¬αªúαºìαª» αª▓αºïαªí αªòαª░αªñαºç αª¼αºìαª»αª░αºìαªÑ αª╣αª»αª╝αºçαª¢αºçαÑñ αª╕αºìαªÑαª╛αª¿αºÇαª»αª╝ αª╕αª╛αª░αºìαª¡αª╛αª░ αªÜαª╛αª▓αºü αªåαª¢αºç αªòαª┐αª¿αª╛ αª¬αª░αºÇαªòαºìαª╖αª╛ αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ'
          : 'Failed to load products. Checking local database...'

    setCart((prev) => {
      const existing = prev.find((item) => item.product.id === product.id);
      if (existing) {
        return prev.map((item) =>
          item.product.id === product.id
            ? { ...item, quantityKg: Math.min(item.quantityKg + 1, product.availableKg) }
            : item
        );
      }
      return [...prev, { product, quantityKg: Math.max(1, product.minOrderKg || 1) }];
    });

    setCart((prev) =>

          if (item.product.id === productId) {

            if (newQty <= 0) return null;
            return {
              ...item,
              quantityKg: Math.min(newQty, item.product.availableKg),
            };

  const grandTotalBDT = cartSubtotalBDT + deliveryFeeBDT;

  const toggleLike = (productId: string) => {
    setLikedMap((prev) => ({ ...prev, [productId]: !prev[productId] }));
  };

  // Toggle Traceability
  const toggleTrace = (productId: string) => {
    setExpandedTraceMap((prev) => ({ ...prev, [productId]: !prev[productId] }));
  };

  // Execute Order
  const handlePlaceOrder = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (cart.length === 0) return;

    if (!customerName.trim() || !phone.trim() || !deliveryAddress.trim()) {
      alert(
        language === 'bn'
          ? 'αªàαª¿αºüαªùαºìαª░αª╣ αªòαª░αºç αªåαª¬αª¿αª╛αª░ αª¿αª╛αª«, αª«αºïαª¼αª╛αªçαª▓ αª¿αª«αºìαª¼αª░ αªÅαª¼αªé αª╕αª«αºìαª¬αºéαª░αºìαªú αªíαºçαª▓αª┐αª¡αª╛αª░αª┐ αªáαª┐αªòαª╛αª¿αª╛ αª¬αºéαª░αªú αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ'
          : 'Please provide your name, phone number, and delivery address.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setSubmittingOrder(true);
    try {
      // Group items by retailer sellerId
      const groupedBySeller: Record<string, CartItem[]> = {};
      cart.forEach((item) => {
        const sid = item.product.sellerId || 'retailer-general';
        if (!groupedBySeller[sid]) groupedBySeller[sid] = [];
        groupedBySeller[sid].push(item);
      });

      let primaryRetailer = '';

        const sellerItems = groupedBySeller[sellerId];
        const primaryProduct = sellerItems[0].product;
        primaryRetailer = primaryProduct.sellerName;

        const res = await orderApi.createOrder({
          buyerId: currentUser?.id,
          buyerName: customerName.trim(),
          buyerPhone: phone.trim(),
          buyerEmail: currentUser?.email,
          buyerRole: 'consumer',
          sellerId: primaryProduct.sellerId,
          sellerName: primaryProduct.sellerName,
          sellerPhone: primaryProduct.sellerPhone,
          sellerRole: 'retailer',
          items: sellerItems.map((si) => ({
            productId: si.product.id,
            quantityKg: si.quantityKg,
          })),
          paymentMethod,
          deliveryAddress: deliveryAddress.trim(),
          district: primaryProduct.district || 'Bogura',
          notes: `Guest Consumer Order. Sourced via NativeBazar Social Feed.`,
        });

        if (res.success && res.order) {
          lastOrderId = res.order.id;
        }
      }

      setOrderSuccessDetails({
        orderId: lastOrderId || `NB-ORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
        totalBDT: grandTotalBDT,
        retailerName: primaryRetailer,
      });

      setCart([]);
      localStorage.removeItem('nb_guest_cart');
      fetchProducts(); // Refresh stock

        err.message ||

            ? 'αªàαª░αºìαªíαª╛αª░ αª¬αºìαª░αªòαºìαª░αª┐αª»αª╝αª╛ αªòαª░αªñαºç αªñαºìαª░αºüαªƒαª┐ αª╣αª»αª╝αºçαª¢αºçαÑñ αªàαª¿αºüαªùαºìαª░αª╣ αªòαª░αºç αªåαª¼αª╛αª░ αªÜαºçαª╖αºìαªƒαª╛ αªòαª░αºüαª¿αÑñ'
            : 'Failed to place order. Please try again.')

      {/* Consumer Hero Header (Zero-Login Welcoming Feed Banner) */}
      <div className="relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950 via-teal-900 to-stone-900 text-white shadow-xl border border-emerald-800/40 p-6 sm:p-8">
        <div className="relative z-10 max-w-3xl space-y-3">

              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                Fresh Native Produce, <span className="text-emerald-400">Direct & Traceable</span>

          </h1>

            {language === 'bn'

'αªòαºïαª¿αºï αªàαºìαª»αª╛αªòαª╛αªëαª¿αºìαªƒ αª¼αª╛ αª▓αªùαªçαª¿ αª¬αºìαª░αºƒαºïαª£αª¿ αª¿αºçαªçαÑñ αª¼αª┐αª╢αºìαª¼αª╕αºìαªñ αªûαºüαªÜαª░αª╛ αª¼αª┐αªòαºìαª░αºçαªñαª╛ αªô αª¼αª╛αª£αª╛αª░ αªòαºçαª¿αºìαªªαºìαª░ αªÑαºçαªòαºç αªƒαª╛αªƒαªòαª╛ αª╕αª¼αª£αª┐, αªåαª▓αºü, αª«αª░αª┐αªÜ αªô αª╢αª╕αºìαª» αª¼αºçαª¢αºç αª¿αª┐αª¿αÑñ αª¬αºìαª░αªñαª┐αªƒαª┐ αª¬αªúαºìαª»αºç αª░αºƒαºçαª¢αºç αªòαºâαª╖αªò αªëαºÄαª╕αºçαª░ αªƒαºìαª░αºçαª╕αºçαª¼αª┐αª▓αª┐αªƒαª┐αÑñ'

  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Calendar,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldCheck,
  Phone,
  MapPin,
  Stethoscope,
  Mic,
  DollarSign,
  Trash2,
  Star,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Wallet,
  Package,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CloudSun,
  Wind,
  Droplets,
  Layers,
  Clock,
  Building2,
  Truck,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { requestMarketPrediction, MarketPredictionResult } from '../services/aiService';

interface FarmerDashboardProps {
  currentUser: User;
  suppliers?: any[];
  language: Language;
  onOpenCropDoctor: () => void;
  onOpenVoiceAssistant: () => void;
}

type FarmerTabId = 'intelligence' | 'my_crops' | 'orders' | 'ledger';

const QUICK_CROPS = [
  {
    nameEn: 'Diamond Potato',
    nameBn: 'ডায়মন্ড গোল আলু',

  {

    nameBn: 'দেশি পটল',
    category: 'Vegetables',
    variety: 'Bogra Deshi',

  },

export const FarmerDashboard: React.FC<FarmerDashboardProps> = ({
  currentUser,
  language,
  onOpenCropDoctor,
  onOpenVoiceAssistant,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<FarmerTabId>('intelligence');

  // Farmer Intelligence State
  const [intelligenceLoading, setIntelligenceLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedDistrict, setSelectedDistrict] = useState(currentUser.district || 'Bogura');
  const [marketRates, setMarketRates] = useState<MarketRate[]>([]);
  const [wholesalerOffers, setWholesalerOffers] = useState<WholesalerOffer[]>([]);
  const [highDemandCrops, setHighDemandCrops] = useState<
    Array<{ name: string; demandIndex: number; trend: string; reason: string }>
  >([]);
  const [officialSource, setOfficialSource] = useState('Department of Agricultural Marketing (DAM)');
  const [lastRefreshedTime, setLastRefreshedTime] = useState<string>('');

  // Live Weather for Farmer District
  const [weatherData, setWeatherData] = useState<{
    temp: number;
    condition: string;
    conditionBn: string;
    humidity: number;
    windSpeed: number;
    rainProb: number;
    source: string;
    forecast: string;
  }>({
    temp: 29,
    condition: 'Partly Sunny',
    conditionBn: 'আংশিক রৌদ্রোজ্জ্বল',
    humidity: 68,
    windSpeed: 12,
    rainProb: 15,
    source: 'Open-Meteo & Bangladesh Met Dept (BMD)',
    forecast: 'Favorable for vegetable harvesting and crate transport.',
  });

  // Farmer's listed products (for Wholesalers)
  const [myProducts, setMyProducts] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [productsLoading, setProductsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Orders from Wholesalers
  const [receivedOrders, setReceivedOrders] = useState<SupplyChainOrder[]>([]);
  const [ordersLoading, setOrdersLoading] = useState(false);

  // Add Product Form
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [submittingProduct, setSubmittingProduct] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCropIndex, setSelectedCropIndex] = useState(0);
  const [quantityKg, setQuantityKg] = useState(500);
  const [pricePerKg, setPricePerKg] = useState(28);
  const [qualityGrade, setQualityGrade] = useState<'A' | 'B' | 'C'>('A');
  const [harvestStatus, setHarvestStatus] = useState('Ready to Harvest');
  const [organicCertified, setOrganicCertified] = useState(false);
  const [variety, setVariety] = useState('Diamond Grade A');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('Freshly harvested batch from our family farmland.');

  // AI Price Prediction
  const [isPredicting, setIsPredicting] = useState(false);
  const [aiPrediction, setAiPrediction] = useState<MarketPredictionResult | null>(null);

  // Financial Ledger
  const [ledgerEntries, setLedgerEntries] = useState<ExpenseLedgerEntry[]>([]);
  const [showLedgerModal, setShowLedgerModal] = useState(false);
  const [ledgerForm, setLedgerForm] = useState({
    type: 'expense' as 'expense' | 'income',
    category: 'Fertilizer' as ExpenseLedgerEntry['category'],
    description: '',
    amountBDT: 0,
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
  });

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // Load Farmer Intelligence (Market prices, bids, weather)
  const loadIntelligence = async () => {
    setIntelligenceLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await intelligenceApi.getFarmerIntelligence(selectedDistrict);
      setMarketRates(data.marketRates || []);
      setWholesalerOffers(data.wholesalerOffers || []);
      setHighDemandCrops(data.highDemandCrops || []);
      setOfficialSource(data.officialSource || 'Department of Agricultural Marketing (DAM)');
      setLastRefreshedTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));

      // Fetch Live Meteorological Weather from Open-Meteo
      try {
        const coords: Record<string, { lat: number; lon: number }> = {
          Bogura: { lat: 24.8465, lon: 89.3777 },
          Dhaka: { lat: 23.8103, lon: 90.4125 },
          Rajshahi: { lat: 24.3636, lon: 88.6241 },
          Rangpur: { lat: 25.7439, lon: 89.2752 },
          Dinajpur: { lat: 25.6217, lon: 88.6355 },
        };
        const c = coords[selectedDistrict] || coords['Bogura'];
        const wRes = await fetch(
          `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${c.lat}&longitude=${c.lon}&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&timezone=auto`
        );
        if (wRes.ok) {
          const wJson = await wRes.json();
          const curr = wJson.current;
          if (curr) {
            setWeatherData({
              temp: Math.round(curr.temperature_2m),
              condition: curr.temperature_2m > 30 ? 'Warm & Clear' : 'Fair Agro Conditions',
              conditionBn: curr.temperature_2m > 30 ? 'উষ্ণ ও রৌদ্রোজ্জ্বল' : 'অনুকূল কৃষি আবহাওয়া',
              humidity: Math.round(curr.relative_humidity_2m),
              windSpeed: Math.round(curr.wind_speed_10m),
              rainProb: curr.weather_code >= 51 ? 65 : 10,
              source: 'Open-Meteo Grounded Meteorological Feed',
              forecast:
                curr.weather_code >= 51
                  ? 'Rain expected. Ensure dry storage for harvested sacks.'
                  : 'Favorable conditions for morning crop picking and wholesale transport.',
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Weather fetch fallback to recorded parameters', e);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load farmer intelligence', err);
    } finally {
      setIntelligenceLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load Farmer's Products
  const loadMyProducts = async () => {
    setProductsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        sellerRole: 'farmer',
      });
      // Filter for this farmer's listings (or all farmer harvests if testing)
      const filtered = res.products.filter(
        (p) => p.sellerId === currentUser.id || p.sellerName === currentUser.name
      );
      setMyProducts(filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : res.products);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load farmer products', err);
    } finally {
      setProductsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load Wholesale Orders received from Wholesalers
  const loadReceivedOrders = async () => {
    setOrdersLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await orderApi.getOrders({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        role: 'farmer',
      });
      setReceivedOrders(res.orders || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load farmer orders', err);
    } finally {
      setOrdersLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadIntelligence();
    loadMyProducts();
    loadReceivedOrders();
    setLedgerEntries(ExpenseStore.getAll().filter((e) => e.farmerId === currentUser.id));
  }, [currentUser.id, selectedDistrict]);

  // AI Price Recommendation
  const handlePredictPrice = async () => {
    setIsPredicting(true);
    const selected = QUICK_CROPS[selectedCropIndex];
    try {
      const result = await requestMarketPrediction(
        selected.nameEn,
        quantityKg,
        harvestStatus,
        selectedDistrict,
        language
      );
      setAiPrediction(result);
      if (result.expectedPriceRangeBDT?.recommendedWholesale) {
        setPricePerKg(result.expectedPriceRangeBDT.recommendedWholesale);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('AI prediction error', e);
    } finally {
      setIsPredicting(false);
    }
  };

  // Publish Crop Batch (Farmer -> Wholesaler)
  const handlePublishCrop = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmittingProduct(true);
    const selected = QUICK_CROPS[selectedCropIndex];

    try {
      await productApi.createProduct({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        sellerName: currentUser.name,
        sellerPhone: currentUser.phone,
        sellerRole: 'farmer',
        targetRole: 'wholesaler',
        cropName: selected.nameEn,
        banglaName: selected.nameBn,
        category: selected.category,
        variety: variety || selected.variety,
        quantityKg,
        availableKg: quantityKg,
        minOrderKg: 50,
        pricePerKg,
        qualityGrade,
        district: currentUser.district || selectedDistrict,
        upazila: currentUser.upazila || 'Shibganj',
        locationDetails: `${currentUser.upazila || 'Shibganj'}, ${currentUser.district || 'Bogura'} Farmland`,
        harvestStatus,
        organicCertified,
        imageUrl: selected.img,
        description: description || `Freshly harvested ${selected.nameEn} directly from farm gate.`,
        traceability: {
          farmerOrigin: `${currentUser.name}, ${currentUser.upazila || 'Shibganj'}, ${currentUser.district || 'Bogura'}`,
          procurementDate: 'Freshly harvested today',
          safetyNote: '100% formalin-free with standard field curing.',
        },
      });

      NotificationStore.addSystemNotif(
        currentUser.id,
        t('Harvest Published!', 'ফসল তালিকাভুক্ত!'),
        t(
          `${selected.nameEn} (${quantityKg}kg) published to Wholesalers at ৳${pricePerKg}/kg.`,
          `${selected.nameBn} (${quantityKg}কেজি) পাইকারদের জন্য তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়েছে। মূল্য ৳${pricePerKg}/কেজি।`
        ),
        'success'
      );

      setShowAddModal(false);
      setAiPrediction(null);
      loadMyProducts();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to publish crop');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingProduct(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Product
  const handleDeleteProduct = async (id: string) => {
    if (confirm(t('Are you sure you want to remove this harvest listing?', 'এই ফসলের তালিকাটি কি নিশ্চিতভাবে মুছে ফেলতে চান?'))) {
      try {
        await productApi.deleteProduct(id);
        loadMyProducts();
      } catch (e: any) {
        alert(e.message || 'Failed to delete listing');
      }
    }
  };

  // Update Order Delivery Status
  const handleUpdateOrderStatus = async (
    orderId: string,
    status: 'Confirmed' | 'Processing' | 'Dispatched' | 'Delivered'
  ) => {
    try {
      await orderApi.updateStatus(orderId, status, currentUser.name, 'farmer');
      loadReceivedOrders();
      NotificationStore.addSystemNotif(
        currentUser.id,
        t('Order Updated', 'অর্ডারের অবস্থা পরিবর্তিত'),
        t(`Order #${orderId} marked as ${status}`, `অর্ডার #${orderId} এখন ${status}`),
        'info'
      );
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || 'Failed to update order status');
    }
  };

  // Add Financial Ledger Entry
  const handleAddLedgerEntry = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const entry: ExpenseLedgerEntry = {
      id: `ledger-${Date.now()}`,
      farmerId: currentUser.id,
      ...ledgerForm,
    };
    ExpenseStore.add(entry);
    setShowLedgerModal(false);
    setLedgerForm({
      type: 'expense',
      category: 'Fertilizer',
      description: '',
      amountBDT: 0,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    });
    setLedgerEntries(ExpenseStore.getAll().filter((entry) => entry.farmerId === currentUser.id));
  };

  const totalHarvestKg = myProducts.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.availableKg || 0), 0);
  const totalEstRevenue = myProducts.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.availableKg || 0) * p.pricePerKg, 0);
  const totalExpenses = ExpenseStore.totalExpenses();
  const totalIncome = ExpenseStore.totalRevenue();
  const netProfit = totalIncome - totalExpenses;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-16 animate-fade-in">
      {/* Farmer Hero Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-900 via-teal-900 to-stone-900 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 text-white shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-emerald-700/40">
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-5">
          <div className="space-y-2 max-w-2xl">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-800/70 border border-emerald-400/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-200">
              <Sprout className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{t('Farmer Command Center • Strict Supply Chain', 'কৃষক পোর্টাল • পাইকারি সরবরাহ কেন্দ্র')}</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              {currentUser.name} {language === 'bn' ? 'এর খামার কেন্দ্র' : 'Agro Harvest Hub'}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-stone-300 text-xs sm:text-sm">
              {t(
                `Direct wholesale supply to registered wholesalers. Verified DAM market prices, live weather alerts, and buyer procurement bids for ${selectedDistrict}.`,
                `সরাসরি নিবন্ধিত পাইকারদের কাছে পাইকারি দরে ফসল বিক্রি করুন। বগুড়া ও স্থানীয় বাজারদর এবং আবহাওয়া বার্তা শুধুমাত্র কৃষকের জন্য।`
              )}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
              className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-stone-950 font-extrabold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 transition-all hover:scale-102"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{t('List New Harvest', 'নতুন ফসল যুক্ত করুন')}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onOpenCropDoctor}
              className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <Stethoscope className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
              <span>{t('Crop Doctor AI', 'এআই শস্য ডাক্তার')}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onOpenVoiceAssistant}
              className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20"
              title="Voice Assistant"
            >
              <Mic className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards Row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Active Harvest Stock', 'মজুদ ফসল')}</span>
            <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-stone-900">
            {totalHarvestKg.toLocaleString()}{' '}
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-stone-500">kg</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">
            {myProducts.length} {t('active wholesale batches', 'টি পাইকারি লট')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Est. Wholesale Value', 'সম্ভাব্য বিক্রয় মূল্য')}</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-blue-700">
            ৳{totalEstRevenue.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">{t('Based on wholesale gate rates', 'পাইকারি দরের ভিত্তিতে')}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Verified Wholesaler Bids', 'পাইকারদের চাহিদা')}</span>
            <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-700">
            {wholesalerOffers.length}{' '}
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-stone-500">{t('Tenders', 'টি অফার')}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">{t('Immediate buyer contracts', 'তাৎক্ষণিক পাইকারি ক্রয় চুক্তি')}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Net Farm Profit', 'নিট খামার মুনাফা')}</span>
            <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-stone-900">
            ৳{netProfit.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">{t('Calculated via Farm Ledger', 'খামার লেজার হিসাব অনুযায়ী')}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-stone-200 pb-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('intelligence')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'intelligence'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-white text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200'
          }`}
        >
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{t('Farmer Intelligence (Weather, Bids & DAM Prices)', 'কৃষক তথ্যভাণ্ডার (আবহাওয়া, দর ও চাহিদা)')}</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('my_crops')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'my_crops'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-white text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200'
          }`}
        >
          <Sprout className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{t('My Harvest Listings', 'আমার ফসলের তালিকা')}</span>
          <span className="bg-stone-900 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
            {myProducts.length}

                  'Orders received from wholesalers purchasing your crops. Update dispatch status upon crate delivery.',
                  'আপনার ফসল ক্রয়ে পাইকারদের অর্ডার। মাল পাঠানোর পর স্ট্যাটাস আপডেট করুন।'
                )}

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                    Delivery Hub: {order.deliveryAddress} • Payment: {order.paymentMethod}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="text-stone-500 text-[11px] block">Order Total</span>
                    <span className="font-black text-emerald-700 text-base">৳{order.totalBDT}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {order.status === 'Confirmed' && (
                      <button

                    {order.status === 'Dispatched' && (

                </button>

                  type="button"

                      : 'border-stone-200 text-stone-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  Income (আয়)
                </button>
              </div>

                <label className="block font-bold text-stone-700 mb-1">Category</label>

                  <option value="Irrigation">Irrigation (সেচ)</option>
                  <option value="Labor">Labor (শ্রমিক)</option>
                  <option value="Pesticide">Pesticide (কীটনাশক)</option>

                  }
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl font-bold"
                  required
                />
              </div>

                <label className="block font-bold text-stone-700 mb-1">Description / Memo</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={ledgerForm.description}
                  onChange={(e) =>

                  }

                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-stone-50 border border-stone-300 rounded-xl"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button

                  className="px-4 py-2 font-bold text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 rounded-xl"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="bg-stone-900 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-xs"
                >
                  Save Entry
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { MarketRate, Language } from '../types';
import { BANGLADESH_LOCATIONS } from '../data/mockData';
import { MarketRateStore } from '../data/store';
import {
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Minus,
  Building2,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Info,
  Calendar,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface MarketRatesViewProps {
  rates?: MarketRate[];
  language: Language;
  selectedDistrict?: string;
  onDistrictChange?: (district: string) => void;
}

export const MarketRatesView: React.FC<MarketRatesViewProps> = ({
  rates: propRates,
  language,
  selectedDistrict = 'Bogura',
  onDistrictChange,
}) => {
  const [districtFilter, setDistrictFilter] = useState(selectedDistrict);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // Sync internal district filter if prop changes
  const activeDistrict = onDistrictChange ? selectedDistrict : districtFilter;

  // Retrieve rates for selected district from store or props
  const allRates = useMemo(() => {
    return MarketRateStore.getAll();
  }, []);

  // Filter rates by district - Strict zero-fabrication (never silently substitute Bogura)
  const districtRates = useMemo(() => {
    const directMatches = allRates.filter(
      (r) => r.district.toLowerCase() === activeDistrict.toLowerCase()
    );
    if (directMatches.length > 0) {
      return { rates: directMatches, isFallback: false };
    }
    return { rates: [], isFallback: true };
  }, [allRates, activeDistrict]);

  // Apply category and search filter
  const displayedRates = useMemo(() => {
    return districtRates.rates.filter((r) => {
      const matchesCategory =
        selectedCategory === 'All' || r.category === selectedCategory;
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        r.cropName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.banglaName.includes(q) ||
