}

type RetailerTabId = 'procure_wholesale' | 'my_retail_shop' | 'consumer_orders';

export const RetailerDashboard: React.FC<RetailerDashboardProps> = ({
  currentUser,
  language,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<RetailerTabId>('my_retail_shop');

  // Tab 1: Procure from Wholesalers (Wholesaler -> Retailer)
  const [wholesaleListings, setWholesaleListings] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [wholesaleLoading, setWholesaleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [wholesaleSearch, setWholesaleSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedWholesaleLot, setSelectedWholesaleLot] = useState<MarketplaceProduct | null>(null);
  const [orderKg, setOrderKg] = useState(100);
  const [submittingWholesaleOrder, setSubmittingWholesaleOrder] = useState(false);

  // Tab 2: My Retail Shop Products (Retailer -> Consumer)
  const [myRetailProducts, setMyRetailProducts] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [retailProductsLoading, setRetailProductsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showAddRetailModal, setShowAddRetailModal] = useState(false);
  const [retailForm, setRetailForm] = useState({
    cropName: 'Fresh Table Tomatoes',
    banglaName: 'তাজা পাকা টমেটো',
    category: 'Vegetables',
    variety: 'Hybrid Shingro-3',
    quantityKg: 300,
    pricePerKg: 52,
    marketPricePerKg: 56,
    qualityGrade: 'A' as 'A' | 'B' | 'C',
    organicCertified: true,
    farmerOrigin: 'Shibganj Farmer Cooperatives, Bogura',
    wholesalerArat: 'Mahasthangarh Wholesale Arat Hub',
    locationDetails: currentUser.address || `${currentUser.upazila || 'Bogura Sadar'} Retail Store`,
    imageUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1592924357228-91a4daadcfea?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    description: 'Crisp, hand-picked table tomatoes directly sourced from Shibganj fields. Certified formalin-free and ready for home delivery.',
    safetyNote: '100% formalin-free tested. Harvested naturally without chemical ripening agents.',
  });

  // Tab 3: Consumer Orders (Retailer fulfills Consumer orders)
  const [consumerOrders, setConsumerOrders] = useState<SupplyChainOrder[]>([]);
  const [ordersLoading, setOrdersLoading] = useState(false);

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // Load Wholesale lots (sellerRole=wholesaler & targetRole=retailer)
  const loadWholesaleListings = async () => {
    setWholesaleLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        sellerRole: 'wholesaler',
        targetRole: 'retailer',
        search: wholesaleSearch.trim() || undefined,
      });
      setWholesaleListings(res.products || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load wholesale listings', e);
    } finally {
      setWholesaleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load My Retail Products (sellerRole=retailer & targetRole=consumer)
  const loadMyRetailProducts = async () => {
    setRetailProductsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        sellerRole: 'retailer',
        targetRole: 'consumer',
      });
      const mine = res.products.filter(
        (p) => p.sellerId === currentUser.id || p.sellerName === currentUser.name
      );
      setMyRetailProducts(mine.length > 0 ? mine : res.products);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load retail products', e);
    } finally {
      setRetailProductsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load Consumer Orders received by this Retailer
  const loadConsumerOrders = async () => {
    setOrdersLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await orderApi.getOrders({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        role: 'retailer',
      });
      setConsumerOrders(res.orders || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load consumer orders', e);
    } finally {
      setOrdersLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMyRetailProducts();
    loadWholesaleListings();
    loadConsumerOrders();
  }, [currentUser.id]);

  // Execute Wholesale Purchase from Wholesaler (Wholesaler -> Retailer)
  const handlePurchaseFromWholesaler = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedWholesaleLot) return;

    if (orderKg < (selectedWholesaleLot.minOrderKg || 50)) {
      alert(`Minimum wholesale order is ${selectedWholesaleLot.minOrderKg || 50} kg.`);
      return;
    }

    setSubmittingWholesaleOrder(true);
    try {
      const res = await orderApi.createOrder({
        buyerId: currentUser.id,
        buyerName: currentUser.shopName || currentUser.name,
        buyerPhone: currentUser.phone,
        buyerEmail: currentUser.email,
        buyerRole: 'retailer',
        sellerId: selectedWholesaleLot.sellerId,
        sellerName: selectedWholesaleLot.sellerName,
        sellerPhone: selectedWholesaleLot.sellerPhone,
        sellerRole: 'wholesaler',
        items: [
          {
            productId: selectedWholesaleLot.id,
            quantityKg: orderKg,
          },
        ],
        paymentMethod: 'Bank Transfer / Wholesale Credit',
        deliveryAddress: currentUser.address || `${currentUser.district} Retail Outlet`,
        district: currentUser.district || 'Bogura',
        notes: `Procured wholesale stock by ${currentUser.shopName || currentUser.name}`,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        alert(
          t(
            `Wholesale stock ordered from Wholesaler! Order #${res.order.id}. Stock reserved.`,
            `পাইকার থেকে স্টক ক্রয় সম্পন্ন হয়েছে! অর্ডার #${res.order.id}। স্টক সংরক্ষিত।`
          )
        );
        setSelectedWholesaleLot(null);
        loadWholesaleListings();
        loadMyRetailProducts();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Wholesale order failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingWholesaleOrder(false);
    }
  };

  // Publish Retail Product for Consumers (Retailer -> Consumer)
  const handlePublishRetailProduct = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await productApi.createProduct({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        sellerName: currentUser.shopName || currentUser.name,
        sellerPhone: currentUser.phone,
        sellerRole: 'retailer',
        targetRole: 'consumer',
        cropName: retailForm.cropName,
        banglaName: retailForm.banglaName,
        category: retailForm.category,
        variety: retailForm.variety,
        quantityKg: retailForm.quantityKg,
        availableKg: retailForm.quantityKg,
        minOrderKg: 1,
        pricePerKg: retailForm.pricePerKg,
        marketPricePerKg: retailForm.marketPricePerKg,
        qualityGrade: retailForm.qualityGrade,
        district: currentUser.district || 'Bogura',
        upazila: currentUser.upazila || 'Bogura Sadar',
        locationDetails: retailForm.locationDetails,
        harvestStatus: 'Fresh Farm Stock',
        availableDate: 'Ready for Home Delivery',
        organicCertified: retailForm.organicCertified,
        imageUrl: retailForm.imageUrl,
        description: retailForm.description,
        traceability: {
          farmerOrigin: retailForm.farmerOrigin,
          wholesalerArat: retailForm.wholesalerArat,
          procurementDate: 'Freshly stocked today',
          safetyNote: retailForm.safetyNote,
        },
      });

      NotificationStore.addSystemNotif(
        currentUser.id,
        t('Retail Product Live on Social Feed!', 'খুচরা পণ্য সোশ্যাল ফিডে প্রকাশিত!'),
        t(
          `Published ${retailForm.cropName} at ৳${retailForm.pricePerKg}/kg. Consumers can now purchase via Guest Checkout.`,
          `${retailForm.cropName} ৳${retailForm.pricePerKg}/কেজি দরে ফিডে উন্মুক্ত করা হয়েছে। ভোক্তারা সরাসরি অর্ডার করতে পারবেন।`
        ),
        'success'
      );

      setShowAddRetailModal(false);
      loadMyRetailProducts();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to publish retail product');
    }
  };

  // Delete Retail Product
  const handleDeleteProduct = async (id: string) => {
    if (confirm(t('Remove this product from the Consumer Marketplace?', 'ভোক্তা মার্কেটপ্লেস থেকে এই পণ্যটি কি সরাতে চান?'))) {
      try {
        await productApi.deleteProduct(id);
        loadMyRetailProducts();
      } catch (e: any) {
        alert(e.message || 'Failed to delete product');
      }
    }
  };

  // Update Consumer Order Status
  const handleUpdateConsumerOrderStatus = async (
    orderId: string,
    status: 'Confirmed' | 'Processing' | 'Dispatched' | 'Delivered'
  ) => {
    try {
      await orderApi.updateStatus(orderId, status, currentUser.name, 'retailer');
      loadConsumerOrders();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || 'Failed to update order status');
    }
  };

  const totalRetailKg = myRetailProducts.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.availableKg || 0), 0);
  const totalSalesVolume = consumerOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + (o.totalBDT || 0), 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-16 animate-fade-in">
      {/* Retailer Hero Header */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-900 via-emerald-900 to-stone-900 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 text-white shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-teal-700/40">
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-teal-800/60 border border-teal-400/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold text-teal-200">
              <Store className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-300" />
              <span>{t('Strict Supply Chain: Wholesaler → Retailer → Consumer', 'নিয়ন্ত্রিত সরবরাহ শৃঙ্খলা: পাইকার → খুচরা → ভোক্তা')}</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              {currentUser.shopName || currentUser.name}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-teal-100 text-xs sm:text-sm max-w-2xl">
              {t(
                'Procure wholesale lots from certified Wholesalers. Publish fresh, traceable retail products to the Consumer Social-Feed Marketplace with fast local van delivery.',
                'পাইকারদের কাছ থেকে পাইকারি লট সংগ্রহ করুন এবং সাধারণ ভোক্তাদের জন্য তাজা খুচরা কৃষিপণ্য সোশ্যাল ফিডে সরবরাহ করুন।'
              )}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddRetailModal(true)}
              className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-stone-950 font-extrabold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{t('Publish Retail Product to Feed', 'ভোক্তা ফিডে নতুন পণ্য যোগ')}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('procure_wholesale')}
              className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
              <span>{t('Procure from Wholesalers', 'পাইকার থেকে মাল ক্রয়')}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards Row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Retail Stock in Store', 'দোকানের মোট মজুদ')}</span>
            <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-stone-900">
            {totalRetailKg.toLocaleString()}{' '}
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-stone-500">kg</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">
            {myRetailProducts.length} {t('Active items on Consumer Feed', 'টি পণ্য ফিডে লাইভ')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Consumer Orders', 'ভোক্তাদের অর্ডার')}</span>
            <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-700">
            {consumerOrders.length}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">Guest & Registered shoppers</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Retail Sales Revenue', 'মোট খুচরা বিক্রয়')}</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-blue-700">
            ৳{totalSalesVolume.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">Delivered & confirmed</p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-stone-500 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase">
            <span>{t('Wholesale Lots Available', 'পাইকারি লট সুযোগ')}</span>
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-700">
            {wholesaleListings.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-stone-500">lots</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-1">From regional wholesalers</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Tabs */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-stone-200 pb-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('my_retail_shop')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'my_retail_shop'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-white text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200'
          }`}
        >
          <Store className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{t('My Retail Store Products (Sell to Consumers)', 'আমার খুচরা দোকান (ভোক্তাদের কাছে বিক্রয়)')}</span>
          <span className="bg-stone-900 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
            {myRetailProducts.length}
          </span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('consumer_orders')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'consumer_orders'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-white text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200'
          }`}
        >
          <Truck className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{t('Consumer Orders & Local Delivery', 'ভোক্তাদের অর্ডার ও হোম ডেলিভারি')}</span>
          {consumerOrders.length > 0 && (
            <span className="bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
              {consumerOrders.length}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('procure_wholesale')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'procure_wholesale'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-white text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 border border-stone-200'
          }`}
        >
          <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{t('Procure from Wholesalers (Browse Stock)', 'পাইকারদের কাছ থেকে পাইকারি ক্রয়')}</span>
          <span className="bg-stone-900 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full">
            {wholesaleListings.length}
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ─── TAB 1: MY RETAIL STORE PRODUCTS (Sell to Consumers) ──────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'my_retail_shop' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 shadow-2xs">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-stone-900 text-sm">
                {t('Live Products on the Consumer Marketplace Feed', 'ভোক্তা সোশ্যাল মার্কেটপ্লেসে লাইভ পণ্য')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">
                {t(
                  'These products appear directly on the landing page for all shoppers with origin traceability and quality badges.',
                  'এই পণ্যগুলো সাধারণ ভোক্তাদের সোশ্যাল ফিডে ট্রেসেবিলিটি ও কোয়ালিটি ব্যাজসহ সরাসরি প্রদর্শিত হয়।'
                )}
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddRetailModal(true)}
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-extrabold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{t('Add Retail Product', 'নতুন খুচরা পণ্য')}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {myRetailProducts.map((prod) => (
              <div
                key={prod.id}
                className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 overflow-hidden shadow-2xs flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div className="relative aspect-16/10 bg-stone-100">
                  <img
                    src={prod.imageUrl}
                    alt={prod.cropName}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 flex gap-1">
                    <span className="bg-emerald-700 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                      Retail Feed Active
                    </span>
                    {prod.organicCertified && (
                      <span className="bg-teal-600 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                        Bio-Organic
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 bg-white/95 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl shadow-md border border-stone-200 text-right">
                    <span className="text-base font-black text-stone-900">৳{prod.pricePerKg}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500">/kg retail</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-extrabold text-stone-900 text-sm">
                      {language === 'bn' ? prod.banglaName || prod.cropName : prod.cropName}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500 mt-0.5">
                      {prod.variety} • Grade {prod.qualityGrade || 'A'}
                    </p>

                    <div className="mt-2 text-stone-700 font-semibold flex items-center justify-between text-xs bg-stone-50 p-2 rounded-xl border border-stone-100">
                      <span>Available Consumer Stock:</span>
                      <strong className="text-emerald-700 font-black text-sm">
                        {prod.availableKg} kg
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-stone-500 space-y-0.5">
                      <div>
                        🌱 <strong>Origin:</strong> {prod.traceability?.farmerOrigin || prod.district}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        🏢 <strong>Arat:</strong>{' '}
                        {prod.traceability?.wholesalerArat || 'Verified Regional Wholesale Hub'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 border-t border-stone-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <BadgeCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      <span>Verified Retailer Listing</span>
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteProduct(prod.id)}
                      className="text-stone-400 hover:text-red-500 p-1"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── TAB 2: CONSUMER ORDERS & LOCAL DELIVERY ──────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'consumer_orders' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-stone-200 p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-stone-100">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-stone-900 text-base">
                {t('Incoming Consumer Orders', 'ভোক্তাদের হোম ডেলিভারি অর্ডার')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-stone-500">
                Orders placed through Guest Checkout on the Consumer Marketplace feed.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="badge-success text-xs">Retailer → Consumer</span>
          </div>

          {ordersLoading && (
            <div className="text-center py-10">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto text-emerald-600 animate-spin" />
            </div>
          )}

          {!ordersLoading && consumerOrders.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-12 text-stone-400 space-y-2">
              <ShoppingBag className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-stone-300" />
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-stone-600">No consumer orders placed yet</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400">
                When visitors checkout on the social feed, their orders appear here for packing and dispatch.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {consumerOrders.map((order) => (
              <div
                key={order.id}

function getInitials(name: string) {
  return name
    .split(' ')
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((n) => n[0])
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string) {
  try {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

function formatBDT(amount: number) {
  return `৳${amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
}

  const cropListings = useMemo(() => CropStore.getAll().filter((c) => c.farmerId === user.id), [user.id]);
  const businessDemands = useMemo(() => DemandStore.getAll().filter((d) => d.buyerId === user.id), [user.id]);
  const supplierProducts = useMemo(() => SupplierStore.getAll().filter((p) => p.supplierId === user.id), [user.id]);
  const orders = useMemo(() => OrderStore.getAll().filter((o) => o.customerId === user.id), [user.id]);
  const tradeOrders = useMemo(() => TradeOrderStore.getByUser(user.id), [user.id]);
  const advisories = useMemo(() => AdvisoryStore.getAll().filter((a) => a.expertId === user.id), [user.id]);
  const auditLogs = useMemo(
    () => AuthStore.getAuditLogs().filter((l) => l.phone === user.phone || l.phone === user.email),
    [user.phone, user.email]
  );
  const allUsers = useMemo(() => (isAdmin ? AuthStore.getUsers() : []), [isAdmin]);

  const rc = roleConfig[user.role];

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (user.role === 'farmer') {
      const totalRevenue = cropListings.reduce((s, c) => s + c.expectedPricePerKg * c.quantityKg, 0);
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'ফসলের তালিকা' : 'Crop Listings', value: cropListings.length, icon: <Leaf className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-emerald-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'সম্ভাব্য আয়' : 'Expected Revenue', value: formatBDT(totalRevenue), icon: <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'জমির আকার' : 'Farm Size', value: `${user.farmSizeAcres || editFarmSize} acres`, icon: <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-amber-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'ট্রেড অর্ডার' : 'Trade Orders', value: tradeOrders.length, icon: <Package className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-purple-600' },
      ];
    } else if (user.role === 'businessman') {
      const totalDemandValue = businessDemands.reduce((s, d) => s + d.targetPricePerKg * d.quantityKgNeeded, 0);
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'চাহিদার তালিকা' : 'Purchase Demands', value: businessDemands.length, icon: <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট ক্রয় মূল্য' : 'Total Buy Value', value: formatBDT(totalDemandValue), icon: <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-emerald-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'ব্যবসার নাম' : 'Business', value: user.businessName || '–', icon: <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-amber-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'ট্রেড অর্ডার' : 'Trade Orders', value: tradeOrders.length, icon: <Package className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-purple-600' },
      ];
    } else if (user.role === 'supplier') {
      const inStock = supplierProducts.filter((p) => p.inStock).length;
      const avgRating = supplierProducts.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.rating || 0), 0) / (supplierProducts.length || 1);
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট পণ্য' : 'Total Products', value: supplierProducts.length, icon: <Package className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-amber-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'স্টকে আছে' : 'In Stock', value: inStock, icon: <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-emerald-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'গড় রেটিং' : 'Avg. Rating', value: `${avgRating.toFixed(1)} ★`, icon: <Star className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-yellow-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'দোকান' : 'Shop', value: user.shopName || '–', icon: <Store className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
      ];
    } else if (user.role === 'customer') {
      const totalSpent = orders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.totalBDT, 0);
      const delivered = orders.filter((o) => o.status === 'Delivered').length;
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট অর্ডার' : 'Total Orders', value: orders.length, icon: <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-purple-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট ব্যয়' : 'Total Spent', value: formatBDT(totalSpent), icon: <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'ডেলিভারি হয়েছে' : 'Delivered', value: delivered, icon: <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-emerald-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'পেন্ডিং' : 'Pending', value: orders.length - delivered, icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-amber-600' },
      ];
    } else if (user.role === 'expert') {
      const urgent = advisories.filter((a) => a.severity === 'Urgent').length;
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'পরামর্শ' : 'Advisories', value: advisories.length, icon: <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-teal-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'জরুরি সতর্কতা' : 'Urgent Alerts', value: urgent, icon: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-red-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'পদবী' : 'Designation', value: (user.designation || 'Officer').split(',')[0], icon: <Award className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-amber-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'বিশেষত্ব' : 'Specialization', value: (user.specialization || ['Crop Science'])[0], icon: <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
      ];
    } else {
      const allOrders = OrderStore.getAll();
      return [
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট ব্যবহারকারী' : 'Total Users', value: allUsers.length, icon: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-slate-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'মোট অর্ডার' : 'Total Orders', value: allOrders.length, icon: <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-blue-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'অডিট লগ' : 'Audit Logs', value: AuthStore.getAuditLogs().length, icon: <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-emerald-600' },
        { label: language === 'bn' ? 'সিস্টেম স্তর' : 'System Level', value: 'Level-4', icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />, color: 'text-red-600' },
      ];
    }
  }, [user, language, cropListings, businessDemands, supplierProducts, orders, tradeOrders, advisories, editFarmSize, allUsers]);

  const handleSave = () => {
    const updates: Partial<User> = {
      name: editName,
      phone: editPhone,
      district: editDistrict,
      education: editEducation,
    };
    if (user.role === 'farmer') updates.farmSizeAcres = editFarmSize;
    if (user.role === 'businessman') updates.businessName = editBusinessName;
    if (user.role === 'supplier') updates.shopName = editShopName;
    if (user.role === 'expert') updates.designation = editDesignation;
    const updated = AuthStore.updateProfile(updates);
    if (updated && onUpdateUser) {
      onUpdateUser(updated);
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      setIsEditing(false);
      setTimeout(() => setSaveSuccess(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  const tabs: { id: TabId; label: string; labelBn: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', labelBn: 'সারসংক্ষেপ', icon: <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity', labelBn: 'কার্যক্রম', icon: <Activity className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'orders', label: 'Orders & Trades', labelBn: 'অর্ডার ও লেনদেন', icon: <Package className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    ...(canEdit ? [{ id: 'edit' as TabId, label: 'Edit Profile', labelBn: 'প্রোফাইল সম্পাদনা', icon: <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" /> }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Back + Breadcrumb */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          onClick={onBack}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-stone-600 hover:text-stone-900 bg-white border border-stone-200 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-50 transition-all shadow-xs"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          {language === 'bn' ? 'ফিরে যান' : 'Back'}
        </button>
        <div className="text-sm text-stone-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'ড্যাশবোর্ড' : 'Dashboard'}</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="text-stone-700 font-semibold">
            {language === 'bn' ? 'ব্যবহারকারী প্রোফাইল' : 'User Profile'}
          </span>
          {!isOwnProfile && (
            <>
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="text-stone-900 font-bold">{user.name}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Profile Hero */}
      <div className={`bg-white border ${rc.border} rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden`}>
        <div className={`absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none ${rc.bg}`} />
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center gap-5">
          {/* Avatar */}
          <div className={`w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl ${rc.bg} ${rc.border} border-2 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shrink-0`}>
            {user.profileImageUrl ? (
              <img src={user.profileImageUrl} alt={user.name} className="w-full h-full rounded-2xl object-cover" />
            ) : (
              <span className={`text-2xl font-black ${rc.color}`}>{getInitials(user.name)}</span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-stone-900">{user.name}</h1>
              {user.verified && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-200">
                  <BadgeCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{' '}
                  {language === 'bn' ? 'যাচাইকৃত' : 'Verified'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${rc.bg} ${rc.border} border ${rc.color} px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold mb-3`}>
              {rc.icon}
              <span>{language === 'bn' ? rc.labelBn : rc.label}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-stone-600">
              {user.email && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{user.email}</span>
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>{user.phone}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>{user.district}{user.upazila ? `, ${user.upazila}` : ''}</span>
              </span>
              {user.education && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{user.education}</span>
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'যোগদান: ' : 'Joined: '}{formatDate(user.createdAt)}</span>
              </span>
              {user.lastLoginAt && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'শেষ লগইন: ' : 'Last login: '}{formatDate(user.lastLoginAt)}</span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ID badge */}
          <div className={`shrink-0 ${rc.bg} ${rc.border} border rounded-xl p-4 text-right`}>
            <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${rc.color} uppercase block`}>
              {language === 'bn' ? 'পরিচয় আইডি' : 'User ID'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-stone-800 block mt-0.5">
              {user.id.length > 14 ? user.id.slice(0, 14) + '…' : user.id}
            </span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${rc.color} mt-1 block`}>
              {user.twoFactorEnabled ? '2FA Enabled' : 'Standard Auth'}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action buttons when viewing another user */}
        {!isOwnProfile && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-stone-200">
            <button
              onClick={() => onMessageUser && onMessageUser(user)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-xs"
            >
              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'বার্তা পাঠান' : 'Send Message'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => onCallUser && onCallUser(user)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-xs"
            >
              <PhoneCall className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'কল করুন' : 'Call Now'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleConnectToggle}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border ${
                connStatus === 'accepted'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300'
                  : connStatus === 'pending_sent'
                  ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200'
                  : 'bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-700 border-stone-200'
              }`}
            >
              {connStatus === 'accepted' ? (
                <>
                  <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'সংযুক্ত ✓' : 'Connected ✓'}</span>
                </>
              ) : connStatus === 'pending_sent' ? (
                <>
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                  <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'অনুরোধ পাঠানো হয়েছে' : 'Request Sent'}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-500" />
                  <span>{language === 'bn' ? 'যুক্ত হোন' : '+ Connect'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {saveSuccess && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-emerald-800 font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            {language === 'bn' ? 'প্রোফাইল সফলভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা হয়েছে!' : 'Profile updated successfully!'}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Stats Row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {stats.map((stat, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-stone-500 mb-2">
              <span className="truncate mr-1">{stat.label}</span>
              <span className={stat.color}>{stat.icon}</span>
            </div>
            <div className={`text-xl font-black ${stat.color} leading-tight`}>{stat.value}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center border-b border-stone-200 overflow-x-auto">
          {tabs.map((tab) => (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab(tab.id); if (tab.id !== 'edit') setIsEditing(false); }}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 transition-all ${
                activeTab === tab.id
                  ? 'border-stone-900 text-stone-900 bg-stone-50'
                  : 'border-transparent text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-50'
              }`}
            >
              {tab.icon}
              {language === 'bn' ? tab.labelBn : tab.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="p-6">
          {/* ── OVERVIEW ── */}
          {activeTab === 'overview' && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              {user.role === 'farmer' && (
                <>
                  <SectionHeader icon={<Leaf className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />} title={language === 'bn' ? 'আমার ফসলের তালিকা' : 'My Crop Listings'} />
                  {cropListings.length === 0 ? (
                    <EmptyState message={language === 'bn' ? 'এখনো কোনো ফসল তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়নি' : 'No crops listed yet'} />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {cropListings.map((crop) => (
                        <div key={crop.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-stone-50 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 text-xs">
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-stone-900">{crop.cropName}</span>
                            <span className="text-stone-500 ml-2">{crop.cropBangla}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-right">
                            <span className="text-stone-600">{crop.quantityKg} kg</span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">৳{crop.expectedPricePerKg}/kg</span>
                            <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold text-[10px] ${
                              crop.status === 'Ready to Harvest' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' :
                              crop.status === 'Growing' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' :
                              crop.status === 'Sold' ? 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-600' :
                              'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                            }`}>{crop.status}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <InfoCard label={language === 'bn' ? 'মূল ফসল' : 'Primary Crops'} value={(user.primaryCrops || ['Rice', 'Vegetables']).join(', ')} icon={<Sprout className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />} />
                    <InfoCard label={language === 'bn' ? 'জমির আকার' : 'Farm Area'} value={`${user.farmSizeAcres || 4.5} acres`} icon={<MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />} />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {user.role === 'businessman' && (
                <>
                  <SectionHeader icon={<FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />} title={language === 'bn' ? 'আমার ক্রয় চাহিদা' : 'My Purchase Demands'} />
                  {businessDemands.length === 0 ? (
                    <EmptyState message={language === 'bn' ? 'এখনো কোনো চাহিদা পোস্ট করা হয়নি' : 'No demands posted yet'} />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {businessDemands.map((d) => (
                        <div key={d.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-stone-50 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 text-xs">
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-stone-900">{d.cropNeeded}</span>
                            <span className="text-stone-500 ml-2">{d.cropBangla}</span>
                            <p className="text-stone-500 text-[11px]">{d.businessName} • {d.district}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-right">
                            <span className="font-bold text-blue-700 block">৳{d.targetPricePerKg}/kg</span>
                            <span className="text-stone-500">{d.quantityKgNeeded} kg</span>
                            {d.urgent && <span className="ml-1 text-red-600 font-bold text-[10px]">⚡ Urgent</span>}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <InfoCard label={language === 'bn' ? 'ব্যবসার ধরন' : 'Business Type'} value={user.businessType || 'Wholesaler'} icon={<Briefcase className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />} />
                </>
              )}

              {user.role === 'supplier' && (
                <>
                  <SectionHeader icon={<Package className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />} title={language === 'bn' ? 'আমার পণ্য ক্যাটালগ' : 'My Product Catalog'} />
                  {supplierProducts.length === 0 ? (
                    <EmptyState message={language === 'bn' ? 'এখনো কোনো পণ্য যুক্ত করা হয়নি' : 'No products added yet'} />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      {supplierProducts.map((p) => (
                        <div key={p.id} className="p-3 bg-stone-50 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 text-xs space-y-1">
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="font-bold text-stone-900">{p.name}</span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-amber-700">৳{p.unitPriceBDT}/{p.unit}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-stone-500">
                            <span>{p.brand}</span>
                            <span>•</span>
                            <span>{p.category}</span>
                            <span className={`ml-auto px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${p.inStock ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>
                              {p.inStock ? 'In Stock' : 'Out'}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-2">
                    {user.shopName && <InfoCard label={language === 'bn' ? 'দোকানের নাম' : 'Shop Name'} value={user.shopName} icon={<Store className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />} />}

    },
    {
      labelBn: '🌦️ বগুড়ার আগামী ২ দিনের আবহাওয়া কেমন?',
      labelEn: '🌦️ What is the 48h weather forecast for Bogura?',
    },
    {
      labelBn: '🤝 আমার ৫০০ কেজি টমেটো আছে, পাইকার ক্রেতা কে?',
      labelEn: '🤝 I have 500kg tomatoes, who are wholesale buyers?',
    },
    {
      labelBn: '🏪 শিবগঞ্জে অনুমোদিত সার ও কীটনাশক ডিলার কোথায়?',
      labelEn: '🏪 Where are certified fertilizer dealers in Shibganj?',
    },
  ];

  // Action dispatcher that maps AI actions to real app navigation
  const executeActionHandler = (actionKey: string) => {
    switch (actionKey) {
      case 'OPEN_MARKET':
      case 'CHECK_RATES':
      case 'VIEW_RATES':
        onNavigate?.('market_rates');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'OPEN_WEATHER':
        onNavigate?.('weather');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'OPEN_ORDERS':
      case 'VIEW_ORDERS':
        onNavigate?.('orders');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'OPEN_LEDGER':
        onNavigate?.('ledger');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'OPEN_DASHBOARD':
      case 'OPEN_BUYERS':
      case 'OPEN_DEALERS':
      case 'CREATE_HARVEST':
      case 'LIST_HARVEST':
      case 'LOCK_CONTRACT':
      case 'FIND_DEALERS':
      case 'CALL_DEALER':
      case 'VIEW_BUYERS':
        onNavigate?.('dashboard');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'OPEN_DOCTOR':
      case 'DIAGNOSE_CROP':
        onClose();
        onOpenCropDoctor?.();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_ROLE_FARMER':
        onSwitchRole?.('farmer');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_ROLE_BUSINESSMAN':
        onSwitchRole?.('businessman');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_ROLE_SUPPLIER':
        onSwitchRole?.('supplier');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_ROLE_CUSTOMER':
        onSwitchRole?.('customer');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_ROLE_EXPERT':
        onSwitchRole?.('expert');
        onClose();
        break;
      case 'SWITCH_LANG_BN':
      case 'SWITCH_LANG_EN':
      case 'TOGGLE_LANGUAGE':
        onToggleLanguage?.();
        break;
      default:
        onClose();
        break;
    }
  };

  const getActionDisplayName = (actionKey: string): string => {
    switch (actionKey) {
      case 'OPEN_MARKET':
      case 'CHECK_RATES':
      case 'VIEW_RATES':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'বাজার দর পৃষ্ঠায় যান' : 'Go to Market Rates';
      case 'OPEN_WEATHER':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'আবহাওয়া পৃষ্ঠায় যান' : 'Go to Weather Forecast';
      case 'OPEN_DOCTOR':
      case 'DIAGNOSE_CROP':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'ফসলের ডাক্তার খুলুন' : 'Open Crop Doctor';
      case 'OPEN_ORDERS':
      case 'VIEW_ORDERS':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'অর্ডার পৃষ্ঠায় যান' : 'Go to Orders';
      case 'OPEN_LEDGER':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'কৃষক লেজারে যান' : 'Go to Farm Ledger';
      case 'OPEN_BUYERS':
      case 'VIEW_BUYERS':

      case 'OPEN_DEALERS':
      case 'FIND_DEALERS':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'সার-কীটনাশক ডিলারদের তালিকায় যান' : 'Go to Input Dealers';
      case 'OPEN_DASHBOARD':
      case 'CREATE_HARVEST':
      case 'LIST_HARVEST':
        return language === 'bn' ? 'ড্যাশবোর্ডে যান' : 'Go to Dashboard';
      default:
        return language === 'bn' ? 'পৃষ্ঠা খুলুন' : 'Open Page';
    }
  };

  const handleSendQuery = async (queryText: string) => {
    if (!queryText.trim()) return;

    const userMsg = queryText.trim();
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, { sender: 'user', text: userMsg }]);
    setQuery('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res: VoiceAssistantResponse = await requestVoiceAssistant(
        userMsg,
        currentRole,
        selectedDistrict,
        language
      );
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          sender: 'ai',
          text: res.reply,
          actions: res.suggestedActions,
          executeAction: res.executeAction,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMicToggle = () => {
    if (!speechSupported) return;
    const SpeechAPI = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;

    if (isListening) {
      recognitionRef.current?.stop();
      setIsListening(false);
      return;
    }

    const recognition = new SpeechAPI();
    recognition.lang = language === 'bn' ? 'bn-BD' : 'en-US';
    recognition.continuous = false;
    recognition.interimResults = false;

    recognition.onstart = () => setIsListening(true);
    recognition.onerror = () => setIsListening(false);
    recognition.onend = () => setIsListening(false);

    recognition.onresult = (event: any) => {
      const transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
      setQuery(transcript);
      setIsListening(false);
      // Allows user to review and correct recognized text in the input box before manual submission
    };

    recognitionRef.current = recognition;
    recognition.start();
  };

  return (

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs transition-colors ${isListening ? 'bg-red-500 animate-pulse' : 'bg-teal-600'}`}>
              <Mic className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-stone-900 text-base">
                {language === 'bn' ? 'নেটিভবাজার ভয়েস ও চ্যাট সহকারী' : 'NativeBazar Bilingual Voice AI'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                {language === 'bn'
                  ? 'সহজ বাংলায় কথা বলুন বা কমান্ড দিন — যেমন "বাজার দর দেখাও"'
                  : 'Speak Bangla or type commands — e.g. "Show market rates"'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600 font-bold text-sm p-1 rounded-lg"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Chat Stream */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-4 space-y-3.5 pr-1">
          {messages.map((m, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className={`flex items-start gap-2.5 ${m.sender === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
            >
              {m.sender === 'ai' && (
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-teal-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-xs shadow-2xs">
                  <Bot className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
              )}

              <div
                className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-xs ${
                  m.sender === 'user'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-br-none'
                    : 'bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 rounded-bl-none border border-stone-200/70'
                }`}
              >
                <p className="leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{m.text}</p>

                {/* Direct executable action banner if matched */}
                {m.executeAction && (
                  <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-stone-200">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => executeActionHandler(m.executeAction!)}
                      className="w-full bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{getActionDisplayName(m.executeAction)}</span>

                )}

                {/* Suggested clickable action button - strictly one relevant action without duplicates */}

                    {m.actions.slice(0, 1).map((act, i) => (
                      <button
                        key={i}
                        onClick={() => executeActionHandler(act.action)}
                        className="bg-white hover:bg-teal-50 text-teal-800 border border-teal-300 font-bold text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <span>{act.label}</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3 text-teal-600" />
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {m.sender === 'user' && (
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-emerald-800 text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-xs">
                  <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>

            </div>

          <div ref={chatBottomRef} />

        {/* Quick Prompts */}
        <div className="pt-2 pb-3 border-t border-stone-200">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-400 block mb-1.5">
            {language === 'bn' ? 'নমুনা কমান্ড ও প্রশ্ন:' : 'Sample Commands & Queries:'}
          </span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {quickPrompts.map((p, i) => (
              <button
                key={i}
                onClick={() => handleSendQuery(language === 'bn' ? p.labelBn : p.labelEn)}
                className="bg-stone-50 hover:bg-teal-50 hover:border-teal-300 border border-stone-200 text-stone-700 text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors"
              >
                {language === 'bn' ? p.labelBn : p.labelEn}
              </button>
            ))}

          {/* Mic button */}

              className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl shrink-0 transition-all shadow-xs ${
                isListening

                  : 'bg-stone-100 hover:bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 border border-stone-200'

              className="p-2.5 rounded-xl shrink-0 bg-stone-100 text-stone-400 border border-stone-200 cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <MicOff className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          )}

            type="text"
            value={query}

                ? (language === 'bn' ? '🎙️ শুনছি... বলুন' : '🎙️ Listening... speak now')

                : 'Type query or tap mic to speak...'
            }
            className="flex-1 text-xs border border-stone-300 rounded-xl p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:outline-hidden"
          />

          <button
            onClick={() => handleSendQuery(query)}
            disabled={!query.trim() || loading}
            className="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-white p-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors shrink-0 shadow-xs"
          >
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Speech notice */}

          <p className="text-[10px] text-stone-400 text-center mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
            {language === 'bn'

              : 'Voice recognition best supported on Chrome/Edge'}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Language, WeatherData } from '../types';
import { fetchWeather } from '../services/weatherService';
import {
  Cloud, Wind, Droplets, Thermometer, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2,
  Sprout, RefreshCw, MapPin, Sun, CloudRain,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface WeatherViewProps {
  district: string;
  language: Language;
}

function WeatherCode({ code }: { code: number }) {
  const icons: Record<number, string> = {
    0:'☀️',1:'🌤️',2:'⛅',3:'☁️',45:'🌫️',48:'🌫️',
    51:'🌦️',61:'🌧️',63:'🌧️',65:'⛈️',80:'🌦️',95:'⛈️',
  };
  const closest = Object.keys(icons).reduce((prev, curr) =>
    Math.abs(Number(curr) - code) < Math.abs(Number(prev) - code) ? curr : prev
  );
  return <span>{icons[Number(closest)] || '🌡️'}</span>;
}

const SEVERITY_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  high:   'bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-800',
  medium: 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-800',
  low:    'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800',
};

const ALERT_ICONS: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
  disease_risk: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
  frost:        <Thermometer className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
  flood:        <CloudRain className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 flex-shrink-0" />,
  heatwave:     <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
  ideal:        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
  fog:          <Cloud className="w-4 h-4 text-stone-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
  drought:      <Droplets className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 flex-shrink-0" />,
};

const DAY_NAMES_BN = ['রবি', 'সোম', 'মঙ্গল', 'বুধ', 'বৃহঃ', 'শুক্র', 'শনি'];
const DAY_NAMES_EN = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];

export const WeatherView: React.FC<WeatherViewProps> = ({ district, language }) => {
  const [weather, setWeather] = useState<WeatherData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => language === 'bn' ? bn : en;

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await fetchWeather(district);
      setWeather(data);
    } catch {
      setError(t('Failed to load weather data', 'আবহাওয়ার তথ্য লোড করতে ব্যর্থ'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [district]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="h-48 skeleton rounded-2xl" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-24 skeleton rounded-xl" />)}
        </div>
        <div className="h-40 skeleton rounded-2xl" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !weather) {
    return (
      <div className="card p-8 text-center">
        <AlertTriangle className="w-12 h-12 text-amber-400 mx-auto mb-3" />
        <h3 className="font-bold text-stone-800 mb-1">{t('Weather Unavailable', 'আবহাওয়া পাওয়া যাচ্ছে না')}</h3>
        <p className="text-stone-500 text-sm mb-4">{error}</p>
        <button onClick={load} className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors">
          {t('Retry', 'আবার চেষ্টা করুন')}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      {/* Hero Weather Card */}
      <div className="hero-banner text-white">
        <div className="relative z-10">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="text-6xl leading-none">{weather.icon}</div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-200 text-sm font-semibold">{district}, Bangladesh</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-6xl font-black leading-none">{weather.temperature}°C</div>
                <p className="text-emerald-100 mt-1 font-medium">
                  {language === 'bn' ? weather.descriptionBn : weather.description}

        </h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2">
          {weather.forecast.map((day, i) => {
            const date = new Date(day.date);
            const dow  = date.getDay();
            const isToday = i === 0;

                {day.precipitation > 0 && (

import {
  Language,
  User,
  MarketplaceProduct,
  SupplyChainOrder,
  WholesalerOffer,
} from '../types';
import { productApi, orderApi, intelligenceApi } from '../services/api';
import { NotificationStore } from '../data/store';

  Building2,

} from 'lucide-react';

interface WholesalerDashboardProps {
  currentUser: User;
  language: Language;
}

type WholesalerTabId = 'procure_crops' | 'my_inventory' | 'retailer_orders' | 'post_tender';

export const WholesalerDashboard: React.FC<WholesalerDashboardProps> = ({
  currentUser,
  language,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<WholesalerTabId>('procure_crops');

  // Tab 1: Browse Farmer Harvests (Procure from Farmers)
  const [farmerCrops, setFarmerCrops] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [cropsLoading, setCropsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [cropSearch, setCropSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedDistrict, setSelectedDistrict] = useState('All');

  // Purchase Modal (Wholesaler buys from Farmer)
  const [selectedCropToBuy, setSelectedCropToBuy] = useState<MarketplaceProduct | null>(null);
  const [purchaseQtyKg, setPurchaseQtyKg] = useState(100);
  const [deliveryHub, setDeliveryHub] = useState(
    currentUser.upazila ? `${currentUser.upazila}, ${currentUser.district} Arat Hub` : 'Mahasthangarh Mokam Hub'
  );
  const [submittingPurchase, setSubmittingPurchase] = useState(false);

  // Tab 2: My Wholesale Stock & Listings for Retailers
  const [myWholesaleListings, setMyWholesaleListings] = useState<MarketplaceProduct[]>([]);
  const [myListingsLoading, setMyListingsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showAddBatchModal, setShowAddBatchModal] = useState(false);
  const [newBatchForm, setNewBatchForm] = useState({
    cropName: 'Diamond Potato',
    banglaName: 'ডায়মন্ড আলু (পাইকারি)',
    category: 'Tubers',
    variety: 'Table Grade A',
    quantityKg: 2000,
    minOrderKg: 100,
    pricePerKg: 32,
    qualityGrade: 'A' as 'A' | 'B' | 'C',
    farmerOrigin: 'Shibganj Farmer Cooperatives, Bogura',
    imageUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518977676601-b53f82aba655?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    description: 'Bulk wholesale lot procured directly from verified Bogura farm gates.',
  });

  // Tab 3: Orders received from Retailers
  const [retailerOrders, setRetailerOrders] = useState<SupplyChainOrder[]>([]);
  const [ordersLoading, setOrdersLoading] = useState(false);

  // Tab 4: Post Procurement Tender / Bid for Farmers
  const [tenderForm, setTenderForm] = useState({
    cropName: 'Hybrid Tomatoes',
    cropBangla: 'হাইব্রিড পাকা টমেটো',
    quantityKgNeeded: 3000,
    offeredPricePerKg: 39,
    district: currentUser.district || 'Bogura',
    upazila: currentUser.upazila || 'Shibganj',
    location: 'Mahasthangarh Highway Delivery Point',
    deadline: 'Within 7 days',
    urgent: true,
    notes: 'Grade A firm table tomatoes. Immediate payment upon crate weighing.',
  });
  const [submittingTender, setSubmittingTender] = useState(false);

  const t = (en: string, bn: string) => (language === 'bn' ? bn : en);

  // Load Farmer Harvests (Strictly sellerRole=farmer & targetRole=wholesaler)
  const loadFarmerCrops = async () => {
    setCropsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        sellerRole: 'farmer',
        targetRole: 'wholesaler',
        district: selectedDistrict !== 'All' ? selectedDistrict : undefined,
        search: cropSearch.trim() || undefined,
      });
      setFarmerCrops(res.products || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load farmer harvests', e);
    } finally {
      setCropsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load Wholesaler's Own Listings (sellerRole=wholesaler & targetRole=retailer)
  const loadMyListings = async () => {
    setMyListingsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await productApi.getProducts({
        sellerRole: 'wholesaler',
        targetRole: 'retailer',
      });
      const mine = res.products.filter(
        (p) => p.sellerId === currentUser.id || p.sellerName === currentUser.name
      );
      setMyWholesaleListings(mine.length > 0 ? mine : res.products);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load wholesaler listings', e);
    } finally {
      setMyListingsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Load Orders from Retailers
  const loadRetailerOrders = async () => {
    setOrdersLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await orderApi.getOrders({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        role: 'wholesaler',
      });
      setRetailerOrders(res.orders || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load retailer orders', e);
    } finally {
      setOrdersLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFarmerCrops();
    loadMyListings();
    loadRetailerOrders();
  }, [currentUser.id, selectedDistrict]);

  // Execute Wholesale Purchase from Farmer (Farmer -> Wholesaler)
  const handleExecuteFarmerPurchase = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedCropToBuy) return;

    if (purchaseQtyKg > selectedCropToBuy.availableKg) {
      alert(t('Quantity exceeds available farm stock.', 'চাহিদার পরিমাণ মজুদ ফসলের চেয়ে বেশি।'));
      return;

    setSubmittingPurchase(true);

        buyerRole: 'wholesaler',
        sellerId: selectedCropToBuy.sellerId,

        sellerPhone: selectedCropToBuy.sellerPhone,
        sellerRole: 'farmer',
        items: [
          {
            productId: selectedCropToBuy.id,
            quantityKg: purchaseQtyKg,
          },
        ],
        paymentMethod: 'Bank Transfer / Arat Escrow',
        deliveryAddress: deliveryHub,
        district: selectedCropToBuy.district,
        notes: `Wholesale procurement contract by ${currentUser.businessName || currentUser.name}. Pick-up at farm gate.`,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        alert(
          t(
            `Wholesale Purchase Order placed successfully! Order #${res.order.id}. Stock reserved from Farmer.`,
            `পাইকারি ক্রয়াদেশ সফলভাবে সম্পন্ন হয়েছে! অর্ডার #${res.order.id}। কৃষকের মজুদ থেকে সংরক্ষিত।`
          )
        );
        setSelectedCropToBuy(null);
        loadFarmerCrops();
        loadMyListings();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Purchase failed');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingPurchase(false);
    }
  };

  // Publish Wholesale Batch for Retailers (Wholesaler -> Retailer)
  const handlePublishWholesaleBatch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await productApi.createProduct({
        sellerId: currentUser.id,
        sellerName: currentUser.businessName || currentUser.name,
        sellerPhone: currentUser.phone,
        sellerRole: 'wholesaler',
        targetRole: 'retailer',
        cropName: newBatchForm.cropName,
        banglaName: newBatchForm.banglaName,
        category: newBatchForm.category,
        variety: newBatchForm.variety,
        quantityKg: newBatchForm.quantityKg,
        availableKg: newBatchForm.quantityKg,
        minOrderKg: newBatchForm.minOrderKg,
        pricePerKg: newBatchForm.pricePerKg,
        qualityGrade: newBatchForm.qualityGrade,
        district: currentUser.district || 'Bogura',
        upazila: currentUser.upazila || 'Shibganj',
        locationDetails: `${currentUser.businessName || currentUser.name} Wholesale Arat Depot`,
        harvestStatus: 'Cold-chain stored / Fresh Lot',
        availableDate: 'Ready for Retailer Dispatch',
        organicCertified: false,
        imageUrl: newBatchForm.imageUrl,
        description: newBatchForm.description,
        traceability: {
          farmerOrigin: newBatchForm.farmerOrigin,
          wholesalerArat: currentUser.businessName || currentUser.name,
          procurementDate: 'Procured from verified farmer',
          safetyNote: 'Sorted and crate-packed for retail shops.',
        },
      });

      NotificationStore.addSystemNotif(
        currentUser.id,
        t('Wholesale Batch Published', 'পাইকারি লট প্রকাশিত'),
        t(

        ),
        'success'

      setShowAddBatchModal(false);
      loadMyListings();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to create wholesale batch');
    }
