import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
import path from 'path';
import crypto from 'crypto';

// Initialize SQLite Database in the workspace root
const dbPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'nativebazar.db');
export const db = new Database(dbPath);

// Enable WAL mode for high performance concurrent reads and writes
db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');
db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');

// ─── INITIALIZE DATABASE TABLES ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export function initDatabase() {
  db.exec(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      role TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      name_bn TEXT,
      phone TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      email TEXT,
      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      upazila TEXT,
      verified INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      farm_size_acres REAL,
      primary_crops TEXT,
      business_name TEXT,
      business_type TEXT,
      shop_name TEXT,
      license_number TEXT,
      trade_address TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_login_at TEXT
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      seller_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      seller_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      seller_phone TEXT,
      seller_role TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_role TEXT NOT NULL,
      crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      bangla_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL,
      variety TEXT,
      quantity_kg REAL NOT NULL,
      available_kg REAL NOT NULL,
      min_order_kg REAL DEFAULT 1,
      price_per_kg REAL NOT NULL,
      market_price_per_kg REAL,
      quality_grade TEXT DEFAULT 'A',
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      upazila TEXT,
      location_details TEXT,
      harvest_status TEXT,
      available_date TEXT,
      organic_certified INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      image_url TEXT,
      description TEXT,
      farmer_origin TEXT,
      wholesaler_arat TEXT,
      procurement_date TEXT,
      safety_note TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      order_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      buyer_id TEXT,
      buyer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      buyer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
      buyer_email TEXT,
      buyer_role TEXT NOT NULL,
      seller_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      seller_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      seller_phone TEXT,
      seller_role TEXT NOT NULL,
      total_bdt REAL NOT NULL,
      payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
      payment_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending',
      delivery_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Confirmed',
      delivery_address TEXT NOT NULL,
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      tracking_code TEXT NOT NULL,
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      product_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      bangla_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity_kg REAL NOT NULL,
      unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
      subtotal REAL NOT NULL,
      FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wholesaler_offers (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      wholesaler_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      wholesaler_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      wholesaler_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
      business_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      crop_bangla TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity_kg_needed REAL NOT NULL,
      fulfilled_kg REAL DEFAULT 0,
      offered_price_per_kg REAL NOT NULL,
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      upazila TEXT,
      location TEXT NOT NULL,
      deadline TEXT NOT NULL,
      urgent INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      verified INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market_prices (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      district TEXT NOT NULL,
      upazila TEXT,
      market_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      market_name_bn TEXT NOT NULL,
      crop_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      bangla_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL,
      wholesale_price REAL NOT NULL,
      wholesale_dhaka REAL NOT NULL,
      retail_price REAL NOT NULL,
      unit TEXT DEFAULT 'kg',
      change_24h REAL DEFAULT 0,
      trend TEXT DEFAULT 'stable',
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_updated TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      order_id TEXT,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      amount REAL,
      actor_role TEXT,
      actor_name TEXT,
      description TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_target_role ON products(target_role);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_seller_role ON products(seller_role);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_district ON products(district);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_buyer ON orders(buyer_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_seller ON orders(seller_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_market_district ON market_prices(district);
  `);

  seedOfficialMarketPrices();
  seedWholesalerOffers();
  seedInitialProductCatalogs();
}

// ─── PASSWORD HASHING HELPER ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function hashPassword(plainText: string, salt = 'nb_secure_salt_2026'): string {
  const hash = crypto.createHmac('sha256', salt).update(plainText).digest('hex');
  return `sha256_${hash}`;
}

export function verifyPassword(plainText: string, storedHash: string, salt = 'nb_secure_salt_2026'): boolean {
  if (!storedHash) return false;
  // Support legacy store hash format or standard sha256
  if (storedHash.startsWith('sha256_')) {
    const computed = hashPassword(plainText, salt);
    if (computed === storedHash) return true;
    // Check old store custom hash
    let oldHash = 5381;
    const combined = `${salt}:${plainText}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < combined.length; i++) {
      oldHash = ((oldHash << 5) + oldHash) + combined.charCodeAt(i);
      oldHash = oldHash & oldHash;
    }
    const hex = Math.abs(oldHash).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    if (storedHash === `sha256_${hex}_${plainText.length}`) return true;
  }
  return plainText === storedHash;
}

// ─── STRICT SUPPLY CHAIN ROLE VALIDATION ────────────────────────────────────
export function validateSupplyChainTrade(buyerRole: string, sellerRole: string) {
  const bRole = (buyerRole || '').toLowerCase();
  const sRole = (sellerRole || '').toLowerCase();

  // 1. Farmer -> Wholesaler: Only wholesalers purchase from farmers
  if (sRole === 'farmer') {
    if (bRole !== 'wholesaler') {
      throw new Error(`Rule Violation: Only Wholesalers are authorized to purchase directly from Farmers. Retailers and Consumers cannot buy from farmers.`);
    }
  }
  // 2. Wholesaler -> Retailer: Only retailers purchase from wholesalers
  else if (sRole === 'wholesaler') {
    if (bRole !== 'retailer') {
      throw new Error(`Rule Violation: Only Retailers are authorized to purchase wholesale stock from Wholesalers. Consumers cannot buy from wholesalers.`);
    }
  }
  // 3. Retailer -> Consumer: Retailers sell to consumers
  else if (sRole === 'retailer') {
    if (bRole !== 'consumer' && bRole !== 'customer') {
      throw new Error(`Rule Violation: Wholesalers and Farmers cannot purchase from Retailers.`);
    }
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Invalid seller role: "${sellerRole}". Must be farmer, wholesaler, or retailer.`);
  }

  return true;
}

// ─── ORDER MANAGEMENT & ATOMIC INVENTORY DEDUCTION ─────────────────────────
export interface CreateOrderParams {
  buyerId?: string;
  buyerName: string;
  buyerPhone: string;
  buyerEmail?: string;
  buyerRole: string;
  sellerId: string;
  sellerName: string;
  sellerPhone?: string;
  sellerRole: string;
  items: Array<{
    productId: string;
    quantityKg: number;
  }>;
  paymentMethod: string;
  deliveryAddress: string;
  district: string;
  notes?: string;
}

export function executeOrderTransaction(params: CreateOrderParams) {
  // 1. Validate supply chain rule
  validateSupplyChainTrade(params.buyerRole, params.sellerRole);

  const orderId = `ORD-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;
  const trackingCode = `TRK-${params.district.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`;
  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

  let orderType = 'retailer_to_consumer';
  if (params.sellerRole === 'farmer') orderType = 'farmer_to_wholesaler';
  else if (params.sellerRole === 'wholesaler') orderType = 'wholesaler_to_retailer';

  // Atomic SQLite transaction
  const performTransaction = db.transaction(() => {
    let grandTotal = 0;
    const processedItems: any[] = [];

    const getProductStmt = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?');
    const updateProductStockStmt = db.prepare('UPDATE products SET available_kg = available_kg - ? WHERE id = ?');
    const insertOrderItemStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO order_items (id, order_id, product_id, crop_name, bangla_name, quantity_kg, unit_price, subtotal)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);

    // 1. First validate all items and calculate grand total
    for (const item of params.items) {
      const prod = getProductStmt.get(item.productId) as any;
      if (!prod) {
        throw new Error(`Product with ID "${item.productId}" not found.`);
      }

      if (prod.seller_role !== params.sellerRole) {
        throw new Error(`Product seller role (${prod.seller_role}) does not match order seller (${params.sellerRole}).`);
      }

      if (item.quantityKg <= 0) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid requested quantity for "${prod.crop_name}": ${item.quantityKg} kg.`);
      }

      if (prod.available_kg < item.quantityKg) {
        throw new Error(`Insufficient stock for "${prod.crop_name}". Available: ${prod.available_kg} kg, Requested: ${item.quantityKg} kg.`);
      }

      const subtotal = prod.price_per_kg * item.quantityKg;
      grandTotal += subtotal;
    }

    // 2. Insert parent order record BEFORE child order items to satisfy foreign key constraint
    const insertOrderStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO orders (
        id, order_type, buyer_id, buyer_name, buyer_phone, buyer_email, buyer_role,
        seller_id, seller_name, seller_phone, seller_role, total_bdt, payment_method,
        payment_status, delivery_status, delivery_address, district, tracking_code, notes,
        created_at, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
      )
    `);

    insertOrderStmt.run(
      orderId,
      orderType,
      params.buyerId || 'guest-consumer',
      params.buyerName,
      params.buyerPhone,
      params.buyerEmail || null,
      params.buyerRole,
      params.sellerId,
      params.sellerName,
      params.sellerPhone || null,
      params.sellerRole,
      grandTotal,
      params.paymentMethod,
      params.paymentMethod === 'Cash on Delivery' ? 'Pending' : 'Escrow Held',
      'Confirmed',
      params.deliveryAddress,
      params.district,
      trackingCode,
      params.notes || null,
      nowIso,
      nowIso
    );

    // 3. Insert order items and deduct inventory
    for (const item of params.items) {
      const prod = getProductStmt.get(item.productId) as any;
      const subtotal = prod.price_per_kg * item.quantityKg;

      // Deduct stock immediately within transaction
      const updateResult = updateProductStockStmt.run(item.quantityKg, item.productId);
      if (updateResult.changes === 0) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to deduct inventory for product ${item.productId}.`);
      }

      const itemId = `item-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000)}`;
      insertOrderItemStmt.run(
        itemId,
        orderId,
        prod.id,
        prod.crop_name,
        prod.bangla_name,
        item.quantityKg,
        prod.price_per_kg,
        subtotal
      );

      processedItems.push({
        id: itemId,
        productId: prod.id,
        cropName: prod.crop_name,
        banglaName: prod.bangla_name,
        quantityKg: item.quantityKg,
        unitPrice: prod.price_per_kg,
        subtotal,
      });
    }

    // Audit log
    const auditStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, order_id, type, amount, actor_role, actor_name, description, created_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    auditStmt.run(
      `aud-${Date.now()}`,
      orderId,
      'ORDER_CREATED',
      grandTotal,
      params.buyerRole,
      params.buyerName,
      `${orderType} trade executed. ${processedItems.length} items. Total: ৳${grandTotal}. Tracking: ${trackingCode}`,
      nowIso
    );

    return {
      orderId,
      orderType,
      trackingCode,
      totalBDT: grandTotal,
      items: processedItems,
      deliveryStatus: 'Confirmed',
      paymentStatus: params.paymentMethod === 'Cash on Delivery' ? 'Pending' : 'Escrow Held',
      createdAt: nowIso,
    };
  });

  return performTransaction();
}

// ─── ORDER CANCELLATION & INVENTORY RESTORATION ────────────────────────────
export function cancelOrderAndRestoreStock(orderId: string, actorName = 'User', actorRole = 'buyer') {
  const cancelTx = db.transaction(() => {
    const orderStmt = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?');
    const order = orderStmt.get(orderId) as any;
    if (!order) throw new Error(`Order ${orderId} not found.`);

    if (order.delivery_status === 'Cancelled') {
      return { success: true, message: 'Order was already cancelled.' };
    }

    if (order.delivery_status === 'Delivered') {
      throw new Error('Cannot cancel an order that has already been delivered.');
    }

    // Get items to restore stock
    const itemsStmt = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?');
    const items = itemsStmt.all(orderId) as any[];

    const restoreStockStmt = db.prepare('UPDATE products SET available_kg = available_kg + ? WHERE id = ?');
    for (const it of items) {
      restoreStockStmt.run(it.quantity_kg, it.product_id);
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare('UPDATE orders SET delivery_status = ?, payment_status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?')
      .run('Cancelled', 'Refunded', nowIso, orderId);

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, order_id, type, amount, actor_role, actor_name, description, created_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      `aud-${Date.now()}`,
      orderId,
      'ORDER_CANCELLED',
      order.total_bdt,
      actorRole,
      actorName,
      `Order ${orderId} cancelled by ${actorName}. Stock restored for ${items.length} items.`,
      nowIso
    );

    return { success: true, orderId, status: 'Cancelled' };
  });

  return cancelTx();
}

const API_BASE_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');

async function fetchWithTimeout(url: string, options: RequestInit, timeoutMs = 15000): Promise<Response> {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(timer);
    return res;
  } catch (err) {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * NativeBazar API Client
 * Persistent database-backed REST communications with the backend Express / SQLite server.
 */

import { MarketplaceProduct, SupplyChainOrder, WholesalerOffer, User, MarketRate } from '../types';

const BASE_URL = '';

async function fetchJson<T>(url: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${url}`, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...options?.headers,
    },
    ...options,
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    let errMsg = `Request failed: ${res.statusText}`;
    try {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data && data.error) errMsg = data.error;
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
    throw new Error(errMsg);
  }

  return res.json();
}

// ─── AUTHENTICATION API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const authApi = {
  async register(userData: {
    role: string;
    name: string;
    phone: string;
    password: string;
    email?: string;
    district?: string;
    upazila?: string;
    farmSizeAcres?: number;
    primaryCrops?: string[];
    businessName?: string;
    businessType?: string;
    shopName?: string;
    licenseNumber?: string;
  }): Promise<{ success: boolean; user: User; message?: string }> {
    return fetchJson('/api/auth/register', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(userData),
    });
  },

  async login(credentials: {
    identifier: string;
    password: string;
    role?: string;
  }): Promise<{ success: boolean; user: User }> {
    return fetchJson('/api/auth/login', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(credentials),
    });
  },

  async adminLogin(adminCredentials: {
    username: string;
    password: string;
    securityPin?: string;
  }): Promise<{ success: boolean; user: User }> {
    return fetchJson('/api/auth/admin-login', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(adminCredentials),
    });
  },
};

// ─── PRODUCTS MARKETPLACE API ────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const productApi = {
  async getProducts(params?: {
    targetRole?: string;
    sellerRole?: string;
    district?: string;
    category?: string;
    search?: string;
  }): Promise<{ products: MarketplaceProduct[]; total: number }> {
    const query = new URLSearchParams();
    if (params?.targetRole) query.set('targetRole', params.targetRole);
    if (params?.sellerRole) query.set('sellerRole', params.sellerRole);
    if (params?.district && params.district !== 'All') query.set('district', params.district);
    if (params?.category && params.category !== 'All') query.set('category', params.category);
    if (params?.search) query.set('search', params.search);

    const qs = query.toString();
    return fetchJson(`/api/products${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
  },

  async createProduct(productData: Partial<MarketplaceProduct>): Promise<{ success: boolean; productId: string; targetRole: string }> {
    return fetchJson('/api/products', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify(productData),
    });
  },

  async updateProduct(id: string, updates: Partial<MarketplaceProduct>): Promise<{ success: boolean }> {
    return fetchJson(`/api/products/${id}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      body: JSON.stringify(updates),
    });
  },

  async deleteProduct(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean }> {
    return fetchJson(`/api/products/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
    });
  },
};

    userId?: string;

    if (params?.role) query.set('role', params.role);
    if (params?.sellerId) query.set('sellerId', params.sellerId);

import { User, CropListing, SupplierProduct, CustomerOrder, DirectMessage, UserConnection, Notification, CallLog } from '../types';
import { CatalogProduct } from '../data/catalogData';

const BASE_URL = '/api';

export interface RegisterPayload {
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  email?: string;
  password: string;
  role: 'farmer' | 'supplier' | 'customer';
  district: string;
  upazila?: string;
  farmSizeAcres?: number;
  primaryCrops?: string[];
  shopName?: string;
  licenseNumber?: string;
  isOrganicCertified?: boolean;
}

export interface LoginPayload {
  identifier: string;
  password: string;
  role?: string;
  securityPin?: string;
}

export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  user?: User;
  token?: string;
  crop?: CropListing;
  crops?: CropListing[];
  product?: SupplierProduct;
  products?: SupplierProduct[];
  order?: CustomerOrder;
  orders?: CustomerOrder[];
  trackingCode?: string;
  stats?: any;
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
  require2FA?: boolean;
  locked?: boolean;
  remainingSeconds?: number;
}

export const apiService = {
  // ── Auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async register(payload: RegisterPayload): Promise<ApiResponse<{ user: User; token: string }>> {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/auth/register`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      return data;
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Network error' };
    }
  },

  async login(payload: LoginPayload): Promise<ApiResponse<{ user: User; token: string }>> {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/auth/login`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      return data;
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Network error' };
    }
  },

  async getMe(token?: string, phone?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ user: User }>> {
    try {
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
      if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
      const query = phone ? `?phone=${encodeURIComponent(phone)}` : '';
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/auth/me${query}`, { headers });
      return await res.json();
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  // ── User Directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async getUsers(filter?: {
    excludeId?: string;
    role?: string;
    district?: string;
    search?: string;
  }): Promise<{ success: boolean; users: User[]; total: number }> {
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (filter?.excludeId) params.append('excludeId', filter.excludeId);
      if (filter?.role && filter.role !== 'all') params.append('role', filter.role);
      if (filter?.district && filter.district !== 'all') params.append('district', filter.district);
      if (filter?.search && filter.search.trim()) params.append('search', filter.search.trim());
      const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/users?${params.toString()}`);
      return await res.json();
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, users: [], total: 0 };
    }
  },

  async updateProfile(updates: Partial<User>): Promise<ApiResponse<{ user: User }>> {

export function resolveDistrictKey(districtInput: string): string | null {
  if (!districtInput || !districtInput.trim()) return null;
  const clean = districtInput.trim().toLowerCase();

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(BANGLADESH_DISTRICT_COORDS)) {
    if (key.toLowerCase() === clean || val.bn.toLowerCase() === clean) return key;
    if (val.aliases.some((a) => a.toLowerCase() === clean)) return key;
  }
  return null;
}

// WMO weather codes to descriptions
const WEATHER_CODES: Record<number, { en: string; bn: string; icon: string }> = {

function getWeatherDesc(code: number) {
  return WEATHER_CODES[code] || { en: 'Unknown', bn: 'অজানা', icon: '🌡️' };
}

// Generate crop weather alerts from weather data
function generateCropAlerts(
  temp: number,
  humidity: number,
  weatherCode: number,
  precipitation7d: number
): CropWeatherAlert[] {
  const alerts: CropWeatherAlert[] = [];
  const isFoggy   = weatherCode === 45 || weatherCode === 48;
  const isRainy   = weatherCode >= 51 && weatherCode <= 82;
  const isHot     = temp > 35;
  const isCold    = temp < 12;
  const isHumid   = humidity > 85;

  if (isFoggy || (isHumid && temp < 22)) {
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'Potato', cropBn: 'আলু',
      alertType: 'disease_risk',
      message: 'Late blight (Phytophthora) risk is HIGH due to fog and high humidity. Apply preventive Mancozeb spray immediately.',
      messageBn: 'কুয়াশা ও আর্দ্রতার কারণে আলুতে নাবি ধসা (লেইট ব্লাইট) ঝুঁকি বেশি। এখনই ম্যানকোজেব স্প্রে করুন।',
      severity: 'high',
    });
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'Tomato', cropBn: 'টমেটো',
      alertType: 'disease_risk',
      message: 'Early blight risk elevated. Increase plant spacing and avoid evening irrigation.',
      messageBn: 'টমেটোতে আগাম ধসা রোগের ঝুঁকি বেড়েছে। সন্ধ্যায় পানি দেওয়া বন্ধ রাখুন।',
      severity: 'medium',
    });
  }

  if (isHot) {
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'Cauliflower', cropBn: 'ফুলকপি',
      alertType: 'heatwave',
      message: `Temperature ${temp}°C is too high for cauliflower curd development. Shade netting recommended.`,
      messageBn: `তাপমাত্রা ${temp}°C ফুলকপির কার্ড তৈরির জন্য অনেক বেশি। ছায়াজাল ব্যবহার করুন।`,
      severity: 'high',
    });
  }

  if (isCold) {
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'Tomato', cropBn: 'টমেটো',
      alertType: 'frost',
      message: `Temperature ${temp}°C may cause flower drop. Avoid stress irrigation.`,
      messageBn: `তাপমাত্রা ${temp}°C টমেটোর ফুল ঝরিয়ে দিতে পারে। সেচ কমান।`,
      severity: 'medium',
    });
  }

  if (isRainy && precipitation7d > 50) {
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'Green Chili', cropBn: 'কাঁচা মরিচ',
      alertType: 'flood',
      message: 'Heavy rainfall may cause waterlogging. Ensure field drainage and harvest ripe chilies urgently.',
      messageBn: 'অতিবৃষ্টিতে জলাবদ্ধতার আশঙ্কা। মাঠের পানি নিষ্কাশন নিশ্চিত করুন এবং পাকা মরিচ দ্রুত তুলুন।',
      severity: 'high',
    });
  }

  if (!isFoggy && !isRainy && temp >= 18 && temp <= 28 && humidity >= 60 && humidity <= 75) {
    alerts.push({
      crop: 'All Vegetables', cropBn: 'সব সবজি',
      alertType: 'ideal',
      message: 'Excellent growing conditions today. Ideal for fertilizer application and transplanting.',
      messageBn: 'আজকের আবহাওয়া চাষাবাদের জন্য আদর্শ। সার প্রয়োগ ও চারা রোপণের উপযুক্ত সময়।',
      severity: 'low',
    });
  }

  return alerts;
}

// Cache to avoid excessive API calls
let weatherCache: { district: string; data: WeatherData; fetchedAt: number } | null = null;
const CACHE_TTL = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes

export async function fetchWeather(district = 'Bogura'): Promise<WeatherData> {
  const resolvedKey = resolveDistrictKey(district) || 'Bogura';

  // Return cached data if fresh
  if (weatherCache && weatherCache.district === resolvedKey && Date.now() - weatherCache.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL) {
    return weatherCache.data;
  }

  const coords = BANGLADESH_DISTRICT_COORDS[resolvedKey];

  try {
    // 1. Try our backend proxy first
    const proxyRes = await fetch(`/api/weather/${encodeURIComponent(resolvedKey)}`).catch(() => null);
    if (proxyRes && proxyRes.ok) {
      const json = await proxyRes.json();
      if (json.success && json.data) {
        const cur = json.data.current_weather || json.data.current;
        const day = json.data.daily;
        const temp = Math.round(cur.temperature || cur.temperature_2m);
        const humidity = cur.relative_humidity_2m || 70;
        const code = cur.weathercode !== undefined ? cur.weathercode : cur.weather_code;
        const desc = getWeatherDesc(code);

        const forecast: WeatherForecastDay[] = (day.time as string[]).slice(0, 7).map((date: string, i: number) => ({
          date,
          maxTemp: Math.round(day.temperature_2m_max[i]),
          minTemp: Math.round(day.temperature_2m_min[i]),
          precipitation: parseFloat((day.precipitation_sum[i] || 0).toFixed(1)),
          weatherCode: day.weathercode ? day.weathercode[i] : day.weather_code[i],
        }));

        const precipitation7d = forecast.reduce((s, d) => s + d.precipitation, 0);
        const cropAlerts = generateCropAlerts(temp, humidity, code, precipitation7d);

        const data: WeatherData = {
          temperature: temp,
          humidity,
          windSpeed: Math.round(cur.windspeed || cur.wind_speed_10m || 10),
          weatherCode: code,
          description: desc.en,
          descriptionBn: desc.bn,
          icon: desc.icon,
          forecast,
          cropAlerts,
        };

        weatherCache = { district: resolvedKey, data, fetchedAt: Date.now() };
        return data;
      }
    }

    // 2. Direct Open-Meteo fallback
    const url = new URL('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast');
    url.searchParams.set('latitude',         String(coords.lat));
    url.searchParams.set('longitude',        String(coords.lon));
    url.searchParams.set('current',          'temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m');
    url.searchParams.set('daily',            'weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum');
    url.searchParams.set('forecast_days',    '7');
    url.searchParams.set('timezone',         'Asia/Dhaka');

    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);

    const json = await res.json();
    const cur  = json.current;
    const day  = json.daily;

    const temp     = Math.round(cur.temperature_2m);
    const humidity = cur.relative_humidity_2m;
    const code     = cur.weather_code;
    const desc     = getWeatherDesc(code);

    const forecast: WeatherForecastDay[] = (day.time as string[]).slice(0, 7).map((date: string, i: number) => ({
      date,
      maxTemp:       Math.round(day.temperature_2m_max[i]),
      minTemp:       Math.round(day.temperature_2m_min[i]),
      precipitation: parseFloat((day.precipitation_sum[i] || 0).toFixed(1)),
      weatherCode:   day.weather_code[i],
    }));

    const precipitation7d = forecast.reduce((s, d) => s + d.precipitation, 0);
    const cropAlerts = generateCropAlerts(temp, humidity, code, precipitation7d);

    const data: WeatherData = {
      temperature:   temp,
      humidity,
      windSpeed:     Math.round(cur.wind_speed_10m),
      weatherCode:   code,
      description:   desc.en,
      descriptionBn: desc.bn,
      icon:          desc.icon,
      forecast,
      cropAlerts,
    };

    weatherCache = { district: resolvedKey, data, fetchedAt: Date.now() };
    return data;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Weather API fallback:', err);
    // Return reasonable fallback for Bangladesh October conditions
    return {
      temperature:   28,
      humidity:      72,
      windSpeed:     12,
      weatherCode:   1,
      description:   'Mainly clear',
      descriptionBn: 'প্রধানত পরিষ্কার',
      icon:          '🌤️',
      forecast: Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => ({
        date:          new Date(Date.now() + i * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
        maxTemp:       30 - i,
        minTemp:       18 + i % 3,
        precipitation: i === 3 || i === 5 ? 12 : 0,
        weatherCode:   i === 3 || i === 5 ? 63 : 1,
      })),
      cropAlerts: [
        {
          crop: 'Potato', cropBn: 'আলু',
          alertType: 'disease_risk',
          message: 'Monitor for late blight as October fog season approaches.',
          messageBn: 'অক্টোবরের কুয়াশায় আলুতে লেইট ব্লাইটের দিকে নজর রাখুন।',
          severity: 'medium',
        }
      ],
    };
  }
}

  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  };

  // Normalized canonical role
  const canonicalRole = currentUser ? normalizeRole(currentUser.role) : 'consumer';

  const switchRole = (newRole: UserRole) => {
    if (!currentUser) {
      setIsAuthOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    const normNewRole = normalizeRole(newRole);
    if (normNewRole === canonicalRole) return;

    }

    const identifier = currentUser.email || currentUser.phone || '';
    const hasAccount = AuthStore.hasRoleAccount(identifier, normNewRole);

    if (!hasAccount) {
      setPendingRole(normNewRole);

      return;

      setRoleSwitchError(
        language === 'bn'

            <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-amber-800 font-medium">
              {language === 'bn'
                ? 'নিরাপত্তার জন্য প্রতিটি ভূমিকা পরিবর্তনে পাসওয়ার্ড যাচাই বাধ্যতামূলক।'
                : 'Password verification is required before switching to another account role.'}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-stone-500 uppercase mb-1.5">
                {language === 'bn' ? 'পাসওয়ার্ড' : 'Password'}
              </label>
              <input
                type="password"
                value={roleSwitchPwd}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setRoleSwitchPwd(e.target.value);
                  setRoleSwitchError('');
                }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && confirmRoleSwitch()}
                placeholder={language === 'bn' ? 'পাসওয়ার্ড লিখুন…' : 'Enter password…'}
                autoFocus
                className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 text-sm border border-stone-200 rounded-xl bg-white text-stone-900 font-medium focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400"
              />
              {roleSwitchError && (
                <p className="text-red-600 text-[11px] font-bold mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>⚠</span> {roleSwitchError}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={confirmRoleSwitch}
                className="flex-1 bg-stone-900 text-white py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-stone-800 transition-all"
              >
                {language === 'bn' ? 'যাচাই করুন' : 'Verify & Switch'}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setPendingRole(null);
                  setRoleSwitchPwd('');
                  setRoleSwitchError('');
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold hover:bg-stone-200"
              >
                {language === 'bn' ? 'বাতিল' : 'Cancel'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Admin Email+Password Verification Modal */}
      <AdminVerificationModal
        isOpen={isAdminVerifyOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAdminVerifyOpen(false)}
        onSuccess={handleAdminVerifySuccess}
        language={language}
      />

      {/* Interactive VoIP Voice Call Modal */}
      {callingUser && currentUser && (
        <CallModal
          isOpen={!!callingUser}
          onClose={() => setCallingUser(null)}
          currentUser={currentUser}
          contactUser={callingUser}
          language={language}
        />
      )}

      {/* No Role Account Modal */}
      {noRoleModalOpen && currentUser && (
        <NoRoleAccountModal
          isOpen={noRoleModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setNoRoleModalOpen(false);
            setPendingRole(null);
          }}
          targetRole={pendingRole}
          currentUser={currentUser}
          language={language}
          onCreateRoleAccount={(role) => {
            setNoRoleModalOpen(false);
            setRoleToCreate(role);
            setCreateRoleModalOpen(true);
          }}
          onLoginDifferentAccount={() => {
            setNoRoleModalOpen(false);
            setPendingRole(null);
            AuthStore.logout();
            setCurrentUser(null);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Create Role Modal */}
      {createRoleModalOpen && currentUser && (
        <CreateRoleModal
          isOpen={createRoleModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setCreateRoleModalOpen(false);
            setRoleToCreate(null);
            setPendingRole(null);
          }}
          targetRole={roleToCreate}
          currentUser={currentUser}
          language={language}
          onSuccess={(newRoleUser) => {
            setCurrentUser(newRoleUser);
            setPendingRole(null);
            setRoleToCreate(null);
            setActiveView('dashboard');
            showToast(
              language === 'bn'
                ? `নতুন ${newRoleUser.role} অ্যাকাউন্ট তৈরি ও সক্রিয় করা হয়েছে!`
                : `New ${newRoleUser.role} account created and activated!`
            );
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Footer */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t border-stone-200 mt-12 py-6 text-xs text-stone-500">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-bold text-stone-800">NativeBazar (নেটিভবাজার)</span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span>Local Agriculture, Business & Supply Chain Platform</span>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center sm:text-right">
            <span>Bangladesh Agricultural Platform • Bogura Pilot Node • Department of Agricultural Marketing (DAM)</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── CORE TYPES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CanonicalRole = 'farmer' | 'wholesaler' | 'retailer' | 'consumer' | 'admin';
export type UserRole = CanonicalRole | 'businessman' | 'supplier' | 'customer' | 'expert';

export function normalizeRole(role: UserRole | string | undefined | null): CanonicalRole {
  if (!role) return 'consumer';
  const r = role.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (r === 'farmer') return 'farmer';
  if (r === 'wholesaler' || r === 'businessman') return 'wholesaler';
  if (r === 'retailer' || r === 'supplier') return 'retailer';
  if (r === 'consumer' || r === 'customer') return 'consumer';
  if (r === 'admin') return 'admin';
  return 'consumer';
}

export type Language = 'en' | 'bn';
export type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

// Initialize Google GenAI client if API key is present
const apiKey = process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY;
const ai = apiKey
  ? new GoogleGenAI({
      apiKey,

        headers: {

// Timeout wrapper helper to guarantee responses never hang
function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms = 15000): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new Error(`Operation timed out after ${ms}ms`));
    }, ms);
    promise
      .then((res) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(res);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(err);
      });
  });
}

// Resilient Gemini runner with automatic model fallback
async function callGemini(contents: any, config?: any, timeoutMs = 15000) {
  if (!ai) throw new Error('AI client not initialized');
  const candidateModels = ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite'];
  let lastError: any = null;

  for (const model of candidateModels) {
    try {
      const p = ai.models.generateContent({
        model,
        contents,
        config,
      });
      const response = await withTimeout(p, timeoutMs);
      if (response && response.text) {
        return response;
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn(`[Gemini] Model ${model} attempt failed:`, err?.message || err);
      lastError = err;
    }
  }

  throw lastError || new Error('All candidate AI models were unreachable');
}

// Register new user: Farmer, Wholesaler, Retailer, Consumer
app.post('/api/auth/register', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      role, name, phone, password, email = '', district = 'Bogura', upazila = '',
      farmSizeAcres, primaryCrops, businessName, businessType, shopName, licenseNumber, tradeAddress,
    } = req.body;

    const allowedRoles = ['farmer', 'wholesaler', 'retailer', 'consumer'];
    const canonicalRole = (role || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!allowedRoles.includes(canonicalRole)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: `Invalid role. Public registration permitted only for: ${allowedRoles.join(', ')}` });
    }

    if (!name || !phone || !password) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Name, phone number, and password are required.' });
    }

    if (phone.length < 9) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Please enter a valid phone number.' });
    }

    if (password.length < 6) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' });
    }

    // Check if phone is already registered
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id, role, phone FROM users WHERE phone = ?').get(phone) as any;
    if (existing) {
      return res.status(409).json({ error: `An account with phone number ${phone} is already registered (${existing.role}). Please log in.` });
    }

    const userId = `usr-${canonicalRole}-${Date.now()}`;
    const passwordHash = hashPassword(password);
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO users (
        id, role, name, phone, email, password_hash, district, upazila, verified,
        farm_size_acres, primary_crops, business_name, business_type, shop_name,
        license_number, trade_address, created_at, last_login_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?
      )
    `);

    insertStmt.run(
      userId,
      canonicalRole,
      name,
      phone,
      email || null,
      passwordHash,
      district,
      upazila || null,
      farmSizeAcres ? Number(farmSizeAcres) : null,
      primaryCrops ? (Array.isArray(primaryCrops) ? JSON.stringify(primaryCrops) : primaryCrops) : null,
      businessName || null,
      businessType || null,
      shopName || null,
      licenseNumber || null,
      tradeAddress || null,
      nowIso,
      nowIso
    );

    const safeUser = {
      id: userId,
      role: canonicalRole,
      name,
      phone,
      email,
      district,
      upazila,
      verified: true,
      farmSizeAcres: farmSizeAcres ? Number(farmSizeAcres) : undefined,
      primaryCrops: primaryCrops || undefined,
      businessName,
      businessType,
      shopName,
      licenseNumber,
      createdAt: nowIso,
      sessionToken: `nb_token_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
    };

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Registration successful!',
      user: safeUser,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Registration error:', err);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Registration failed.' });
  }
});

// Login for registered users
app.post('/api/auth/login', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { identifier, password, role } = req.body;
    if (!identifier || !password) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Phone/Email and password are required.' });
    }

    let query = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE (phone = ? OR email = ?)';
    const params: any[] = [identifier, identifier];
    if (role) {
      query += ' AND role = ?';
      params.push(role);
    }
    query += ' LIMIT 1';

    const user = db.prepare(query).get(...params) as any;
    if (!user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No account found with these credentials. Please register first.' });
    }

    const isValid = verifyPassword(password, user.password_hash);
    if (!isValid) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Incorrect password. Please try again.' });
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET last_login_at = ? WHERE id = ?').run(nowIso, user.id);

    const safeUser = {
      id: user.id,
      role: user.role,
      name: user.name,
      nameBn: user.name_bn,
      phone: user.phone,
      email: user.email,
      district: user.district,
      upazila: user.upazila,
      verified: Boolean(user.verified),
      farmSizeAcres: user.farm_size_acres,
      primaryCrops: user.primary_crops ? JSON.parse(user.primary_crops) : undefined,
      businessName: user.business_name,
      businessType: user.business_type,
      shopName: user.shop_name,
      licenseNumber: user.license_number,
      createdAt: user.created_at,
      lastLoginAt: nowIso,
      sessionToken: `nb_token_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
    };

    return res.json({
      success: true,
      user: safeUser,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Login error:', err);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Login failed.' });
  }
});

app.post('/api/auth/admin-login', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { username, password, securityPin } = req.body;
    const validUser = process.env.ADMIN_USER;
    const validPass = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
    const validPin = process.env.ADMIN_PIN;

    // Fail closed if admin credentials have not been explicitly configured in environment
    if (!validUser || !validPass || !validPin) {
      console.error('[Security] Admin login blocked: ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASSWORD, or ADMIN_PIN environment variable is not configured.');
      return res.status(503).json({ error: 'Administrator access is currently not configured or disabled.' });
    }

    const isMatch = username === validUser && password === validPass && securityPin === validPin;

    if (!isMatch) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Access Denied: Invalid administrator credentials or clearance PIN.' });
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const adminUser = {
      id: 'admin-authorized-root',

      name: 'Central Platform Administrator',
      phone: '01700000000',
      email: 'admin@nativebazar.gov.bd',
      district: 'Bogura',

      verified: true,
      createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
      lastLoginAt: nowIso,
      sessionToken: `nb_admin_token_${Date.now()}`,
    };

    return res.json({
      success: true,
      user: adminUser,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Admin login failed.' });

});

// Get products with role filtering
// Consumers ONLY see Retailer products
// Retailers ONLY see Wholesaler products
// Wholesalers ONLY see Farmer products
app.get('/api/products', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { targetRole, sellerRole, district, category, search, minAvailable = 0 } = req.query as any;

    let query = 'SELECT * FROM products WHERE available_kg > ?';
    const params: any[] = [Number(minAvailable) || 0];

    // Strict role filters
    if (targetRole) {
      query += ' AND target_role = ?';
      params.push(targetRole);
    }
    if (sellerRole) {
      query += ' AND seller_role = ?';
      params.push(sellerRole);
    }
    if (district && district !== 'All') {
      query += ' AND district = ?';
      params.push(district);
    }
    if (category && category !== 'All') {
      query += ' AND category = ?';
      params.push(category);
    }
    if (search) {
      query += ' AND (crop_name LIKE ? OR bangla_name LIKE ? OR seller_name LIKE ?)';
      params.push(`%${search}%`, `%${search}%`, `%${search}%`);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';

    const rows = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
    const mapped = rows.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      sellerId: r.seller_id,
      sellerName: r.seller_name,
      sellerPhone: r.seller_phone,
      sellerRole: r.seller_role,
      targetRole: r.target_role,
      cropName: r.crop_name,
      banglaName: r.bangla_name,
      category: r.category,
      variety: r.variety,
      quantityKg: r.quantity_kg,
      availableKg: r.available_kg,
      minOrderKg: r.min_order_kg,
      pricePerKg: r.price_per_kg,
      marketPricePerKg: r.market_price_per_kg,
      qualityGrade: r.quality_grade,
      district: r.district,
      upazila: r.upazila,
      locationDetails: r.location_details,
      harvestStatus: r.harvest_status,
      availableDate: r.available_date,
      organicCertified: Boolean(r.organic_certified),
      imageUrl: r.image_url,
      description: r.description,
      traceability: {
        farmerOrigin: r.farmer_origin,
        wholesalerArat: r.wholesaler_arat,
        procurementDate: r.procurement_date,
        safetyNote: r.safety_note,
      },
      createdAt: r.created_at,
    }));

    return res.json({ products: mapped, total: mapped.length });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching products:', err);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch products.' });
  }
});

// Publish new product: Enforces seller role restrictions
app.post('/api/products', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      sellerId, sellerName, sellerPhone = '', sellerRole, cropName, banglaName,
      category = 'Vegetables', variety = '', quantityKg, pricePerKg, marketPricePerKg,
      qualityGrade = 'A', district = 'Bogura', upazila = '', locationDetails = '',
      harvestStatus = 'Harvested Today', availableDate = 'In Stock', organicCertified = false,
      imageUrl = '', description = '', farmerOrigin = '', wholesalerArat = '',
      procurementDate = '', safetyNote = '', minOrderKg = 1,
    } = req.body;

    const sRole = (sellerRole || '').toLowerCase();
    let targetRole = 'consumer';

    // Strict supply chain mapping:
    // Farmer lists crops -> Wholesaler buys
    if (sRole === 'farmer') {
      targetRole = 'wholesaler';
    }
    // Wholesaler lists produce -> Retailer buys
    else if (sRole === 'wholesaler') {
      targetRole = 'retailer';
    }
    // Retailer lists goods -> Consumer buys
    else if (sRole === 'retailer') {
      targetRole = 'consumer';
    } else {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only Farmers, Wholesalers, and Retailers are authorized to publish products.' });
    }

    if (!cropName || !pricePerKg || !quantityKg) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Crop name, quantity, and price are required.' });
    }

    const prodId = `prod-${sRole.slice(0, 3)}-${Date.now()}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO products (
        id, seller_id, seller_name, seller_phone, seller_role, target_role,
        crop_name, bangla_name, category, variety, quantity_kg, available_kg,
        min_order_kg, price_per_kg, market_price_per_kg, quality_grade, district,
        upazila, location_details, harvest_status, available_date, organic_certified,
        image_url, description, farmer_origin, wholesaler_arat, procurement_date,
        safety_note, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?
      )
    `);

    insertStmt.run(
      prodId,
      sellerId || 'seller-1',
      sellerName || 'Verified Seller',
      sellerPhone || '',
      sRole,
      targetRole,
      cropName,
      banglaName || cropName,
      category,
      variety || '',
      Number(quantityKg),
      Number(quantityKg),
      Number(minOrderKg) || 1,
      Number(pricePerKg),
      marketPricePerKg ? Number(marketPricePerKg) : Number(pricePerKg) * 1.15,
      qualityGrade,
      district,
      upazila || '',
      locationDetails || '',
      harvestStatus,
      availableDate,
      organicCertified ? 1 : 0,
      imageUrl || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1592924357228-91a4daadcfea?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
      description || '',
      farmerOrigin || '',
      wholesalerArat || '',
      procurementDate || '',
      safetyNote || '',
      nowIso
    );

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      productId: prodId,
      targetRole,
      message: `Product successfully published for ${targetRole}s!`,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error creating product:', err);
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Failed to publish product.' });
  }
});

// Update product
app.put('/api/products/:id', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { pricePerKg, quantityKg, availableKg, qualityGrade, harvestStatus, description, imageUrl } = req.body;

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM products WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (!existing) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Product not found.' });

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE products
      SET price_per_kg = COALESCE(?, price_per_kg),
          quantity_kg = COALESCE(?, quantity_kg),
          available_kg = COALESCE(?, available_kg),
          quality_grade = COALESCE(?, quality_grade),
          harvest_status = COALESCE(?, harvest_status),
          description = COALESCE(?, description),
          image_url = COALESCE(?, image_url)
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(
      pricePerKg !== undefined ? Number(pricePerKg) : null,
      quantityKg !== undefined ? Number(quantityKg) : null,
      availableKg !== undefined ? Number(availableKg) : null,
      qualityGrade || null,
      harvestStatus || null,
      description || null,
      imageUrl || null,
      id
    );

    return res.json({ success: true, message: 'Product updated successfully.' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// ─── ORDER & SUPPLY CHAIN EXECUTION (STRICT RULES ENFORCED) ─────────────────

// Create an order: Verifies supply chain rules, reserves stock, creates tracking code
app.post('/api/orders', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      buyerId, buyerName, buyerPhone, buyerEmail, buyerRole,
      sellerId, sellerName, sellerPhone, sellerRole, items,
      paymentMethod = 'Cash on Delivery', deliveryAddress, district = 'Bogura', notes,
    } = req.body;

    if (!buyerName || !buyerPhone || !deliveryAddress) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Name, phone number, and delivery address are required.' });
    }

    if (!items || !items.length) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No items in cart to order.' });
    }

    // Execute atomic transaction with supply chain validation
    const result = executeOrderTransaction({
      buyerId,
      buyerName,
      buyerPhone,
      buyerEmail,
      buyerRole: buyerRole || 'consumer',
      sellerId,
      sellerName,
      sellerPhone,
      sellerRole,
      items,
      paymentMethod,
      deliveryAddress,
      district,
      notes,
    });

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Order confirmed successfully!',
      order: result,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Order creation error:', err.message);
    if (err.message.includes('Rule Violation')) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: err.message });
    }
    if (err.message.includes('Insufficient stock')) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: err.message });
    }
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message || 'Order execution failed.' });
  }
});

// Get orders: filtered by user or role
app.get('/api/orders', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { userId, role, sellerId, buyerId } = req.query as any;

    let query = 'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE 1=1';
    const params: any[] = [];

    if (buyerId) {
      query += ' AND buyer_id = ?';
      params.push(buyerId);
    } else if (sellerId) {
      query += ' AND seller_id = ?';
      params.push(sellerId);
    } else if (userId) {
      query += ' AND (buyer_id = ? OR seller_id = ?)';
      params.push(userId, userId);
    }

    if (role) {
      query += ' AND (buyer_role = ? OR seller_role = ?)';
      params.push(role, role);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';

    const orders = db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
    const itemsStmt = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?');

    const fullOrders = orders.map((o) => {
      const items = itemsStmt.all(o.id) as any[];
      return {
        id: o.id,
        orderType: o.order_type,
        buyerId: o.buyer_id,
        buyerName: o.buyer_name,
        buyerPhone: o.buyer_phone,
        buyerEmail: o.buyer_email,
        buyerRole: o.buyer_role,
        sellerId: o.seller_id,
        sellerName: o.seller_name,
        sellerPhone: o.seller_phone,
        sellerRole: o.seller_role,
        totalBDT: o.total_bdt,
        paymentMethod: o.payment_method,
        paymentStatus: o.payment_status,
        deliveryStatus: o.delivery_status,
        deliveryAddress: o.delivery_address,
        district: o.district,
        trackingCode: o.tracking_code,
        notes: o.notes,
        createdAt: o.created_at,
        updatedAt: o.updated_at,
        items: items.map((it) => ({
          id: it.id,
          productId: it.product_id,
          cropName: it.crop_name,
          banglaName: it.bangla_name,
          quantityKg: it.quantity_kg,
          unitPrice: it.unit_price,
          subtotal: it.subtotal,
        })),
      };
    });

    return res.json({ orders: fullOrders, total: fullOrders.length });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Update order status (or cancel with stock restoration)
app.put('/api/orders/:id/status', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const { status, actorName, actorRole } = req.body;

    if (status === 'Cancelled') {
      const cancelResult = cancelOrderAndRestoreStock(id, actorName, actorRole);
      return res.json(cancelResult);
    }

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare('UPDATE orders SET delivery_status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?').run(status, nowIso, id);

    return res.json({ success: true, message: `Order status updated to ${status}.` });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Get verified wholesaler purchase offers for farmers
app.get('/api/wholesaler-offers', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { district, crop } = req.query as any;
    let query = 'SELECT * FROM wholesaler_offers WHERE 1=1';
    const params: any[] = [];

    if (district && district !== 'All') {
      query += ' AND district = ?';
      params.push(district);
    }
    if (crop) {
      query += ' AND (crop_name LIKE ? OR crop_bangla LIKE ?)';
      params.push(`%${crop}%`, `%${crop}%`);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY urgent DESC, created_at DESC';
    const offers = db.prepare(query).all(...params);
    return res.json({ offers });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

// Wholesalers post procurement demands / purchase offers
app.post('/api/wholesaler-offers', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      wholesalerId, wholesalerName, wholesalerPhone, businessName,
      cropName, cropBangla, quantityKgNeeded, offeredPricePerKg,
      district = 'Bogura', upazila = '', location, deadline, urgent = false, notes = '',
    } = req.body;

    if (!cropName || !quantityKgNeeded || !offeredPricePerKg || !location) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Crop, quantity, offered price, and delivery location are required.' });
    }

    const offerId = `bid-${Date.now()}`;
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO wholesaler_offers (
        id, wholesaler_id, wholesaler_name, wholesaler_phone, business_name,
        crop_name, crop_bangla, quantity_kg_needed, fulfilled_kg, offered_price_per_kg,
        district, upazila, location, deadline, urgent, verified, notes, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, 0, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?
      )
    `).run(
      offerId,
      wholesalerId || 'w-user',
      wholesalerName || 'Verified Wholesaler',
      wholesalerPhone || '',
      businessName || wholesalerName || 'Wholesale Arat',
      cropName,
      cropBangla || cropName,
      Number(quantityKgNeeded),
      Number(offeredPricePerKg),
      district,
      upazila || null,
      location,
      deadline || 'Within 7 days',
      urgent ? 1 : 0,
      notes || null,
      nowIso
    );

    return res.status(201).json({ success: true, offerId, message: 'Purchase offer broadcast to farmers successfully!' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/ai/diagnose-crop', async (req, res) => {
  const { cropName = 'Tomato', symptoms = '', imageBase64, imageMimeType = 'image/jpeg', language = 'bn' } = req.body;

  const fallback = {

      : cropName.toLowerCase().includes('potato') || cropName.toLowerCase().includes('আলু')

    immediateActions: language === 'bn'
      ? ['আক্রান্ত পাতা সংগ্রহ করে পুড়িয়ে ফেলুন', 'গাছের গোড়ায় অতিরিক্ত পানি নিষ্কাশন নিশ্চিত করুন', 'বাতাস চলাচলের জন্য জমি আগাছামুক্ত রাখুন']
      : ['Collect and burn severely infected leaves', 'Ensure proper drainage at roots', 'Keep field weed-free for aeration'],
    chemicalTreatment: {
      medicine: 'Mancozeb 75 WP (Dithane M-45) or Ridomil Gold MZ',
      dose: language === 'bn' ? 'প্রতি লিটার পানিতে ২ গ্রাম হারে স্প্রে করুন' : '2 grams per liter of water',
      schedule: language === 'bn' ? '৭-১০ দিন পর পর ২ বার স্প্রে করুন' : 'Spray twice at 7-10 day intervals',
    },
    organicTreatment: language === 'bn'
      ? 'নিম তেলের দ্রবণ (প্রতি লিটারে ৫ মিলি) অথবা ট্রাইকোডার্মা জৈব ছত্রাকনাশক ব্যবহার করুন।'
      : 'Neem oil solution (5ml/L) or Trichoderma bio-fungicide soil treatment.',
    preventionTips: language === 'bn'
      ? 'পরবর্তী মৌসুমে রোগমুক্ত প্রত্যায়িত বীজ ব্যবহার করুন এবং ফসল পর্যায়ক্রম অনুসরণ করুন।'
      : 'Use certified disease-free seeds and practice crop rotation next season.',
    aiDisclaimer: language === 'bn'
      ? 'সতর্কতা: এটি এআই ভিত্তিক প্রাথমিক বিশ্লেষণ। কোনো রাসায়নিক প্রয়োগের পূর্বে অবশ্যই স্থানীয় উপ-সহকারী কৃষি কর্মকর্তা (SAAO/UAO) বা কৃষি বিশেষজ্ঞের পরামর্শ নিন।'
      : 'Advisory: This is an automated AI diagnostic estimate. Always consult your local Sub-Assistant Agriculture Officer (SAAO) or certified agronomist before taking action.',
    pesticideSafetyWarning: language === 'bn'
      ? 'কীটনাশক সতর্কতা: স্প্রে করার সময় মাস্ক ও গ্লাভস পরিধান করুন। ফসল তোলার পূর্ববর্তী নির্ধারিত নিরাপদ সময় (PHI) বজায় রাখুন।'
      : 'Pesticide Safety: Wear protective gloves and face mask. Strictly adhere to Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI).',
    verifiedBySAAO: false,
  };

  if (!ai) {
    return res.json(fallback);
  }

  try {
    const promptText = `Expert Agronomist for Bogura Bangladesh. Diagnose this crop:
Crop: ${cropName}
Symptoms: ${symptoms}
Language: ${language === 'bn' ? 'Bengali' : 'English'}
NOTE: Do NOT claim human or SAAO verification. Do NOT return fake certainty or confidence percentages.
Return JSON with:
{
  "diseaseName": "English name",
  "diseaseBanglaName": "বাংলা নাম",

  "symptomsSummary": "short explanation",

  "preventionTips": "crop rotation and clean seed",

  "pesticideSafetyWarning": "safety notice"
}`;

    const parts: any[] = [{ text: promptText }];

      const cleanBase64 = imageBase64.replace(/^data:image\/\w+;base64,/, '');
      parts.push({
        inlineData: {
          mimeType: imageMimeType || 'image/jpeg',
          data: cleanBase64,
        },
      });
    }

    const response = await callGemini(parts, {
      responseMimeType: 'application/json',
    }, 15000);

    const parsed = JSON.parse(response.text || '{}');
    return res.json({ ...fallback, ...parsed });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn('Crop diagnosis fallback activated:', error.message);
    return res.json(fallback);
  }
});

// 3. Current User Profile
app.get('/api/auth/me', (req, res) => {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  const phone = req.query.phone as string;

  let user: any = token ? jsonDb.getUsers().find((u: any) => u.sessionToken === token) : undefined;
  if (!user && phone) {
    user = jsonDb.findUserByIdentifier(phone);
  }

  // Also check SQLite database if not found in jsonDb
  if (!user && phone) {
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = ? LIMIT 1').get(phone) as any;
    if (row) {
      user = {
        id: row.id,
        role: row.role,
        name: row.name,
        nameBn: row.name_bn,
        phone: row.phone,
        email: row.email,
        district: row.district,
        upazila: row.upazila,
        verified: Boolean(row.verified),
        farmSizeAcres: row.farm_size_acres,
        primaryCrops: row.primary_crops ? JSON.parse(row.primary_crops) : undefined,
        businessName: row.business_name,
        businessType: row.business_type,
        shopName: row.shop_name,
        licenseNumber: row.license_number,
        createdAt: row.created_at,
      };
    }
  }

  if (!user) {
    return res.status(401).json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' });
  }

  const { passwordHash: _, ...safeUser } = user;
  return res.json({ success: true, user: safeUser });
});

// 4. Update Profile
app.put('/api/users/profile', (req, res) => {
  const { id, name, nameBn, district, upazila, farmSizeAcres, primaryCrops, shopName, licenseNumber } = req.body;
  if (!id) return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'User id is required' });

  // Update in SQLite if exists there
  try {
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE users SET
          name = COALESCE(?, name),
          name_bn = COALESCE(?, name_bn),
          district = COALESCE(?, district),
          upazila = COALESCE(?, upazila),
          farm_size_acres = COALESCE(?, farm_size_acres),
          primary_crops = COALESCE(?, primary_crops),
          shop_name = COALESCE(?, shop_name),
          license_number = COALESCE(?, license_number)
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        name ?? null,
        nameBn ?? null,
        district ?? null,
        upazila ?? null,
        farmSizeAcres ?? null,
        primaryCrops ? JSON.stringify(primaryCrops) : null,
        shopName ?? null,
        licenseNumber ?? null,
        id
      );
    }
  } catch {
    // continue to jsonDb
  }

  const updated = jsonDb.updateUser(id, {
    name,
    nameBn,
    district,
    upazila,
    farmSizeAcres,
    primaryCrops,
    shopName,
    licenseNumber,
  });

  const finalUser = updated || (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any);
  if (!finalUser) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'User not found' });
  const { passwordHash: _, password_hash: __, ...safeUser } = finalUser;
  return res.json({ success: true, user: safeUser });
});

// ─── USER DIRECTORY REST API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Returns all eligible users for the cross-role communication directory.
// Strips sensitive fields (passwordHash, sessionToken, securityPin) before sending.
app.get('/api/users', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { excludeId, role, district, search } = req.query;

    const sqliteRows = db.prepare('SELECT id, role, name, name_bn as nameBn, phone, email, district, upazila, verified, farm_size_acres as farmSizeAcres, primary_crops as primaryCrops, business_name as businessName, business_type as businessType, shop_name as shopName, license_number as licenseNumber FROM users').all() as any[];
    const sqliteUsers = sqliteRows.map((u: any) => ({
      ...u,
      primaryCrops: u.primaryCrops ? (typeof u.primaryCrops === 'string' ? JSON.parse(u.primaryCrops) : u.primaryCrops) : undefined,
    }));

    const jsonUsers = jsonDb.getUsers();
    const userMap = new Map<string, any>();
    jsonUsers.forEach((u: any) => userMap.set(u.id, u));
    sqliteUsers.forEach((u: any) => userMap.set(u.id, { ...userMap.get(u.id), ...u }));

    let users = Array.from(userMap.values()).filter((u: any) => {
      // Never expose admin accounts in directory
      if (u.role === 'admin') return false;
      // Exclude the requesting user themselves
      if (excludeId && u.id === String(excludeId)) return false;
      return true;
    });

    // Role filter
    if (role && role !== 'all') {
      users = users.filter((u: any) => u.role === String(role));
    }

    // District filter
    if (district && district !== 'all') {
      users = users.filter(
        (u: any) => u.district && u.district.toLowerCase() === String(district).toLowerCase()
      );
    }

    // Text search (name, nameBn, phone, businessName, shopName, designation, primaryCrops)
    if (search && String(search).trim()) {
      const q = String(search).toLowerCase().trim();
      users = users.filter((u: any) => {
        if (u.name && u.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.nameBn && u.nameBn.includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.phone && u.phone.includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.district && u.district.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.businessName && u.businessName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.shopName && u.shopName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        if (u.designation && u.designation.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        if (Array.isArray(u.primaryCrops)) {
          if (u.primaryCrops.some((c: string) => c.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
        }
        return false;
      });
    }

    // Strip sensitive fields
    const safeUsers = users.map((u: any) => {
      const { passwordHash: _, password_hash: __, sessionToken: ___, securityPin: ____, ...safe } = u;
      return {
        ...safe,
        phone: safe.phone ? `****${String(safe.phone).slice(-4)}` : '',
      };
    });

    res.json({ success: true, users: safeUsers, total: safeUsers.length });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post('/api/crops', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      farmerId,
      farmerName,
      farmerPhone,
      district,
      upazila,
      cropName,
      cropBangla,
      variety = 'Standard',
      quantityKg,
      availableDate,
      expectedPricePerKg,
      marketBenchmarkPrice,
      imageUrl,
      qualityGrade = 'A',
      organicCertified = false,
    } = req.body;

    if (!farmerId || !farmerName || !cropName || !quantityKg || !expectedPricePerKg) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Missing required crop fields: farmerId, farmerName, cropName, quantityKg, expectedPricePerKg',
      });
    }

    const newCrop = jsonDb.addCrop({
      id: `crop-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      farmerId,
      farmerName,
      farmerPhone: farmerPhone || '',
      district: district || 'Bogura',
      upazila: upazila || 'Shibganj',
      cropName,
      cropBangla: cropBangla || cropName,
      variety,
      quantityKg: Number(quantityKg),
      availableDate: availableDate || 'Ready to Harvest',
      expectedPricePerKg: Number(expectedPricePerKg),
      marketBenchmarkPrice: marketBenchmarkPrice ? Number(marketBenchmarkPrice) : Number(expectedPricePerKg) + 4,
      status: 'Growing',
      imageUrl: imageUrl || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1592924357228-91a4daadcfea?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
      qualityGrade,
      organicCertified: !!organicCertified,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    return res.status(201).json({ success: true, crop: newCrop });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Verified Buyer Review Submission (Allowed ONLY on Delivered Orders)
app.post('/api/orders/:id/review', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { rating, comment } = req.body;
    if (!rating || Number(rating) < 1 || Number(rating) > 5) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Valid star rating between 1 and 5 is required' });
    }

    const order = jsonDb.getOrderById(req.params.id);
    if (!order) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Order not found' });
    if (order.status !== 'Delivered') {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Reviews are reserved exclusively for verified buyers with completed deliveries.',
      });
    }

    const updated = jsonDb.addOrderReview(req.params.id, Number(rating), comment || '');
    return res.json({ success: true, order: updated, message: 'Verified review submitted successfully' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// ─── MASTER AGRICULTURAL CATALOG REST APIS ──────────────────────────────────
app.get('/api/catalog', (req, res) => {
  const { category, query, page = '1', limit = '24' } = req.query;
  const cat = typeof category === 'string' ? category : undefined;
  const q = typeof query === 'string' ? query : undefined;
  const all = jsonDb.getCatalog(cat, q);

  if (limit === 'all') {
    return res.json({ success: true, products: all, total: all.length, page: 1, totalPages: 1 });
  }

  const p = Math.max(1, parseInt(String(page), 10) || 1);
  const l = Math.max(1, parseInt(String(limit), 10) || 24);
  const total = all.length;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / l);
  const start = (p - 1) * l;
  const paginated = all.slice(start, start + l);

  res.json({
    success: true,
    products: paginated,
    total,
    page: p,
    totalPages,
    limit: l,
  });
});

app.get('/api/catalog/:id', (req, res) => {
  const product = jsonDb.getCatalogById(req.params.id);
  if (!product) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Product not found' });
  res.json({ success: true, product });
});

// ─── REAL-TIME SSE (SERVER-SENT EVENTS) ENGINE ──────────────────────────────
const sseClients = new Map<string, Set<express.Response>>();

export function sendSSE(userId: string, event: string, data: any) {
  const clients = sseClients.get(userId);
  if (clients && clients.size > 0) {
    const payload = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
    clients.forEach((clientRes) => {
      try {
        clientRes.write(payload);
      } catch {
        // ignore closed socket errors
      }
    });
  }
}

app.get('/api/realtime', (req, res) => {
  const userId = req.query.userId as string;
  if (!userId) {
    return res.status(400).send('userId query parameter required');
  }

  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
  res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
  res.flushHeaders?.();

  if (!sseClients.has(userId)) {
    sseClients.set(userId, new Set());
  }
  sseClients.get(userId)!.add(res);

  res.write(`event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ userId, connectedAt: new Date().toISOString() })}\n\n`);

  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => {
    try {
      res.write(': keepalive\n\n');
    } catch {
      clearInterval(keepAlive);
    }
  }, 20000);

  req.on('close', () => {
    clearInterval(keepAlive);
    const clients = sseClients.get(userId);
    if (clients) {
      clients.delete(res);
      if (clients.size === 0) {
        sseClients.delete(userId);
      }
    }
  });
});

// ─── DIRECT MESSAGING REST APIS ─────────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/api/messages', (req, res) => {
  const { userA, userB } = req.query;
  if (!userA || !userB) {
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'userA and userB are required' });
  }
  const messages = jsonDb.getMessages(String(userA), String(userB));
  res.json({ success: true, messages });
});

app.post('/api/messages', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { senderId, senderName, senderRole, recipientId, recipientName, recipientRole, content, replyToId } = req.body;
    if (!senderId || !recipientId || !content || !content.trim()) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Missing required message parameters' });
    }

    const message = jsonDb.addMessage({
      senderId,
      senderName: senderName || 'User',
      senderRole: senderRole || 'farmer',
      recipientId,
      recipientName: recipientName || 'User',
      recipientRole: recipientRole || 'businessman',
      content: content.trim(),
      replyToId,
    });

    // Real-time dispatch via SSE
    sendSSE(recipientId, 'new_message', { message });
    sendSSE(senderId, 'message_sent', { message });

    res.status(201).json({ success: true, message });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.put('/api/messages/read', (req, res) => {
  const { recipientId, senderId } = req.body;
  if (!recipientId || !senderId) {
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'recipientId and senderId are required' });
  }
  jsonDb.markMessagesRead(recipientId, senderId);
  sendSSE(senderId, 'messages_read', { recipientId, senderId });
  res.json({ success: true });
});

// ─── CONNECTIONS REST APIS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/api/connections', (req, res) => {
  const { userId } = req.query;
  if (!userId) return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'userId is required' });
  const connections = jsonDb.getConnections(String(userId));
  res.json({ success: true, connections });
});

app.post('/api/connections', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { requesterId, recipientId } = req.body;
    if (!requesterId || !recipientId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'requesterId and recipientId are required' });
    }
    const connection = jsonDb.addConnectionRequest(requesterId, recipientId);
    sendSSE(recipientId, 'new_connection', { connection });
    sendSSE(requesterId, 'connection_requested', { connection });
    res.status(201).json({ success: true, connection });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.put('/api/connections/:id', (req, res) => {
  const { status } = req.body;
  if (status !== 'accepted' && status !== 'rejected') {
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'Status must be accepted or rejected' });
  }
  const connection = jsonDb.updateConnectionStatus(req.params.id, status);
  if (!connection) return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: 'Connection not found' });

  sendSSE(connection.requesterId, 'connection_updated', { connection });
  sendSSE(connection.recipientId, 'connection_updated', { connection });
  res.json({ success: true, connection });
});

app.delete('/api/connections/:id', (req, res) => {
  const deleted = jsonDb.deleteConnection(req.params.id);
  res.json({ success: deleted });
});

// ─── AUTH LOGOUT REST API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.post('/api/auth/logout', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const token = req.headers.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', '') || req.body.token;
    const { userId } = req.body;

    let user: any = userId ? jsonDb.getUserById(userId) : undefined;
    if (!user && token) {
      user = jsonDb.getUsers().find((u: any) => u.sessionToken === token);
    }

    if (user) {
      jsonDb.updateUser(user.id, { sessionToken: undefined });
      jsonDb.addAuditLog({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        phone: user.phone,
        role: user.role,
        status: 'LOGOUT',
        ip: req.ip || '127.0.0.1',
        device: (req.headers['user-agent'] as string) || 'Web Client',
        details: 'User logged out and session token invalidated',
      });
    }

    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Logged out successfully' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// ─── WEBRTC CALL SIGNALING & CALL LOGS REST APIS ────────────────────────────
app.post('/api/calls/signal', (req, res) => {
  const { toUserId, fromUserId, fromUserName, fromUserRole, type, sdp, candidate, reason } = req.body;
  if (!toUserId || !type) {
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: 'toUserId and signal type are required' });
  }

  sendSSE(toUserId, 'call_signal', {
    toUserId,
    fromUserId,
    fromUserName,
    fromUserRole,
    type,
    sdp,
    candidate,
    reason,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  res.json({ success: true });
});
